overview_en:
After receiving the Purah Pad from a Steward Construct, Link is told that Zelda is waiting for him in the Temple of Time on the Great Sky Island. However, when he tries to activate the Terminal to open the Temple's door, the Terminal turns red and denies him entry. While Link is examining his new Right Arm, Rauru appears behind him, explaining that he can only open the door once he has a sufficient amount of power. Rauru apologizes for startling Link, revealing that he was the original owner of the Arm and introducing himself.
Rauru laments having to appear as a Spirit, since his physical form is gone. He reasons that the Right Arm should have enough power to activate the Terminal, but it appears to have lost this ability. To restore his Arm's Ancient Powers, Link must visit three of the Shrines of Light located on the Great Sky Island,  Looking towards Ukouh Shrine nearby, Rauru assures Link that the Shrines are the key to fixing the Arm before disappearing. Afterwards, "The Closed Door" will begin.
Whenever Link enters a Shrine of Light, Rauru will appear before him yet again. In the first Shrine, Rauru will explain that he was the original creator of the Shrines, and he believes they are capable of restoring the Right Arm's lost Ancient Powers. He then asks Link to show him his hand, granting him either Ultrahand, Fuse, or Ascend depending on the Shrine. Link must then use these abilities to reach the end of the Shrine of Light.
Once Link has completed his first Shrine of Light, Rauru appears in front of him, commending him for passing its trial and restoring one of the Right Arm's abilities. Should Link two more Shrines, Rauru believes he will be able to enter the Temple of Time. He suggests Link mark the locations of these Shrine with Pins with the Purah Pad's Scope, allowing him to keep track of them as he explores.
After completing Ukouh Shrine, In-isa Shrine, and Gutanbac Shrine and receiving the Lights of Blessing, Rauru returns to Link, telling him that he has successfully restored some of the Right Arm's Ancient Powers. He believes that Link is now capable of activating the Terminal in front of the Temple of Time.
Now, when Link attempts to activate the Terminal in front of the Temple of Time, it will respond to his Right Arm and open the door. Once this is done, "The Closed Door" will be completed.
overview_zh:
链接从管家构造物处获得光之护臂后，被告知塞尔达在天空岛的大时钟神殿等候他。然而，当他试图激活终端以打开神殿大门时，终端变为红色并拒绝进入。 此时，链接正在检查他的新右臂时，拉鲁从身后出现，解释说只有在获得足够的力量后才能打开大门。 拉鲁向链接道歉，透露他是护臂的原始所有者，自我介绍。

拉鲁对必须以精灵的形式出现感到遗憾，因为他已经失去了肉体。 他认为右臂应该有足够的能量来激活终端，但似乎已经失去这种能力。 为了恢复右臂的古老力量，链接必须前往天空岛上的三个光之神殿， 转向附近的乌库赫神殿，拉鲁向链接保证神殿是修复护臂的关键，然后消失。 之后，“关闭的大门”将开始。

每次链接进入一个光之神殿时，拉鲁都会再次出现。 在第一个神殿中，拉鲁解释他是神殿的原始创建者，并且他认为它们能够恢复右臂失去的古老力量， 然后要求链接展示他的手，根据不同的神殿，给予他 Ultrahand、Fuse 或者 Ascend。 链接必须使用这些能力到达光之神殿的终点。

当链接完成第一个光之神殿后，拉鲁出现在他面前，赞扬他通过了考验并恢复了一部分右臂的能力。 如果链接还能完成两个神殿，拉鲁认为他能够进入时间神殿。 他建议链接使用 Purah Pad 的测距功能来标记这些神殿的位置，以便他在探索过程中跟踪它们。

在完成乌库赫神殿、仁萨神殿和古塔巴克神殿并获得祝福的光之光后，拉鲁回到链接身边，告诉他他已经成功地恢复了右臂的部分古老力量。 他认为，链接现在能够激活时间神殿前的终端。

现在，当链接尝试在通往时间神殿的大门前激活终端时，它会回应他的护臂并打开大门。 这样，“关闭的大门”就完成了。

overview_en:
After the Decayed Master Sword disappears at the back of the Temple of Time, the Light Dragon rises from the clouds beneath the Great Sky Island, revealing the Surface below. As Link looks down on Lookout Landing, he hears the voice of Zelda telling him to come find her. Upon hearing her voice, "To the Kingdom of Hyrule" Main Quest will begin.

When Link dives from the Temple of Time, he will be able to land in the Water of the Bottomless Pond. From there, he makes his way to Lookout Landing in Hyrule Field. When he reaches the Research Lab, Josha will be shocked to see him and call out to Purah. At this, Purah runs out from inside the Research Lab, asking Link where he has been. While examining Link, she wonders if he is a ghost, though she quickly becomes distracted by his new Right Arm. Removing her goggles, Purah decides to take their encounter one step at a time and asks Link what happened.
Upon hearing Link's retelling of the events Beneath Hyrule Castle, Purah reasons that they must have occurred at the start of the Upheaval. She also repeats his story of his time on the Great Sky Island. She is shocked that Link was able to come back to the Surface from the Sky. Recalling that Rauru was the name of the first King of Hyrule, Purah speculates they could be the same individual, but she is still confused. However, she believes that the mummy Beneath Hyrule Castle is related to the Upheaval. She also takes Link hearing Zelda's voice as a sign she is still alive, potentially even trapped Beneath Hyrule Castle. Now that Link has returned, Purah decides that they need his help investigating Hyrule Castle as part of the Search for Princess Zelda. Following their conversation, "To the Kingdom of Hyrule" will be completed, and the "Crisis at Hyrule Castle" Main Quest will begin.
overview_zh:
在时间神殿后，腐朽的神剑消失后，光龙从大天空岛下方升起，揭示了地面的景象。当林克俯瞰 lookout landing时，他听到了塞尔达的声音，让她来找他。听到她的声音后，“前往海拉鲁王国”主线任务将开始。

当林克从时间神殿坠落时，他可以在无底池湖中着陆。然后他前往海拉鲁平原上的 lookout landing 。当他到达研究实验室时，Josha 会震惊地看到他并呼唤 Purah。这时，Purah 冲出研究实验室，问林克他去哪里了。虽然她在检查林克的身体时，怀疑他是鬼魂，但很快就被他的新右臂吸引了。摘下护目镜后，Purah 决定一步步来，并问林克发生了什么。

听到林克讲述的海拉鲁城堡下发生的事件，Purah 推断这一定是在“动荡”开始的时候。她还重复了他的在“大天空岛”上的经历。她感到惊讶的是，林克竟然能从天空回到地面。回忆起拉努尔是海拉鲁的第一位国王的名字，Purah 猜测他们可能是一个人，但她仍然困惑。然而，她认为海拉鲁城堡下的木乃伊与“动荡”有关。她也将林克听到塞尔达的声音视为一个迹象，表明塞尔达仍然活着，甚至被困在海拉鲁城堡下。现在林克回来了，Purah 决定他需要帮助调查海拉鲁城堡，作为“寻找塞尔达公主”的任务的一部分。在与他们的谈话之后，“前往海拉鲁王国”将会完成，并且 “海拉鲁城堡危机 ”主线任务将开始.

overview_en:
During the "Crisis at Hyrule Castle" Main Quest, Purah asks Link to start investigating the strange phenomena that has appeared throughout Hyrule as part of the Upheaval, believing that it could help them locate Princess Zelda. After he has activated the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower and collected its Map data, Purah asks to see his Purah Pad. Using the Map, she directs him to the four Regions that have been reported issues, these being Hebra, Eldin, Lanayru, and Gerudo. She suspects that by investigating these phenomena, they can learn more about where Zelda could be. Josha claims to have heard that Zelda was sighted near Rito Village recently, which Purah thinks could be credible. After their conversation, "Regional Phenomena" will start.
In order to complete "Regional Phenomena", Link must first finish the following Main Quests:

"Tulin of Rito Village"
"Yunobo of Goron City"
"Sidon of the Zora"
"Riju of Gerudo Town"
During each of these Main Quests, Link will encounter an individual who appears to be Zelda causing the Region's disasters. As he awakens the Sages, their predecessors show him visions featuring an ancient Sage of Time that resembles Zelda as well. When Link solves the phenomena plaguing a Region, their leaders pledge to send reinforcements to Lookout Landing to help aid in the search for Zelda.

Once all four of these Main Quests have been completed, Link will be directed to return to Lookout Landing and report his findings to Purah. Upon his return, Link can hear rumors that Zelda has been seen near Hyrule Castle. He can then find Purah looking through the Telescope on top of her Research Lab. When spoken to, she commends him for solving the problems that the Regions were facing. She believes that the individual who resembles Zelda is related to the Upheaval, and although she has something to share with Link, she is interrupted by the sudden appearance of a Blood Moon. Looking back through her Telescope, Purah spots something and tells Link to look. When he does so, he can see Zelda outside of Hyrule Castle's Sanctum. Purah is shocked, but as the Blood Moon ends, Zelda disappears in a cloud of Gloom.
After the Blood Moon ends, Purah reveals that she saw the person who resembles Zelda at Hyrule Castle, and instead of disappearing, it seems like she retreated inside. She declares that they must rescue her, but since Link is the only individual capable of reaching Hyrule Castle, he is forced to go after her alone. She asks him to come back safely with Zelda. At this point, "Regional Phenomena" will be completed, and "Crisis at Hyrule Castle" will continue.
overview_zh:
在“海拉鲁城堡危机”主线任务中，普拉要求林克调查整个海拉鲁出现的奇怪现象，这与“动荡”有关，并相信这将有助于找到梅丽坚。林克激活了洛卡兰天空塔并收集了地图数据后，普拉让他查看他的普拉Pad。她利用地图指引他前往报告出现问题的四个区域：赫布拉、艾尔登、莱纳鲁和格鲁多（Gerudo）。她认为通过调查这些现象，他们可以了解梅丽坚可能的位置。乔沙声称最近在利托村看到了梅丽坚的身影，普拉觉得这有可能是真的。

为了完成“区域现象”，林克首先需要完成以下主线任务：

“利托村的图林”
“哥隆城的尤诺博”
“扎拉的西登”
“格鲁多城的里朱”

在这些主线任务中，林克将遇到一个似乎是梅丽坚的人，而这个出现的人正导致该地区的灾难。当林克唤醒先贤时，他们向他展示了古代的时之贤者，该贤者与梅丽坚非常相似。
完成某个区域的现象后，他们的领导人会承诺为搜寻梅丽坚前往洛卡兰天空塔提供支援。

完成以上四项主线任务后，林克将被引导返回洛卡兰天空塔并向普拉汇报情况。在返回时，林克听到传言称梅丽坚可能出现在海拉鲁城堡附近。他随后可以找到普拉正在研究实验室的望远镜上。与她交谈后，她赞扬了林克解决各个地区的问题。她认为与梅丽坚相似的人与“动荡”有关，虽然她有一些信息要分享给林克，但突然出现了一轮血月打断了她的话。普拉用望远镜看向前方，发现了什么并告诉林克去看看。林克看向后，看到了在海拉鲁城堡的圣殿外，梅丽坚。普拉震惊了，但随着血月的结束，梅丽坚消失在充满笼雾之中。

随着血月的结束后，普拉透露她也曾在海拉鲁城堡看到与梅丽坚相似的人，而且这次她并没有消失，而是似乎进入了城堡内部。她决定要救出梅丽坚，但因为林克是唯一能够到达海拉鲁城堡的人，所以他必须独自去救她。她要求他安全地带回梅丽坚。这时，“区域现象”将完成，“海拉鲁城堡危机”将继续。

overview_en:
After facing Phantom Ganon during the "Crisis at Hyrule Castle" Main Quest, Link and the Sages return to Purah and Lookout Landing, who is able to determine that Princess Zelda was making preparations for their fight against Demon King Ganondorf in the ancient past. She believes that they could be missing a hint that she left for them. Sidon agrees with her, claiming it is important for them to act now. However, Riju is concerned by their lack of leads.
Purah remembers that in all of their stories, Six Sages were involved in the Imprisoning War, and excluding Zelda, only four of them are accounted for. Riju and Tulin are amazed, though Yunobo is confused. Sidon then voices that they are missing one Sage. In a flashback, Mineru can be seen fighting alongside her fellow Sages. Back in the present, Purah states that this is a lead they must follow, wondering if the final Sage could be within ruins from the ancient past. Riju decides that they should start by searching these ruins. Purah directs the Sages to search for clues in their respective Regions, while she asks Link to find leads on his own. After they leave, "Find the Fifth Sage" will begin.
At Kakariko Village, Link can inform Paya and Tauro of the Phantom Ganon pretending to be Zelda. Tauro realizes that the Floating Ring Ruin may be a threat to Demon King Ganondorf in some way, and since the Order of Princess Zelda no longer stands, they are now able to investigate. Following this revelation, "Secret of the Ring Ruins" will start.
During "Secret of the Ring Ruins", Link opens a Challenge Door and enters a chamber on Dragonhead Island. Inside, he finds the Zonai Relic, which shoots a beam of light toward Tobio's Hollow when interacted with. He will then hear the voice of Mineru, telling him to take the Relic and follow the light. Afterwards, "Secret of the Ring Ruins" will be completed, and "Guidance from Ages Past" will begin.
During "Guidance from Ages Past", Link reawakens Mineru as the Sage of Spirit, which he must then report to Purah. Though she is initially shocked, Purah is excited to hear they have gathered all five Sages. She is also relieved to hear of Zelda's actions in the distant past, which have restored the Master Sword in the modern day. To find the Master Sword, Purah suggests that Link visit the Great Deku Tree in the Great Hyrule Forest. Afterwards, both "Find the Fifth Sage" and "Crisis at Hyrule Castle" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在“哈莱王城堡危机”主线任务中，林克和智者们回到普拉和 Lookout Landing，普拉确定公主塞尔达在过去为与魔王加农德的战斗做好了准备。她认为他们可能遗漏了一个线索。西顿同意她的观点，认为现在行动很重要。然而，丽朱对缺乏线索感到担忧。

普拉回忆起六智者一直参与封印之战，除了塞尔达，只有四位智者记录在案。丽朱和图林都感到惊讶，而尤诺则感到困惑。西顿表示他们缺少一位智者。在一段回忆中，米纽可以被看到与她的同伴智者一起战斗。回到现在，普拉表示这是他们必须遵循的线索，猜测最后的智者可能隐藏在古代遗迹之中。丽朱决定先去寻找这些遗迹。普拉让智者们分别搜索各自的区域，而她要求林克自己寻找线索。离开后，“找到第五位智者”将开始。
在卡卡里村，林克可以告知佩亚和塔鲁关于幻影甘农假扮塞尔达的事情。塔鲁意识到浮现戒指遗迹可能以某种方式对魔王加农德构成威胁，由于公主塞尔达的秩序已经不存在，他们现在可以进行调查。随后，“浮现戒指遗迹”将开始。
在“浮现戒指遗迹”中，林克打开了一个挑战门，进入了龙头岛上的一个房间。在那里，他找到了佐奈遗物，与人互动后，它会向托比奥的空洞发射一束光。之后，“浮现戒指遗迹”将完成，并开始“古代的指引”。
在“古代的指引”中，林克复活了米纽作为精神智者，然后需要向普拉汇报此事。虽然她最初感到震惊，但得知他们已经找到了所有五位智者让她很兴奋。此外，她还得知塞尔达在遥远的过去所做的事情，从而让现在的贤刃恢复了原状。为了找到贤刃，普拉建议林克去大德库树所在的吉尔王森林。之后，“寻找第五位智者”和“哈莱王城堡危机”将完成。

overview_en:
Upon hearing Link's story during the "To the Kingdom of Hyrule" Main Quest, Purah determines that the events of the Upheaval must be connected to the mummy he and Zelda encountered Beneath Hyrule Castle. Since Link heard Zelda's voice, Purah believes that she could still be trapped below Hyrule Castle. As a result, she tasks Link with meeting up with Squad One and Squad Two of the Monster-Control Crew led by Hoz at Hyrule Castle, who have been searching for both him and Zelda. Despite the fact that the mummy may be in the area, Purah decides it is important to keep up the Search for Princess Zelda. Afterwards, "To the Kingdom of Hyrule" will end, and "Crisis at Hyrule Castle will begin.
At the First Gatehouse, Link can find Hoz directing his squad members to continue the search. When Link approaches him, Hoz initially tries to dismiss him, claiming to be busy. He is shocked when he realizes it is Link, believing that means Zelda is safe as well. Although Hoz is confused by Link's clarification, he declares that continuing to search for Zelda is more important. He expresses how relieved he is to have Link's help, since they have been overwhelmed by the Gloom surrounding Hyrule Castle.

Suddenly, Toren shouts, claiming to have spotted Zelda. On a ruined wall in the distance, a figure resembling Zelda can be seen staring towards the group. Hoz is happy to see that she is safe. However, she then floats into the air and bursts into Light, much to his confusion. Hoz declares that they are in an emergency situation, wondering why Zelda left without speaking to them. He decides to withdraw the Monster-Control Crew for now, sending Link ahead to inform Purah of what they saw.

When Link returns to Lookout Landing, Purah asks him if he was able to find anything. She and Josha are both shocked to hear about the sighting, noting how he always tells outlandish stories. Due to Zelda flying off, Purah decides that they should focus on investigating the Upheaval itself, since it could lead them to where Zelda went. She then asks to see the Purah Pad, at which point she looks for its Map function. In order to create a Map of Hyrule, they first need to add data from the area surrounding Lookout Landing.
Turning to Josha, Purah asks her the status of the Skyview Towers. After an examination, she determines that the Travel Point is still receiving its final adjustments. Purah decides she will be the one to finish it, apologizing to Link for the delay. Until then, she suggests that he rest in the Emergency Shelter, which has Beds and a Kitchen. She directs him to talk to Scorpis for more information. Purah also tells him to visit Mubs's Armor Shop if he needs Armor. Once Link is ready, she tells him to meet her at the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower. Before ending their conversation, she puts Josha in charge of preparing the switch.
At the Lookout Landing Skyview Tower, Link will find Purah finishing her work on the Sheikah Slate Terminal. She asks Link if he is ready and reveals that the Travel Point is almost completed. Purah then calls out to Josha at the Research Lab to pull the switch, which she proceeds to do. This causes all of the Skyview Towers throughout Hyrule to activate, launching flares into the Sky. Next, Purah directs Link to use the Purah Pad on the Sheikah Slate Terminal. Once he does so, the Skyview Tower will be activated on his Map, allowing him to use its Travel Point. Purah reveals that Skyview Towers are capable of creating Maps of their surroundings for the Purah Pad. Due to Link's absence, Purah had no one who would be able to complete the Scan, since it requires a Paraglider. She then gives Link the Paraglider.
For the first Scan, Purah tells Link to stand on the nearby Elevator Platform, and once he is done, he should meet her at the Research Lab to discuss the search for Zelda. When Link steps onto the Platform, mechanical arms will emerge from the ground, outfitting him with a coil of wire that plugs into the Purah Pad. The Elevator Platform will then abruptly shoot upwards, launching Link into the Sky. As he Scans the area, his Maps of the Surface and the Sky will both be updated.
Upon Link's return, Purah asks if his Scan was successful in updating his Map. She is relieved that the Purah Pad's Map is functioning, and she tells Link that he should try to get scans from all of the Skyview Towers in Hyrule. Switching topics to the Upheaval, Purah reveals that there have been reports of strange happenings all throughout Hyrule. In particular, she points out troubles in the Regions of Hebra, Eldin, Gerudo, and Lanayru. She believes that they may find clues about Zelda by looking into the Upheaval. Before ending their conversation, Purah reveals that she has recruited the Lucky Clover Gazette to assist in the search, and she suggests that he visit their headquarters. Purah plans to remain in Lookout Landing to coordinate research into the Upheaval and finding leads on Zelda's location. She entrusts the major happenings to Link, hoping that their combined efforts will lead them to Zelda. At this point, "Regional Phenomena" will begin.

After completing "Tulin of Rito Village", "Yunobo of Goron City", "Sidon of the Zora", and "Riju of Gerudo Town", Link must then return to Lookout Landing to inform Purah of his discoveries. There, he can find Purah looking through her Telescope toward Hyrule Castle. She informs Link that she has something to tell him, but she is interrupted by the sudden emergence of a Blood Moon. When she looks through her Telescope again, she is shocked and tells Link to do the same. Once he does so, Link will once again see the figure resembling Zelda in front of the Sanctum, though she disappears in a cloud of Gloom.
When the Blood Moon ends, Purah reveals that she was searching for signs of Zelda at Hyrule Castle, and she believes that she may have been inside the entire time. Since Link is the only one who can reach the Castle, Purah sends him after the figure. She apologizes for sending him into a dangerous situation, though she asks that both he and Zelda return safely.
When Link arrives at the floating portion of Hyrule Castle, he will find that it is being subjected to a constant Thunderstorm. He then hears the voice of Zelda saying that she is waiting for him. Link must then follow a series of Markers, which lead him to ambushes by Monster Forces using the figure as bait. The Markers denote the following locations:

The Second Gatehouse (-0159, 0880, 0284)

	Scourge of Hyrule CastleMonster Forces
