After defeating all of the Monster Forces, Link will once again hear Zelda's voice. Inside the Sanctum's Throne Room, the figure disappears again, this time appearing in front of the Thrones. She expresses her relief that Link  has finally arrived, revealing that she has something to show him. Using her powers, she then restores the Throne Room to pristine condition. She then asks Link his opinion, teleporting around the room as she does so. She encourages him to take everything in, as it will be the last thing he ever sees. An image of Demon King Ganondorf appears above the figure, wondering how Link was able to survive his Gloom. He blames the Right Arm, reiterating the threat that he will soon perish. Demon King Ganondorf reveals that the figure was a puppet Phantom Ganon meant to distract Link, and he now directs it to attack Link outright.
Once all of the Phantom Ganons have been defeated, Demon King Ganondorf admits to underestimating Link before unleashing a Gloom attack. However, it is blocked by Sidon, Yunobo, Riju, and Tulin. The image of Demon King Ganondorf returns, recognizing the Secret Stones carried by the Sages. Upon hearing Sidon's confusion, Demon King Ganondorf claims there are limits to the knowledge granted by Secret Stones. He introduces himself, claiming that their ancestors were only able to delay his rise to power. He then shows them a glimpse of his time as the Demon King, which triggers "The Demon King's Army" Memory. Following the Memory, Link and the Sages appear disoriented, but they quickly right themselves as Demon King Ganondorf continues to speak. He declares that he will soon take over Hyrule, before laughing as he disappears.

The Sages sheath their Weapons, and Tulin asks if that was truly the Demon King. Sidon states how dangerous his return is, which causes Yunobo to panic. However, Riju reasons that they still have time until he returns to his full strength, since he chose to leave instead of continuing to fight them. She tells the other Sages to regroup at Lookout Landing, asking Link to join them. After they leave, a Heart Container appears for Link.
Back at Lookout Landing, Link can find the Sages gathered outside the Research Lab. When Link approaches Purah, she greets him and asks what he found. After Purah hears Link and the Sages' story, Tulin points out how all of the strange occurences throughout Hyrule happened because of Demon King Ganondorf. Yunobo then states that Zelda is in the distant past, and Sidon adds that she was part of the effort to defeat the Demon King. Riju reveals that their ancestors made vows to Zelda that new Sages would awaken to fight him.Tulin laments that they are unable to ask Zelda what her plan is, and she will not be being beside them. In addition to this, Yunobo emphasizes how little they know about Demon King Ganondorf.
Purah is able to discern that Zelda was preparing for Demon King Ganondorf's revival in the present, and she believes they are still missing a hint that she left for them. Through their conversations, Purah and the Sages realize that excluding Zelda, there is one Sage from the Imprisoning War who is still unaccounted for. Since the other Sages awakened at ancient ruins, Purah believes that the fifth could be at a similar location. Riju decides that they should focus on investigating ruins from the same era in their respective Regions. Purah agrees with her, telling Link to search for any other leads. Once they leave, the "Find the Fifth Sage" Main Quest will begin.
After Link completes "Guidance from Ages Past" and reawakens Mineru as the Sage of Spirit, he is once again tasked with reporting to Purah. She is initially surprised to hear of Link's achievements and happy that they have now gathered all five Sages. Additionally, she is relieved that Zelda in the past wanted to restore the Master Sword to return to Link, and she suggests that he visit the Great Deku Tree in Korok Forest for help finding it. At this point, both "Crisis at Hyrule Castle" and "Find the Fifth Sage" will be completed.
overview_zh:
莱恩获知“向草原王国”主线任务中的故事，发现灾难与城堡下方的邪巫之间有联系。他听到塞尔达的声音，认为塞尔达可能仍然在城堡下。因此，他被指派去会见由霍兹率领的怪物控制队的另一支队伍，前往皇都在寻找他们两人。虽然邪巫可能就在附近，但依旧要寻找塞尔达。之后，“向草原王国”将结束，“皇都在的危机”开始。“皇都在城的第一个哨所”，莱恩可以见到霍兹指挥他的队员搜索。当莱恩上前时，霍兹试图转移话题，声称自己很忙。他意识到是莱恩被震惊了，因为他也认为塞尔达安全。虽然霍兹对莱恩的说法感到困惑，但他仍然决定继续寻找塞尔达。之后，索伦大喊“我发现了塞尔达”。在远处的一块废墟上，可以看到像塞尔达一样的人影，正对着他们。霍兹高兴地看到塞尔达安全了，但是她却飘向空中，然后被光芒吞噬，让他感到困惑。“我们现在处于紧急状态”，霍兹思考塞尔达为何没有找到他。为了进行调查，此时霍兹决定撤退，让莱恩先行前往与普拉赫沟通。当莱恩返回时，“ lookout landing” 普拉赫询问是否找到什么？普拉赫和乔莎都震惊于发现，但普拉赫认为莱恩是神话说大王。
“普拉赫觉得应该着重调查瘟疫。”由于塞尔达失踪，普拉赫决定重点围绕“灾难”展开调查。她要求查看普拉赫Pad中的地图功能。要绘制皇都在的地图，首先需要获取周边区域的数据。普拉赫询问乔莎关于天空塔的状态。乔莎告知正在进行最后的调整。“普拉赫认为自己来完成”，并 apologized 给莱恩。
在“ lookout landing” 莱恩可以与普拉赫见面，普拉赫了解到莱恩和Sage们的故事后，提问普拉赫是否发现了线索，但莱恩仍然无法提供实际的线索，普拉赫因此决定着重调查灾难，因为这可能让他们找到塞尔达。普拉赫询问普拉赫Pad中地图功能之后，她开始寻找皇都在周边的Map 功能。
普拉赫接着询问乔莎关于天空塔的状态。乔莎告知正在进行最后的调整。“普拉赫认为自己来完成”，并 apologized 给莱恩。“普拉赫决定让莱恩在Emergency Shelter里休息，那里有床和厨房。” 普拉赫还告诉他去探望 Mubs’s Armor Shop.

莱恩与普拉赫会面时，“普拉赫指示莱恩前往 lookout landing 的天空塔与她见面。” 在“皇都在的"第三个哨所"，莱恩可以看到普拉赫正在工作。
普拉赫询问莱恩是否准备好，告知“地点调整几乎完成了”，之后普拉赫会通知乔莎启动。当普拉赫找到乔莎时，“普拉赫向乔莎指示启动开关”。这导致整个皇都在的天空塔都开始运作。然后普拉赫指示莱恩利用普拉赫Pad中的Sheikah Slate 功能，完成 Scan 工作。“普拉赫告知莱恩天空塔的功能是绘制周边范围的Map”，因为“Link 还没有获得这项功能，所以他需要利用这片地形”。
当普拉赫和莱恩会面时，“普拉赫让莱恩站在附近的电梯平台上……”

当莱恩回到 Lookout Landing 时，“普拉赫询问是否找到什么”，之后了解到莱恩和Sages 的故事后。
“普拉赫提问大家是否能看到有什么线索”。之后，由于塞尔达的失踪 ，普拉赫决定着重调查“灾难”，因为这可能让他们找到塞尔达。普拉赫对莱恩说：“请去寻找其他线索。” 之后 “Find the Fifth Sage” 主线任务开始

完成“Guidance from Ages Past”和唤醒“Mineru”
回到 Lookout Landing 普拉赫会面，之后告知莱恩和Sage得新成就。还告知塞尔达在过去想要恢复Master Sword，然后建议他去“Great Deku Tree” 帮忙找。 完成“Crisis at Hyrule Castle” 和 “Find the fifth Sage” 后。

overview_en:
After Link views the "Critical Decisions" Memory during "Guidance from Ages Past", Mineru informs hims that Zelda undertook a forbidden process the restore the Master Sword for him. She directs him to meet with the Great Deku Tree for help finding it, as Zelda wanted him to. She assures Link that the Master Sword is the key to defeating Demon King Ganondorf. Afterwards, "Guidance from Ages Past" will be completed, and the "Trail of the Master Sword" Main Quest will begin.
When Link returns to Purah to report Mineru reawakening as the Sage of Spirit, she is relieved to hear news about Zelda, though she is saddened that she had to restore the Master Sword all on her own. Purah believes that the Master Sword must be somewhere in the present day, and she tells him that the Great Deku Tree can be found within the Great Hyrule Forest.
Whenever Link attempts to walk through the Lost Woods, he will be overcome by fog and automatically returned to his point of entry. If Link tries to enter the Lost Woods from their southeastern entrance, Peeks will stop him and explain that it is impossible to reach Korok Forest without getting lost. He also shares that a Chasm has opened in the Minshi Woods, which frightens him. At the Minshi Woods Chasm, Link will find Tasho, who explains that the Koroks they were walking with jumped into the Chasm thinking they could find a way back to Korok Forest.
In Minshi Grove at the bottom of the Chasm, Link can meet Nako and Mopu. Nako has become frightened of the Depths. When Link approaches Mopu, they ask if he needs directions to Korok Forest. If asked for further details, they point Link to the north.
Along the way, Link can meet with Mokka, who identifies that fog on the roof of the Depths as being from the Lost Woods. Lastly, at the center of Korok Grove, Link can meet Jatora and Maheli, who have figured out that they are beneath Korok Forest and are trying to find a way to the Surface.

If Link Ascends through the Ascend Access Point at the base of the Great Deku Tree, he will emerge within Korok Forest. He finds that the Great Deku Tree appears unwell, with Gloom seeping out of his mouth. Inside the Great Deku Tree's Navel, he will find the Deku Tree Chasm, at the bottom of which is a mass of Gloom Spawn. Upon defeating the Gloom Spawn, a Phantom Ganon will appear and begin to attack Link as well.
Once the Phantom Ganon has been defeated, all of the Gloom will disappear from the Great Deku Tree. A group of three Koroks descend before Link, who thank him for saving Korok Forest. They also inform him that the Great Deku Tree is waiting for him on the Surface. When Link stands before the Great Deku Tree, he thanks Link for helping him despite still feeling groggy. He thinks back to the last time they met with one another, which starts "The Master Sword's Power" Memory.
After the Memory ends, the Great Deku Tree notices that Link is no longer in possession of the Master Sword. Hearing that Link has lost it, the Great Deku Tree reveals that he can sense the Master Sword. A glowing Marker appears on Link's Map, marking the Sword's location. However, he notices that it appears to be moving through the Sky. Following this conversation, "Trail of the Master Sword" will be completed, and "Recovering the Hero's Sword" will start.
overview_zh:
在《过去的回响》中，林克看到“关键抉择”记忆，米内尔告诉他，塞尔达为了恢复宝剑，使用了被禁止的方法。她建议林克去见大德库树以寻求帮助，正如塞尔达希望的那样。她向林克保证，宝剑是击败魔王加农朵的关键。之后，《过去的回响》将完成，并开始《宝剑之路》。

当林克回到普拉时，她得知米内尔成为了精灵圣者，对此感到欣慰，但同时也为自己独自恢复宝剑而感到悲伤。普拉认为宝剑一定在现在，并告诉林克大德库树位于大赫鲁尔森林。

每次林克尝试进入迷雾森林，都会被浓雾笼罩并自动返回入口点。如果林克从东南方向进入迷雾森林，派克会阻止他，解释说无法到达科洛克森林而不会迷路。他还表示，在明西森林出现了一个深渊，这让他感到恐惧。在明西森林深渊处，林克会遇到塔沙，他解释说，原本和他一起走动的科洛克们认为可以找到回科洛克森林的路，于是跳到了深渊里。

在明西森林的底部，林克可以与娜可和莫普接触。娜可对《深渊》感到恐惧。当林克接近莫普时，他们会询问是否需要前往科洛克森林的方向。如果进一步询问，他们会将林克指向北方。

在前往途中，林克可以遇到默卡，他指出《深渊》屋顶上的浓雾来自迷雾森林。最后，在科洛克的中心，林克可以与扎托拉和玛赫莉接触，他们已经意识到自己位于科洛克森林之下，并试图找到返回地面的方法。

如果林克通过大德库树的底部“升空点”进入科洛克森林，他会发现大德库树看起来很虚弱，从他的嘴里渗出《忧郁》。在大德库树的肚脐中，他会找到《德库树深渊》，里面充满了《忧郁》。击败《忧郁》后，一个《幽灵加农朵》会出现并开始攻击林克。

当《幽灵加农朵》被击败后，《忧郁》从大德库树消失了。三只科洛克向林克致谢，感谢他拯救了科洛克森林。他们还告诉他，大德库树在地上等待着他。当林克站在大德库树面前时，他感谢林克帮助自己，尽管他还感到虚弱。然后，“宝剑的力量”记忆开始。

在记忆结束后，大德库树注意到林克失去了宝剑。得知林克丢失了宝剑后，大德库树透露他可以感知到宝剑的位置。一个发光的标记出现在林克的地图上，标记了宝剑的位置。然而，他发现它正在天空移动。之后，《宝剑之路》将会完成，“夺回英雄之剑”开始。

overview_en:
After Link views the Memory "The Master Sword's Power" during the "Trail of the Master Sword" Main Quest, the Great Deku Tree notices that he is no longer carrying the Master Sword. Although Link does not know where it is, the Great Deku Tree is able to sense its power. From the Map, the Great Deku Tree is able to show Link where the Master Sword is currently located. However, he notices that it appears to be moving through the Sky. The Great Deku Tree urges Link to hurry, since the Master Sword is waiting for him. After this conversation, "Recovering the Hero's Sword" will begin.
By following the Marker on the Map, Link can find the Master Sword embedded in the head of the Light Dragon. When he attempts to pull it out, the Light Dragon will suddenly roar and begin flying erratically. In order to keep his grip, Link will require at least two Stamina Wheels. If he manages to stay on the Light Dragon's head, she will calm down and bring him higher into the Sky. The fur around the Master Sword will loosen, and Link will be able to reclaim it. With its blade restored, Link then views the Memory "Zelda's Wish".
Following the Memory, Link disembarks from the Light Dragon at the Temple of Time on the Great Sky Island. At this point, "Recovering the Hero's Sword"s will be completed.
overview_zh:
在“剑之试炼”主线任务中，林克查看了“剑之力量”的回忆。大德古树注意到，林克不再持有剑。虽然林克不知道剑去了哪里，但大德古树能感知到它的力量。通过地图，大德古树能够告知林克剑的位置。然而，他发现剑似乎在天空中移动。“剑正在等待你”，大德古树敦促林克尽快行动。之后，“夺回英雄之剑”任务开始。

跟随地图上的标记，林克可以找到剑插入光龙的头部。当他尝试拔出时，光龙会突然咆哮并疯狂飞行。为了保持对光龙的控制，林克至少需要两轮耐力。如果他能成功抓住光龙的头，它就会平静下来并带他飞上天空。剑周围的毛发会松动，林克就可以取回剑。获得锋利的剑后，林克观看了“塞尔达之愿”的回忆。

在回忆之后，林克从光龙降落在天空中岛上的时钟神殿。此时，“夺回英雄之剑”任务完成。

overview_en:
As part of the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quest, Purah asks Link to investigate strange happenings caused by the Upheaval throughout Hyrule as part of their efforts to locate Princess Zelda. Josha suggests that he visit Rito Village first, claiming to have heard a rumor that Zelda was sighted there.

When Link first arrives in Rito Village, it will be subject to an intense Blizzard. At Revali's Landing, he will find Teba and Saki arguing with Tulin. Tulin insists that he is capable of investigating the Blizzard on his own, though Teba groans at his words. Tulin attempts to continue his argument, but he become distracted when he notices Link nearby. Asking if it really is Link, Tulin flies closer to him. After confirming that it is truly Link, Tulin smiles and excitedly greets him.
Teba and Saki are both pleased to see Link, having heard that he went missing. Teba asks if Link remembers Tulin, noting that while he is not yet an adult, he has grown taller since they last saw each other. Tulin retorts that he would be able to grow up if his parents stopped treating him like a child. His father claims that until Tulin learns to rely on others, he will remain a child. Tulin takes this to mean that he is unable to take care of himself, and he decides to prove himself by undertaking a scouting trip. Before he leaves, Tulin retorts that he will not waste his time like everyone else is with the "Song of the Stormwind Ark". Teba attempts to stop Tulin, but he flies away in the middle of his sentence.
After Tulin leaves, Teba grows exasperated. He reveals to Link that Tulin wants to find the source of the Blizzard, but Teba has refused to allow him to do so. When Link asks about the "Song of the Stormwind Ark", Saki explains that it is an old Rito folk song, which describes Rito Village being saved by a flying ship. Though Teba states that the song is for children, there are still occasional reports of Flying Ships. He also claims that the Blizzard has made tales of the Stormwind Ark seem more likely. Looking up at storm in the Hebra Sky, Teba voices his suspicion that there is something lurking in the clouds, but the Rito are unable to get close. As a result, he started to make preparations to enter the cloud, but Tulin believed the other Rito to be acting out of fear.
Teba moves away from this topic, asking Link what has brought him to Rito Village. He and Saki are shocked to hear the state of Hyrule Castle. While Teba is disturbed that Zelda's disappearance could be related to the Upheaval, all adult Rito are unable to contribute to the search due to the need to search for Food. Saki reveals that Teba has not been able to leave Rito Village often since becoming the elder, but Teba still wishes he could help somehow. Instead, Teba suggests that Link ask Harth for any information on Zelda. He claims Harth can be found at the Hebra Trailhead Lodge, which is located past the pair of Bonfires in the distance. Once their conversation ends, "Tulin of Rito Village" will begin.
At the Hebra Trailhead Lodge, Harth will be relieved to see Link is well and asks what happened to him. Upon hearing that Link is looking for Zelda, Harth admits that he has not heard any rumors about her whereabouts, since the Rito have been busy dealing with Aerocudas and the effects of the Blizzard. However, he believes that Tulin may be able to help him. Harth explains that Tulin was developed a technique, Tulin's Power of Wind, that allows him to patrol the skies even during the Blizzard. He claims that Tulin left for the Hebra South Summit Cave with Gesane and Laissa to look for Food. The Cave can be found by looking for the Bonfire in front of it.
Inside the entrance to the Hebra South Summit Cave, Link will find Laissa examining their supplies. She is surprised to see someone else braving the Blizzard, and she asks Link what he is doing here. She accepts that Link is looking for Tulin, revealing that he and Gesane went further into the Cave to scavenge. Laissa refuses to show Link how to find them, since she is watching over their current supplies. However, she does warn Link of the Cave's Bubbulfrog, wishing him luck in locating Tulin.
Near the Hebra South Summit Cave's exit, Link will encounter Gesane complaining about Tulin. He is annoyed that Tulin flew off without him, leaving all of their Food behind. When he notices Link, he is confused as to why a Hylian is so far into the Hebra Mountains during a Blizzard. Gesane reveals that a flock of Monsters passed by while they were scavenging, and instead of returning to Rito Village to report them with him, Tulin left to face them on his own. He points Link towards the Cedar Tree on Talonto Peak, claiming that Tulin will have followed the Monsters there. Gesane remarks that Tulin should not be taking as many risks as he does.

On Talonto Peak, Tulin will be angry that he let his guard down. As Link approaches him, Tulin will be shocked by his sudden appearance. When Link asks what happened, Tulin admits that his Swallow Bow was taken by one of the Aerocudas. He then asks Link to help him retrieve his Bow. If Link agrees, Tulin will be grateful. He reveals that he is capable of using his Power of Wind to blow a strong Wind, which he offers to use to help Link Glide to the Aerocuda. The Aerocuda can be found flying over a ruin nearby.
Once Link defeats the Aerocuda, Tulin will take his Swallow Bow back. He thanks Link for saving his Bow, since he may have lost it for good. A screech can then be heard in the distance, which scares Tulin. Three Aerocudas appear to drop off a group of Bokoblins. Tulin asserts that he will not be made a fool of again, and he invites Link to fight the Bokoblins alongside him.

After the Bokoblins have been slain, Tulin will celebrate their victory. He then realizes that the ruin they are standing on must have served as the Monsters' hideout. At that moment, Tulin and Link hear a voice, though they are unable to identify its source. Just then, someone calls out to them from the distance, and Harth and Gesane join then on the ruin. He commends their teamwork in fighting the Monsters, though Tulin is embarrassed to hear that Harth saw his Bow get stolen. He admits that he was wrong for not listening when Gesane tried to stop him, and if it were not for Link, he would not have been able to retrieve his Bow. Harth claims that his recklessness was the reason the other adults were treating him like a child. Looking towards Link, Tulin finally acknowledges it is better to work as a team instead of trying to do everything on his own.
Gesane believes there is more to the story, claiming it is unlike Tulin to allow his Bow to be taken. Tulin reveals that he saw Zelda being attacked by an Aerocuda, and while he was shocked, the Aerocuda was able to steal his Swallow Bow. Afterwards, Zelda ascended above the cloud. Though Harth is confused by Tulin's story, he informs Tulin that Link's goal is to find Zelda. He suggests that Tulin join Link in his investigation of the cloud.
Tulin reminds Harth that Teba forbade him from doing so, but Harth reveals that only Tulin is capable of approaching the cloud from above. Harth recalls Teba telling him that once Tulin learns the value of teamwork, he will become the finest Rito warrior. While Tulin is surprised to hear his father's words, Harth promises to tell Teba about his growth. Once again, Harth tells Tulin to join Link in the clouds, to which Tulin assures him that the two of them will accomplish their goal. Tulin informs Link that Zelda was on the Sky Islands above Hebra Peak, which is where they should begin their search. Harth informs them both that the Rito are counting on them.
At the ruin on Hebra Peak, Link and Tulin will encounter Huck, lamenting that it is impossible to find the source of the Blizzard. When he notices Tulin, Huck realizes he must have received permission to enter the cloud, which Tulin confirms. Huck reveals that he has thought Tulin's Power of Wind made him best suited for such a mission. Tulin thanks Huck for his kind words, assuring him that he will not be disappointed.

As Link and Tulin begin to travel through the Rising Island Chain, Tulin stops Link to tell him this is where he saw Princess Zelda, but he does not know where she went. When he spots the Flying Ship nearby, Tulin runs over to check it out. Upon seeing it up close, Tulin is able to confirm that it is a boat.
At that moment, Tulin hears the strange voice again, telling him to come to the cloud above. Although Tulin is confused about who is speaking to him, he notices that the cloud's Lightning allows him to see the silhouette of a huge boat inside. He also sees several smaller Flying Ships surrounding it, which reminds him of a verse from the "Song of the Stormwind Ark". He wonders if the song was true the whole time. Using both the voice calling to him and the search for Zelda as reasons, Tulin decides they should continue heading up towards the ship.

After entering the cloud from its top, Link and Tulin discover that the boat at the center is the Stormwind Ark, serving as the Wind Temple. Landing on its deck, Tulin is surprised that the Stormwind Ark is real. He then spots Zelda nearby, but when he tries to run over to her, a gust of Wind rages from below deck, causing him to lose sight of her. He takes this is proof of the Blizzard's source. He also realizes that he can no longer see the person from before. When Link interacts with the Wind Temple's Terminal, its Travel Point will become active. The gears surrounding the hatch at the center of the ship will lower themselves, with its nearest latch attempting to recede. However, the other five remain still, blocking it from doing so, and all of the gears raise back up. Tulin is disappointed that they were unable to open hatch, wondering if they can open it somehow.
The voice returns again, and it tells Tulin to use his Power of Wind to release the five locks throughout the ship in order to open the hatch. Now certain that he is hearing the voice, he decides to heed its instructions and unlock the hatch. When Tulin uses his Power of Wind on one of the windmill-shaped devices in the ship, it will deactivate one of the Locks. As more of the Locks are deactivated, Tulin will count how many are left. Once all of the Locks have been deactivated, Tulin directs him to open the hatch.

When Link opens the hatch, both he and Tulin are blown away by the strong Wind it was containing. After stabilizing themselves in the air, the two of them then dive back down towards the deck. Colgera rises from the now open hatch, and Tulin surmises it must be the cause of the Blizzard and resolves to defeat it. After Colgera has been slain, the cloud surrounding the Wind Temple will disappear. A Heart Container falls to the ground for Link, and the Ice at the center of the deck thaws, revealing a Secret Stone.
As Tulin looks upon the Secret Stone, it will suddenly shrink and move right in front of him. When he touches the Stone, light will overtake him and Link, and they find themselves in front of Raphica, the Sage of Wind. He refers to Tulin as his "brave fledgling", and Tulin recognizes him as the voice that has been speaking to him. Raphica reveals that he is Tulin's ancestor, serving as a Sage for Rauru, the first King of Hyrule. He is proud of Tulin's Power of Wind, believing it fitting for his descendant to master such a feat. Raphica then reveals that Colgera was summoned by the Demon King to prevent Tulin from obtaining the Secret Stone and awakening as a Sage. When Tulin expresses confusion over his words, Raphica decides to tell him the story of the Imprisoning War.
Raphica shows Tulin and Link a vision of himself, Rauru, and the other Sages facing Demon King Ganondorf in the distant past. They were assisted by the Secret Stones entrusted to them by Rauru. However, they were unable to defeat the Demon King, and so Rauru sacrificed himself to seal him.

Following the battle, the Sage of Time came to visit Raphica at the Wind Temple. She informed him that the magic binding Demon King Ganondorf would come undone, but a swordsman named Link will need the help of the Rito in order to defeat him. Raphica honored her request by assuring a new Rito Sage would awaken when the time came. Raphica warns Tulin that Ganondorf will soon restore his strength, and so Tulin must take the Secret Stone for himself and become the new Sage of Wind.
After Raphica disappears, Tulin becomes excited by the prospect of fighting alongside Link and saving the world. Tulin decides to accept his ancestor's legacy and become the new Sage of Wind. The Secret Stone in front of him turns green and becomes the Secret Stone of Wind, creating an anklet around Tulin's ankle to hang around. As the new Sage of Wind, Tulin shows off his Sage Avatar to Link. He asks Link to hold out his hand, which he then takes with a vow to fight by his side. He then gives Link the Vow of Tulin, Sage of Wind, allowing him to summon his Sage Avatar whenever he needs from his ring. With their mission complete, Tulin declares they should return to Rito Village to inform Teba.

Back in Rito Village, Teba watches as the Blizzard ends and all of the Snow in Rito Village disappears. Tulin and Link meet with Teba, Saki, and Harth on Revali's Landing. Harth celebrates the fact that they ended the Blizzard, which Tulin claims was easy once he started working with others. Teba is impressed by their work, while Saki and Tulin are still surprised that the Stormwind Ark is real. As a reward for ending the Blizzard, Teba gifts his Great Eagle Bow to Tulin. Tulin is shocked that his father would give him something that means so much to him, but Teba reveals he always planned to give it to him once he came of age as a warrior. Tulin takes the Great Eagle Bow and thanks Teba, promising to prove his worth to carry it.
Turning to Link, Tulin recalls that the woman in the vision that Raphica showed them resembled Princess Zelda. He wonders if it was actually Zelda that they saw, but he is confused as to how she could have appeared so long ago. He decides to continue looking into the individual they saw on the Stormwind Ark, promising he will have more information for Link the next time they see each other. He also reminds Link that his Vow means that the two of them will continue working together. Following their conversation, "Tulin of Rito Village" will be completed.
overview_zh:
Purah指示林克调查风暴带来的奇怪现象，寻找梅尔兹。他建议先去丽托村，据说那里有关于梅尔兹的传闻。

抵达丽托村后，遭遇猛烈的暴风雪。在雷维力的住所，特巴和萨基与图林争吵，图林坚持自己能处理暴风雪。
在图林的尝试中，他注意到林克并靠近，确认了，图林露出笑容并向他问好。
特巴和萨基都很高兴见到林克，但特巴也认为林克已经不在丽托村，注意他的身高，但他确实比上次见面时更高了。
图林说如果父母就放他长大即可，特巴则对林克来说无法让他自己生存，所以会尝试找机会证明自己的能力（探险）。
离开前，图林让其他人不要浪费时间，希望大家能把风暴发生的原因说明清楚，并询问了梅尔兹的下落。
在赫布拉起义站，哈特告诉林克梅尔兹可能和风暴有关。萨基透露，他们的村长已经不能经常离开村子了。
图林再次请求在云上寻找梅尔兹，但哈特也这样限制了他的行动。哈特提醒“他的父亲说，当他学会与他人合作时（即成为Rito战士）”，哈特也会将这句话告诉他。而哈特建议先去看一下Harth的信息，并告知他可能的地点
在赫布拉出发站，哈特和萨基对林克的情况感到惊讶，提到梅尔兹的失踪后会影响整个村子。
萨基透露自成为村长后的，图林很少离开村子，但图林还是希望自己能尝试做些什么。哈特建议先去赫布拉查看Harth的信息，并告知他可能的地点
赫布拉出发站

在赫布拉出发站，哈特将高兴地见到林克，并询问林克的情况。
听到梅尔兹的下落后，哈特也认为也许只有图林才能知道。
哈特解释了图林的"风之力量"，能帮助他在暴风中巡逻，他提到图林与盖桑和莱萨来到了南山峰的洞穴，查找食物。
在洞穴入口附近，他们可以看到莱莎正在整理他们的物资，她被林克出现的弄奇了一下，要求林克说一下自己是怎么来的。
他们透露图林正在去寻找食物
虽然莱莎会告知危险

在赫布拉南山峰洞穴出口附近，他们遇到发现了，哈特和萨基
哈特对梅尔兹的失踪感到担心，因为无法搜索食物
萨问得知了梅尔兹的事情后，认为可以询问Harth（关于赫布拉起义村）的信息。他提到了"Harth可以与在赫布拉出发站找到" 。他告诉他们可能的地点
哈特还说，只有图林才能进入云层

在赫布拉出发站
哈特告知他们可以找寻Harth找寻梅尔兹的线索，并告知地点

在赫布拉出发站
找到了Harth告知他们寻找梅尔兹，告知地点

在赫布拉出发站找到Harth告诉他关于梅尔兹的信息
并在Harth 告知那里可能的位置

回到赫布拉出发站
哈特再次告知林克和图林可以去找Harth找寻梅尔兹的线索，并告知地点
哈特再要求他们去寻找食物、帮助
哈特再次告知他们，只有Rito才能进入云

overview_en:
As part of the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quest, Purah asks Link to investigate strange happenings caused by the Upheaval throughout Hyrule in an effort to find Princess Zelda. After "Tulin of Rito Village" has been completed, she suggests Link visit Goron City next, since it is closest to their location at Lookout Landing.
In Goron City, Link will find that all of the adult Gorons focused on eating Marbled Rock Roasts, ignoring everything else. Bludo, Slergo, and Offrak are standing over Krane, disappointed that he has given into the temptation of Marbled Rock Roast. Slergo and Offrak realize that the Marbled Rock Roast mined by YunoboCo is the cause of the Gorons' altered behavior. However, their conversation is interrupted by Yunobo, who wonders what they are talking about.

As Yunobo approaches the group, the Weird Mask can be seen covering his part of his face. He notes that they are talking about Marbled Rock Roast, and while looking at Krane, he insists that there is nothing wrong with it. He then demands that Slergo and Offrak stand next to him, causing the two children to fearfully run to his side. Finally noticing Link, Yunobo aggressively asks what he wants.
Yunobo claims that since Link is so small, he did not see him at first. Bludo is angered by this statement, asking Yunobo how he could speak to a guest in such a way. Claiming that Bludo does not know his place, Yunobo asks Slergo who runs Goron City. When Slergo reveals that YunoboCo does, Yunobo then asks Offrak who is in charge of YunoboCo. Offrak states that Yunobo is, Yunobo claims that this proves Bludo is no longer needed in Goron City. While Bludo tries to argue in his favor, Yunobo cuts him off by asking Link why he has come to Goron City.
Upon hearing Link's story, Bludo is shocked to hear the Zelda is still missing. When Bludo mentions her blond hair, Slergo and Offrak state that Yunobo has been meeting with a blond-haired lady to discuss Marbled Rock Roast. Yunobo becomes panicked and orders the two of them to stop talking. Claiming that Goron City is peaceful, Yunobo refuses to help search for Zelda and tells Link to leave. When Yunobo decides to go meet with the woman, Bludo attempts to threaten him not to bring back more Marbled Rock Roasts, but he is interrupted by his back pain flaring up. Yunobo mocks Bludo, taking Slergo and Offrak with him to YunoboCo HQ. After the three of them roll off, "Yunobo of Goron City" will officially begin.
Near YunoboCo HQ, Link can find Slergo and Offrak standing in front of YunoboCo Storage. They recognize Link from their earlier encounter, revealing that Yunobo is currently speaking to the blond-haired woman and has barred entry to the Storage. The two children voice how upset they are with what has been happening, claiming that Yunobo turned mean after receiving the Weird Mask from the woman. Since Link is friends with Yunobo, Offrak states he will let him into the Storage if he promises to have Yunobo stop mining Marbled Rock Roasts. If Link agrees to try, Slergo and Offrak become excited by the prospect of Goron City returning to normal. If Link is not wearing any Flame-Resistant Equipment, they warn Link that the interior of YunoboCo Storage is a dangerous Scorching Climate.
Inside YunoboCo Storage, Link can find Yunobo talking with a woman resembling Zelda. Using his Power of Fire, he breaks a nearby Gloom Rock, causing several Marbled Rock Roasts to fall to the ground. Offrak and Slergo attempt to convince Yunobo to stop and take off the Weird Mask, While Yunobo is initially moved by their pleas, the woman says something, and Yunobo writhes in pain as the Weird Mask starts to glow. When he opens his eyes again, they will be glowing similar to those of Gorons under the effects of Marbled Rock Roast. He insists that the woman is right and that everyone who eats Marbled Rock Roast is happy. Yunobo then proceeds to attack Link.
After breaking the Weird Mask during their battle, the glow fades from Yunobo's eyes. Although Yunobo is confused, Slergo and Offrak happily run up to him. Yunobo claims that his memory is blurry from the time he put on the Weird Mask, and he wants to try to demand an explanation from Zelda. Yunobo spots her at the entrance to YunoboCo Storage, but a Gloom Rock cave-in blocks the way, forcing Yunobo to shelter Slergo and Offrak. After assuring Link, Slergo, and Offrak are uninjured, Yunobo hears a strange sound calling to him.
Slergo is shocked that the woman was Princess Zelda, and Yunobo insists he needs to talk to her about the Weird Mask and Marbled Rock Roast. Since the only way to break the Gloom Rocks is by using his Power of Fire, Yunobo asks Link to guide his charge. Once Link and Yunobo destroy the Gloom Rocks blocking the entrance, he takes Slergo and Offrak with him to search for Zelda.
Outside YunoboCo Storage, Yunobo looks around for Zelda but is unable to find her. Though he is initially shocked to see Gloom spouting from the top of Death Mountain, Slergo and Offrak remind him that he went to investigate it after the Upheaval began. Offrak then states that Yunobo came back from this trip wearing the Weird Mask. From their story, Yunobo is able to recall that he met Zelda at the Death Mountain Crater and received the Mask. Slergo wonders if Zelda lives inside Death Mountain, which makes Yunobo think they could potentially find her there. Yunobo declares that he is going to go look for her there, and he tells Slergo and Offrak to wait for him at Goron City. He then requests that Link join him in his search.
As Link and Yunobo approach the top of Death Mountain, Yunobo starts to guide him and rolls ahead. When Link catches up to Yunobo, he reveals that this is where he saw Princess Zelda, but he has trouble remembering what happened after he was given the Weird Mask. At that moment, Death Mountain begins to rumble, and the pair spot Zelda at the Crater's edge. Yunobo tries to convince her to turn back, but they lose sight of her as Gloom begins to rise from the ground. Following an eruption of Gloom, Moragia rises from the Crater. Yunobo is initially shocked by its appearance, but he asserts that they must defeat it to keep Zelda safe. However, he is unable to charge at it due to how high up it is and asks Link if he knows what to do.

Using a nearby Zonai Vehicle, which is constructed of a Wing, a Steering Stick, Fans, and Batteries, Link and Yunobo are able to take flight and approach Moragia's heads. When they are in range of one of the heads, Link is able to launch Yunobo towards it, causing it to crumble. Once all three heads have been defeated, the molten rock covering the Death Mountain Chasm will collapse. Noticing the Chasm nearby, Yunobo wonders if Princess Zelda could have fallen into the Depths. Worrying for her safety, Yunobo decides he and Link should go after her. Yunobo then jumps into the Chasm, assuring Zelda that they are on the way.
At the bottom of the Death Mountain Chasm, Link will find himself near the Mustis Lightroot in the Death Mountain Depths, which is surrounded by ancient ruins. Speaking to Yunobo, he is surprised that this is what the interior of Death Mountain looks like, noting how many Gloom Rocks there are. He then wonders why Zelda would be down here. Once again, Yunobo and Link hear the strange sound, and this time, they are able to discern a voice telling them to come to a structure in the distance. Since the voice may be related to Zelda's location, Yunobo decides that they should follow it.

When Link and Yunobo arrive at the structure, it is revealed that they have been traveling through Gorondia to reach the Fire Temple. As they approach, Yunobo wonders if this is the source of the voice and rolls ahead. When Link catches up with him, Yunobo asks why such a ruin is inside Death Mountain. Seeing Zelda near the Gloom Rock blocking the entrance, Yunobo attempts to reach her. However, by the time he runs up to the entrance, she will be gone. Inside the Fire Temple, Link and Yunobo find Zelda inside a locked chamber. However, the Gloom Rocks surrounding her suddenly rise up, trapping her against the ceiling. Upon seeing this, Yunobo declares that they must help her.
When Link uses the nearby Terminal, the Fire Temple's Travel Point will become active. The gate to the chamber will also attempt to open itself, but its five Locks prevent it from doing so. The voice then speaks to Yunobo and Link again, revaling that they must unlock the five Locks in order to access the chamber. Yunobo wonders who the voice could be and why they refer to him as "young, little rock." Ultimately, Yunobo decides they can trust the voice, since it told them how to move forward.
The Locks can be deactivated by using Yunobo's Power of Fire to hit the five corresponding Gongs. As Link and Yunobo unlock the Locks, Yunobo will keep track of how many are left. Once all of the Locks are undone, Link will be able to open the gate. Inside the innermost chamber of the Fire Temple, Yunobo tells Link to direct his Fire to destroy the Gloom Rocks on the ceiling and save Zelda. When he does, however, Zelda is nowhere to be seen. Instead, a large eye appears on the ceiling, and Marbled Gohma crashes to the floor below. Yunobo thinks that Zelda may be trapped inside the Boss. He states that they must save Zelda, and the battle will begin.
After defeating Marbled Gohma, a Heart Container will appear in the center of the room, and a Secret Stone descends from the ceiling. While Yunobo stares at the Secret Stone, it suddenly shrinks and zooms right in front of him. When he touches it, he and Link will be engulfed in light, and the Spirit of Agraston, the Sage of Fire appears before them, once again referring to Yunobo as a "little rock". Yunobo recognizes that he is the source of the voice that has been calling out to them. Agraston reveals that he is Yunobo's distant ancestor, and in the past, he served the first King of Hyrule Rauru as a Sage. He is impressed by Yunobo's practice of using his own body as a weapon, referring to him as the pride of the Gorons. Agraston then claims that Marbled Gohma was created by the Demon King Ganondorf in an attempt to prevent Yunobo from obtaining his Secret Stone.
At Yunobo's confusion, Agraston decides to show him a vision of the Imprisoning War. In the early days of Hyrule, the Demon King Ganondorf attempted to conquer the kingdom, but Rauru and the Six Sages joined together to face him. Rauru gave the Sages their Secret Stones to amplify their powers. Although they were unable to defeat the Demon King, Rauru sacrificed himself to seal him away. Following their battle, the Sage of Time came to visit Agraston at Gorondia. She predicted that the Demon King would one day break out of his prison and threaten Hyrule, but he would be stopped by Link. However, Link will need the help of the Gorons to face him, and so she asked Agraston to lend him his power. Upon hearing her request, Agraston realized what the duty of the Gorons would be, and he vowed that a new Sage of Fire would awaken when the time comes and fight alongside Link.

While Goron City has been saved, Agraston warns that the Demon King Ganondorf is still a threat. He instructs Yunobo to take his Secret Stone and become the new Sage of Fire. Agraston then disappears. Yunobo is initially hesitant to take the Secret Stone out of concern that he is not as great as the previous Sage. However, he realizes that it is his duty to help Link, and he accepts the Secret Stone. The Stone then turns red as an inscription appears upon it, becoming the Secret Stone of Fire. It affixes itself to Yunobo's belt.
Declaring himself as the new Sage of Fire, Yunobo shows off his new power to Link. He proceeds to summon his Sage Avatar, which uses his Power of Fire to charge around the chamber. Yunobo asks Link to hold out his fist, and with a fistbump, he makes the Vow of Yunobo, Sage of Fire. The Vow then inscribes itself on the thumb ring on Link's Right Arm, allowing him to summon Yunobo's Sage Avatar whenever he wants. Yunobo promises that he will be strong enough to stand by Link's side. With their business at the Fire Temple concluded, Yunobo decides that they should return to Goron City.
Back in Goron City, all of the Marbled Rock Roasts disintegrate and fade away, and the Gorons are freed from its control. Upon seeing this, Slergo and Offrak begin cheering and laughing together. When Link and Yunobo return, Bludo attempts to scold the latter for making him worry, but Slergo interrupts to defend him. Despite this, Yunobo takes responsibility that he was the cause of the Marbled Rock Roast problem. Slergo reminds Yunobo that he also returned Goron City to normal, and Offrak proclaims that he is a hero. Yunobo thanks the two of them for their kindness.
Yunobo also thanks Link for his part in getting rid of the Marbled Rock Roasts. He is concerned about what would have happened if Link did not break the Weird Mask. Slergo asks if Zelda was angry about that, at which point Yunobo reveals they were unable to find her. Upon recollection, he feels like she was deliberately walking toward Marbled Gohma. Offrak then wonders if the Zelda they saw was Marbled Gohma pretending to be her.
Although Yunobo considers this ridiculous at first, he recalls that in the vision shown to them by Agraston, the Sage of Time resembled Zelda. He is unsure how this could be Zelda, however, given how long ago Agraston lived. If it was her, however, he thinks that they could have been following the real Zelda. While he attempts to decipher it for himself, Yunobo only ends up becoming confused. He declares that the only way to know for certain is to ask Zelda themselves. Alternatively, if this is the final Main Quest that Link completes during "Regional Phenomena", Yunobo is confident that the Sage of Time was Zelda, meaning that the one they have seen in the present is an impostor. Either way, he pledges to have the YunoboCo workers join the Search for Princess Zelda by scouring the area around Goron City. At the end of their conversation, Yunobo declares that the two of them are connected no matter how far apart they are. Bludo then tells Yunobo not to dig up any more strange rocks, much to Yunobo's embarrassment. Should all of the other Main Quests related to "Regional Phenomena" be finished, Yunobo suggests that Link report his findings to Purah at Lookout Landing. Afterwards, "Yunobo of Goron City" will be completed.
overview_zh:
Link在普拉的指导下，调查了因“动荡”造成的神秘事件，以寻找梅尔兹公主。完成“鲁托村的图林”后，普拉建议他前往戈龙城，因为那里离他们的 Lookout Landing 位置最近。

在戈龙城，Link发现所有成年戈龙都专注于食用“纹理石”，而忽略其他一切。Bludo、Slergo 和 Offrak 围着 Krane，对 Krane 的诱惑感到失望。但他们意识到由 YunoboCo 开采的纹理石是导致戈龙行为异常的原因。之后，他们与 Yunobo 对话，被他的问题打断。

当 Yunobo 靠近时，能看到 Weird Mask 覆盖了他的部分脸部。他注意到他们在谈论纹理石，并且看著 Krane，他坚持认为这没什么。然后，他要求 Slergo 和 Offrak 站在他身边，这让两个孩子害怕地跑向他的身边。最后，Yunobo 迫切地问 Link 原来想做什么。

Yunobo 声称，由于 Link 很小，所以一开始没有看到他。Bludo 对此感到愤怒，询问 Yunobo是如何与客人说话的。但 Yunobo 以自己作为“Gorons 的人”为由回绝。然后，他询问 Slergo 是谁在管理 Goron City。当 Slergo 提到是 “YunoboCo”后，Yunobo 就询问 Offrak 在 yunoboCo 的角色是什么。Offrak 回答说就是 Yunobo，之后 yunobo 认为 Bludo 没有自己的责任。Bludo 则试图辩解，但Yunobo 再次打断他，问 Link 来 Goron City 的目的是什么。

在听到 Link 的解释后，Bludo 感动于梅尔兹公主仍然失踪的事实。当 Bludo 提到梅尔兹公主的金发时，Slergo 和 Offrak 声称 Yunoboco 与一位金发的女士见面讨论纹理石的味道。Yunobo 变得恐慌，要求他们停止谈论。说 Goron City 是平和的，Yunobo 不想帮助 Zelda，并让 Link 离开。“如果他决定去和这位女人会面后，”Bludo 试图威胁他说不要带回更多的“纹理石”，但他被打断了，因为他的身体疼痛开始复发。此时，Yunobo 开始嘲笑 Bludo。之后， Yunobo 带上 Slergo 和 Offrak 前往 Yunoboco总部。三个成功地躲开了，“Yunobo of Goron City”正式开始了。

在“YunoboCo HQ”附近，Link 发现了 Slergo 和 Offrak 立在 “YunoboCo Storage”前。他们认出了 Link 并透露，Yunobo 当前正在与那位金发女士见面，并且阻止他们在“Storage”（仓库）的入口。这两个孩子表达了对目前情况的不满，并声称，是因为Yunobo 拿到 Weird Mask 而变得很古怪。由于 Link 与 Yunobo 是朋友，Offrak 表示，如果他保证停止开采纹理石，就会让 Link 进入“Storage”（仓库）。如果 Link 答应的话，Slergo 和 Offrak 则对回到正常状态充满期待。如果 Link 没有佩戴任何防火装备，他们警告 Link，“YunoboCo Storage”内部环境非常危险。

在 “YunoboCo Storage”（仓库） 门前，Link 能够看到 Yunobo 正与一位梅尔兹公主貌的人说话。“Power of Fire”（用火焰的力量）释放，他破坏了一个 Gloom Rock（暗影岩），从而导致多个纹理石掉落在地上。Slergo

overview_en:
When Link first arrives in Zora's Domain, he finds that the Zora are recovering from a wave of Sludge the fell on them. Nearby, Yona can be found discussing the situation with Chroma and Khira. They reveal to her that they have run out of Splash Fruit while treating those affected by the Sludge and apologize. Yona insists that they do not need to apologize, and she is relieved that all of the Zora have survived thus far. However, she is disappointed that the Statue at the center of the Zora's Domain Square has remained covered in Sludge.
Turning to Link, Yona apologizes for not noticing him sooner. She explains that Zora's Domain is currently suffering due to the Sludge falling from the Sky, which has covered much of the Lanayru Great Spring. In particular, she is saddened by the Statue being obfuscated by Sludge, since it is important to the Zora. Although they are busy cleaning up, Yona encourages him to make himself at home. Afterwards, "The Sludge-Covered Statue" will begin.

Using Splash Fruit, Chuchu Jelly, or a Hydrant, Link can wash away the Sludge over the Statue, revealing The Turning Tide. When Link returns to Yona, she will be relieved that he was able to wash the Statue. She explains that The Turning Tide has become a symbol of hope for the Zora, depicting Sidon and Link himself. Chroma wishes to be able to meet Link one day, noticing that the individual in front of her resembles the one depicted on the Statue. After Link introduces himself, Chroma reacts with shock, which causes Khira to scold her. Yona and Chroma both apologize for their behavior. Yona claims that she has heard about him ever since she arrived at Zora's Domain, revealing that she is Sidon's fiancée. She expresses how honored she is to finally meet him.
After hearing that Link is searching for Princess Zelda, Yona invites him to investigate Zora's Domain as much as he needs to. She also requests that he visit Sidon, who can be found at Mipha Court. Before leaving with Chroma and Khira, Yona asks Link to meet with her when he has time. Following their conversation, "The Sludge-Covered Statue" will end, and "Sidon of the Zora" will begin.
overview_zh:
当林克首次抵达佐拉领域时，他发现佐拉们正在从一次泥浆袭击中恢复。附近，尤娜可以和克罗玛、希拉讨论此事。他们告诉她，在治疗受泥浆影响的人群时，他们已经用尽了“水花果”，并表示道歉。 尤娜坚持认为不需要道歉，并且松了一口气，目前所有佐拉都幸存。然而，她对位于佐拉领域广场中心的雕像被泥浆覆盖感到失望。

向林克道歉，尤娜说她本应该更早注意到他。 她解释说，由于天空中的泥浆侵袭，佐拉领域正遭受困扰，这使得兰伊鲁大池大部分区域都被泥浆覆盖。 特别是，她对雕像被泥浆覆盖感到难过，因为这对佐拉来说很重要。 尽管他们正在清理，但尤娜鼓励他好好休息。之后，“泥浆覆盖的雕像”将开始。

使用“水花果”、“朱朱果冻”，或水龙头，林克可以冲走雕像上的泥浆，露出“潮汐回流”。 当林克回到尤娜身边时，她很高兴能成功清理雕像。 尤娜解释说，“潮汐回流”已经成为佐拉的希望象征，描绘了西多姆和林克的形象。 克罗玛希望有一天能见到林克，注意到身前的人与雕像上的人物相似。“潮汐回流”将开始。

使用“水花果”、“朱朱果冻”，或水龙头，林克可以冲走雕像上的泥浆，露出“潮汐回流”。 当林克回到尤娜身边时，她很高兴能成功清理雕像。 尤娜解释说，“潮汐回流”已经成为佐拉的希望象征，描绘了西多姆和林克的形象。 克罗玛希望有一天能见到林克，注意到身前的人与雕像上的人物相似。“潮汐回流”将开始。

overview_en:
During the "Sidon of the Zora" Main Quest, Sidon suggests that Link meet with Jiahto, believing that his research may provide a clue to Zelda's location. At Toto Lake, Link can find Jiahto examining an ancient Stone Slate. He is impressed with the writing, stating that it must have been left by the ancient Zora. Due to the central piece's absence, however, he is unable to decipher the entire text.
Noticing Link's presence, Jiahto apologizes for not doing so sooner, and he proceeds to demonstrate his discovery to him. He explains that the Stone Slate's text appears to focus on the Sky, but he cannot completely translate it due to its broken state. Following their conversation, "The Broken Slate" will begin.
The Stone Slate's missing piece can be found lodged in a pile of Sludge nearby. After cleaning the Sludge with a Splash Fruit, a Chuchu Jelly, or a Hydrant, Link can use Ultrahand to lift the missing piece and return it to its place. Jiahto will be shocked, and he thanks Link for restoring the Stone Slate. Now able to read the entire Stone Slate, Jiahto relays that if an Arrow with the mark of the king is shot through a "droplet" on the land of the sky fish, it will reveal the resting spot of the Watery Bridge. Jiahto believes that these are instructions as to how to reach the Sky, though he is uncertain about what they mean. Jiahto suggests consulting with Dorephan about the "mark of the king", as he may have already returned from his investigation. At this point, "The Broken Slate" will be completed, and "Clues to the Sky" will begin.
overview_zh:
在主线任务“西顿的预言”中，西顿建议林克与贾托相会，认为他的研究可能提供与塞尔达位置相关的线索。在托托湖，林克可以找到贾托正在研究一块古代石板。他被上面记载的内容所吸引，表示这一定是古代佐拉留下的文字。但是，由于石板的主体缺失，他无法完全解读。

注意到林克的到来，贾托为未能提前告知道歉，并开始向林克展示他的发现。他解释说，石板上的文字似乎主要描述天空，但他因为石板损坏而无法完全翻译。在与贾托的交谈后，“损坏的石板”任务将启动。

石板丢失的部分可以被找到，位于附近的泥浆堆中。通过使用水果、墨水或喷泉洗净泥浆后，林克可以使用Ultrahand将其抬起并放回原位。“损坏的石板”的任务完成后，“通往天空的线索”任务将会开始。

overview_en:
At the end of "The Sludge-Covered Statue", Yona asks Link to meet her after he visits Sidon. Afterwards, he will be able to find her tending to her patients in the Sleeping Chamber, alongside Chroma and Khira. When Khira informs her that Link has arrived, she will be glad to see him.
Yona reveals that she wants to speak to him about his Zora Armor, which he previously left at Zora's Domain for repairs. While it is mostly complete, the last thing she needs is the scale of an Ancient Arowana. Since she does not know where to find one, Yona suggests asking Dento. She promises that she will be able to completely repair the Zora Armor if Link brings her one, reminding him that wearing it will allow him to Swim. After their conversation, "Restoring the Zora Armor" will begin.
When Link speaks to Dento, he reveals that they may be found near Mipha's Statue, which is located at Mipha Court on Ploymus Mountain. He wonders whether the return of Ancient Arowanas could be related to the Upheaval. Link can also find Ancient Arowanas in bodies of Water on Sky Islands.
Once Link has an Ancient Arowana, he can return to the Sleeping Chamber to give it to Yona. Now that she is able to repair the Zora Armor, Yona leaves for the Hammerhead. Upon her return, she claims to be honored to help restore the Armor. She then presents him with his Zora Armor.
Yona wishes Link well on his travels, and she reveals that although the Zora Armor will help him Swim up Waterfalls, it will not work in Water tainted by Sludge. She hopes that the Armor will be helpful to his search for Princess Zelda, after which "Restoring the Zora Armor" will be finished.
overview_zh:
在《被污泥覆盖的雕像》结尾，尤娜要求林克在她拜访西顿之后再见。 他随后可以在沉睡之室里找到她，与克罗马和基尔一同照顾病人。 当基尔告知尤娜林克已到时，她会很高兴见到他。
尤娜表示她想和他谈论他的水族盔甲， которую он ранее送到佐拉王国进行修理。 尽管盔甲已经基本完工，但她还需要一个古老的鳄鱼鳞片。 因为她不知道在哪里可以找到它，尤娜建议询问丹通。 她保证如果林克能给她一个，她就能完全修复水族盔甲，并提醒他穿上盔甲后可以游泳。 在他们谈话之后，“修复水族盔甲”将开始。
当林克与丹通交谈时，他透露他们可能在米普拉的雕像附近，该雕像位于普洛姆山上的米普拉法院。 他也怀疑古老的鳄鱼与“动荡”有关联。 林克还可以从天空岛的水域中找到古老的鳄鱼。
一旦林克拥有古老的鳄鱼，他可以回到沉睡之室交给尤娜。 现在尤娜能够修复水族盔甲，她离开了前往锤头镇。 在返回后，她表示荣幸能帮助修复盔甲，然后将盔甲交给了林克。

尤娜祝愿林克旅途顺利，并透露尽管水族盔甲可以让他在瀑布中游泳，但不能在受污泥污染的水中使用。 她希望盔甲能有助他找到塞尔达公主的寻找，之后“修复水族盔甲”也将完成。

overview_en:
During "The Broken Slate", Jiahto translates the ancient Slate for Link, which reveals that the Sky can be accessed by shooting the "mark of the king" through a "droplet" on the "land of the sky fish". Believing that Dorephan may soon return from his investigation, Jiahto suggests that Link consult with him. Following this statement, "Clues to the Sky" will begin.
When Link enters the Throne Room of Zora's Domain, he will find Tumbo, Keye, and Laruta reenacting what happened to Dorephan through play. According to them, Dorephan was injured while fighting a Sludge Monster, and he went to heal in a secret location. However, they refuse to keep playing when they notice Link nearby, so Tumbo tells him to leave.
By hiding in the Water of the Throne, Link is able to eavesdrop on the children's game. At first they attempt to continue playing, but Keye struggles playing both the Monster and Muzu. Laruta then wonders aloud what Dorephan's hiding spot is like. Tumbo recalls asking him about it once, and it was called the "pristine sanctummy." Since it is supposedly pristine, Keye reasons that the Water must be clean there.
Tumbo claims that clean Water flows between Ploymus Mountain and Zora's Domain, and he heard there is a secret entrance behind a Waterfall there. Laruta is impressed by the concept. Keye suddenly remembers that Muzu warned them not to tell anyone, but Tumbo insists that it is fine since no one is listening. He then decides that they should go through their game one more time, but Keye wants to play something else.

Link can enter the Pristine Sanctum from either Lulu Lake or Mikau Lake. Inside, he will find Muzu caring for Dorephan, who is suffering from the effects of Sludge. Though Muzu is initially hostile toward Link, Dorephan stops him, claiming his is only causing confusion. Dorephan greets Link and asks what has brought him to Zora's Domain, since he last heard that he and Zelda went missing. Despite Dorephan's shock, Muzu still refuses to believe Link, claiming he saw Zelda right after the Upheaval began.
Seeing no betrayal in Link's eyes, Dorephan declares that he is still an ally to them. After Hyrule Castle began to float, Dorephan and Muzu left Zora's Domain to investigate the Sludge, but they were caught off-guard by Zelda appearing from the Sky and ordering a sludge monster to attack them. Although Dorephan was able to defeat the Monster, he was injured, and he hid himself in the Pristine Sanctum to avoid word of Zelda's betrayal spreading. Noting how their story contradicts Link's, Dorephan states that they may find answers in the Sky.
Recalling that Jiahto was meant to be studying the ruins from the Sky, Dorephan wonders if he has found anything yet. When Link relays the writing on the Slate, Dorephan reveals that the "mark of the king" refers to one of his scales, though he does not know anything about the ritual in which it is used. Since Link is in need of it, Dorephan gives him five King's Scales, inviting him to take more if he runs out. Due to recent events, Dorephan considers whether it may be time to pass on his title as King of the Zora to Sidon. While this concerns Muzu, Dorephan puts off his decision until after the Sludge crisis has ended. He then asks Link to inform Sidon of both his condition and the King's Scale.
Link can reach Floating Scales Island by Swimming up its Waterfall while wearing the Zora Armor. Once there, he must look to the southwest, from where the floating rocks surrounding the Island appear to form a drop of Water. From this angle, Link can Fuse one of the King's Scale to an Arrow and shoot it through the droplet, which causes it to land in East Reservoir Lake. A green Pillar of Light will then rise up to the Sky, completing "Clues to the Sky".
overview_zh:
在《破碎的大理石》中，吉哈托向林克翻译了古代大理石的文字，揭示可以通过击穿“天空鱼”的地表上的“小水珠”，进入天空。吉哈托认为多雷凡很快就会返回，建议林克咨询他。随后，“通往天空的线索”将开始。

当林克进入索拉王座时，他会看到图姆波、凯耶和拉鲁塔正在通过游戏重演多雷凡的遭遇。他们说，多雷凡是在与泥浆怪战斗中受伤的，然后前往一个秘密地点寻求治疗。但当他们注意到林克在附近时，他们停止了玩耍，图姆波对林克发出了警告。

通过潜伏在王座之水里，林克可以偷听到孩子们的游戏。起初，他们试图继续玩，但凯耶在扮演怪物和木朱的过程中遇到了困难。拉鲁塔开始自言自语地询问多雷凡的藏身之处。图姆波回忆起他曾问过他，这个地方被称为“原始圣殿”。由于它被认为是原始的，凯耶认为这里的水应该是干净的。

图姆波声称，从普洛姆斯山到索拉王座的海水流淌着，并且他听说在瀑布后面有一个秘密入口。拉鲁塔对这个概念感到印象深刻。凯耶突然意识到木朱警告他们不要告诉任何人，但图姆波坚持认为这没有问题，因为没有人正在倾听。然后他决定再次进行一次游戏，但凯耶想玩一个不同的游戏。

林克可以通过位于露露湖或米考湖的“原始圣殿”进入。在里面，他会看到木朱照料着多雷凡，多雷凡正遭受泥浆的影响。起初，木朱对林克充满敌意，但多雷凡阻止了他，声称自己只是造成了混淆。多雷凡向林克问好，并询问他为何来到索拉王座，因为他上次听到他和塞尔达失踪了。尽管多雷凡感到震惊，但木朱仍然不相信林克，声称他在混乱开始后就看到了塞尔达。

看到林克眼中没有欺骗的迹象，多雷凡宣布自己仍然是他们的盟友。在海拉鲁城堡漂浮之后，多雷凡和木朱离开了索拉王座去调查泥浆，但他们却被塞尔达从天空突然出现并命令攻击给措手不及。虽然多雷凡成功地击败了怪物，但他受了伤，躲藏到“原始圣殿”中以避免塞尔达的背叛传开。注意到他们的故事与林克的陈述相矛盾，多雷凡认为他们在天空可能会找到答案。

回忆起吉哈托原本应该在天空的研究遗迹中工作，多雷凡猜测他是否已经发现了什么。当林克讲述大理石上的文字时，多雷凡透露，“国王的标记”是指他的一个鳞片，但他对使用它的仪式一无所知。既然林克需要它，多雷凡给了他五个国王之鳞，并邀请他在用完后再来获取。由于最近发生的事情，多雷凡开始考虑是否应该将自己的王冠称号传给西顿。虽然这让木朱感到担忧，但多雷凡推迟了这个决定，直到泥浆危机结束后。然后他要求林克向西顿告知他的情况和国王之鳞。

穿着索拉盔甲时，林克可以沿着位于浮动岛水中的瀑布游泳。到达后，他需要看向西南方，从那里，环绕在岛周边的漂浮岩石看起来像一个“小水珠”。从这个角度看，林克可以将其中一个国王之鳞与箭结合起来，然后射穿它，这会使其落在东储湖中。随后，一柱绿色的光明将升向天空，完成“通往天空的线索”。

overview_en:
As part of the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quest, Purah asks Link to investigate strange happenings throughout Hyrule as part of the search for Princess Zelda. After both "Tulin of Rito Village" and "Yunobo of Goron City" have been completed, she suggests visiting Zora's Domain next, since Monsters are more active in the south.
After Link cleans The Turning Tide during "The Sludge-Covered Statue", Yona asks why he has come to Zora's Domain. Upon hearing that he is searching for Zelda, she welcomes him to search for her in the Domain. She also suggests that Link visit Sidon, who is currently at Mipha Court on Ploymus Mountain. Once she leaves, "Sidon of the Zora" will begin.

At Mipha Court, Link can find Sidon using his Power of Water to separate the Sludge from the Water. When he notices Link, he gasps and asks if it is really him. Throwing his arms into the air, Sidon declares that it is good to see him. He reveals that he was concerned when he heard that Link was missing and asks what happened to him.
After hearing Link's story, Sidon voices his suspicions that the Sludge originates from the Sky Islands above the Lanayru Great Spring. As a result of this, he asked Jiahto to investigate the fallen ruins, since it is necessary for him to keep the Water clean from Sludge. Sidon suggests that Link visit with Jiahto at Toto Lake, believing that Zelda's disappearance may be related to the Sky Islands. He reminds Link that he is grateful to see him again after spending so long apart, welcoming him to come visit whenever he wants.
At Toto Lake, Link can start "The Broken Slate" Main Quest by speaking to Jiahto. After helping Jiahto restore the Stone Slate found there, he learns that he can access the Sky via a Watery Bridge, the location of which is revealed by shooting an Arrow with the "mark of the king" through a droplet in the "land of the sky fish." He suggests that Link consult with Dorephan, which starts the "Clues to the Sky". During this Main Quest, Link can find Dorephan in the Pristine Sanctum, where he reveals that he was attacked by a Sludge Monster commanded by Zelda. In order to prevent chaos from spreading among the Zora, he hid himself away in the Sanctum. He then informs Link that the "mark of the king" refers to a Zora King's Scale, which he willingly gives to him. Lastly, Dorephan requests that Link inform Sidon of both the King's Scale and his current condition.
Back at Mipha Court, Sidon is shocked to hear what happened to Dorephan, though he decides to listen when he says not to worry and thanks Link for telling him. Noting that they have more clues pointing them toward the Sky, Sidon decides that they should attempt to find the "land of the sky fish" mentioned on the Stone Slate. He then asks Link to inform him of any leads that he finds.
After completing "Clues to the Sky", a Pillar of Light will appear at East Reservoir Lake. Upon returning to Mipha Court, he will find Sidon speaking with Yona. He insists that it is too dangerous for her, but she claims that she has something to discuss with him. However, they stop their argument when Yona notices Link nearby, and Sidon asks for an update on his investigation. Hearing that they are one step closer to accessing the Sky, Sidon commends Link for his work. Yona suggests that Sidon join Link's search, claiming that he has been holding himself back. She believes that by joining Link, he will be able to act freely and overcome any dangers they face.

While Yona attempts to find the cause for his concerns, they are interrupted by the Sludge nearby beginning to move. The Sludge Like then appears, and Sidon wonders if it was the Monster that attacked Dorephan. Yona claims that she and her attendants, Chroma and Khira, are capable of cleansing the Water for now, so Sidon leaves it to them while he and Link fight the Sludge Like. Sidon offers to use his Power of Water to create a shield of Water around Link, which he can then attack the Monster.
Once the Sludge Like has been defeated, Sidon will celebrate their victory. He then turns to Yona, asking if she and her attendants are safe. Yona confirms that they are fine, and out of concern, Sidon tells them to return to Zora's Domain. Yona refuses, using the importance of Link's investigation as evidence that Sidon should accompany him. Although Sidon is uncomfortable about leaving her in a potentially dangerous location, Yona insists that they will be fine. Yona believes that he is acting this way because he is afraid of losing someone he loves again, but she claims that he needs to move forward with courage.
When Sidon once again attempts to argue, Yona becomes angry, telling him that he must follow his heart and leave with Link. Despite his hesitance, Yona is able to convince him to help Link. He decides to go on ahead to the Pillar of Light. Yona is relieved to see Sidon acting like his usual self, and she asks Link to take care of him.

 
At East Reservoir Lake, Link can find Sidon on a piece of rubble overlooking the Pillar of Light. At that moment, Link and Sidon hear a strange sound, and although Sidon is momentarily confused, he instead decides to focus on the Pillar of Light's origin. He suddenly has an idea and jumps into the Lake's Water. He uses his speed to create a Whirlpool, which reveals the entrance to a Cave on the lakebed. Sidon directs Link to jump into the Whirlpool.
The Whirlpool leads Link to the Ancient Zora Waterworks. By breaking the Hard Sediment clogging its pipes, Link can raise the Waterworks' Water level. This allows him to reach a Terminal on top of a large stone outcropping, which is the origin of the Pillar of Light. Once it is activated, a beam of light will shoot up towards Wellspring Island in the Sky, which causes the Watery Bridge to flow into East Reservoir Lake.
Back on the Surface, Sidon is shocked by the sudden appearance of the Watery Bridge. He asks Link what happened, and he realizes that this must be how they are meant to reach the Sky. He commends Link for living up to his expectations. Once again, a strange sound appears, and a voice beckoning them to the Sky can be heard. In spite of his confusion, Sidon decides to continue on to the Sky. Using the Zora Armor, Link is able to Swim up the Watery Bridge with him.
At the top of the Watery Bridge, Link will land on Wellspring Island, which is located within a low-Gravity environment. Nearby, he can find Sidon admiring the ruins. While he is curious, Sidon prioritizes dealing with the Sludge first. He decides that they should temporarily split up for their exploration and runs ahead.
By Swimming in Water Globules, Link is able to navigate Wellspring Island. Upon meeting with Sidon again, he remarks how light he feels in this environment. Due to their unfamiliar situation, Sidon decides to stay with Link. The pair then defeat a Captain Construct, which motivates Sidon to continue forward. At the bottom of a nearby Waterfall, Sidon is able to identify the ruins from which is flows as the source of the Sludge. He then tells Link to make sure he is prepared before they begin to explore.

Once Link confirms that he is ready, the pair will Swim up the Waterfall. Upon reaching the top, they will arrive at the Water Temple. Sidon is shocked that such a structure was above Zora's Domain. He then sees what he believes to be the origin of the Sludge. He also notices a stream of Water descending from one of the faucets behind the Sludge, which he thinks can be used on it.
By activating the Terminal, the Water Temple's Travel Point will activate, and the Water Vessels behind the Sludge will tip toward it. Though this causes the Sludge to temporarily recede, to amount of Water splashed on it is not enough. The voice speaks to Link and Sidon again, revealing that the Water Temple is the source of Zora's Domain's pure Water. She instructs Sidon to use his Power of Water to activate the remaining four faucets, which will fill all of the Water Vessels. Sidon decides that they should listen to the voice

If Link swings a Weapon at one of the Water Wheels while Sidon's Power of Water is active, it will begin to spin, which activates a faucet. As they activate faucets, Sidon will count down how many are left. Once all five faucets are flowing, Sidon directs him to activate the Terminal once more.
When the Water Vessels are tipped again, the Sludge will be successfully washed away, except for a glob that flies past Sidon and Link. Sidon is initially positive that they have saved Zora's Domain, but he becomes concerned when he notices the Sludge behind them moving. Mucktorok then reveals itself, and Sidon reasons that it must be the source of the Sludge. Once it creates a Sludge shark, Sidon tells Link to prepare for its attack.
Once Mucktorok has been defeated, the remaining Sludge will disappear from the Water Temple, including that which is covering a Secret Stone. A Heart Container also appears for Link. When Sidon approaches the Secret Stone, it will suddenly shrink in size and rush toward him. Though he stares at it for a moment, Sidon eventually touches it, which causes him and Link to be engulfed in light.

The pair find themselves in an unknown realm with the Spirit of Qia, the Sage of Water, standing before them. Sidon recognizes that her voice was the one guiding them, and she reveals that she is an ancestor of his from the ancient past. In her time, she was a Sage who served Rauru, the first King of Hyrule. Based on Sidon's fluid movements as he fights, Qia declares her pride for him. She claims that Mucktorok was a servant of the Demon King Ganondorf that was sent to prevent him from obtaining her Secret Stone. She decides that it is important he knows the history of the Imprisoning War.
Qia shows Link and Sidon a vision of Hyrule's earliest days. In this time, the Demon King Ganondorf appeared and attempted to destroy Hyrule. Rauru and the Six Sages gathered together to face him, and they were given Secret Stones to enhance their powers. However, they were unable to defeat the Demon King, so Rauru sacrificed himself to seal him away.
Following the Imprisoning War, the Sage of Time came to visit Qia at the Water Temple. She revealed that the Demon King Ganondorf will break from his seal in the distant future, but a swordsman named Link will fight him. The Sage of Time asks Qia to lend her control over Water to him, which makes the future of the Zora clear to her. She vowed that when the Demon King returned, a new Sage of Water would awaken among the Zora, and the Zora themselves will fight alongside Link.
Once the vision ends, Qia states that this involves the destiny of the Zora. Since the Demon King Ganondorf is still a threat, Qia asks Sidon to accept her Secret Stone and honor her vow. After Qia disappears, Sidon is silent for a moment as he considers his destiny. In order to save Hyrule, Sidon will decide to honor his ancestor's request. The Secret Stone then becomes a Secret Stone of Water, and it adheres itself to the back of Sidon's hand.
As the new Sage of Water, Sidon demonstrates his new power by summoning a Sage Avatar of himself. He then asks to take Link's hand, which he holds as he makes the Vow of Sidon, Sage of Water. As proof, his Vow will engrave itself upon a ring on the pointer finger of Link's Right Arm. This allows him to summon Sidon's Sage Avatar. Now that they are partners once more, Sidon decides that they should return to Zora's Domain.

Around the Lanayru Great Spring, all of the Sludge can be seen disappearing, including that which has afflicted Dorephan. In the Throne Room, Yona welcomes Link's return, and Sidon points out that all of the Sludge has disappeared. Dorephan expresses his gratitude toward Link for helping save Zora's Domain. He also acknowledges Sidon's role, declaring that now is the time to pass the Throne down to him. Although Sidon is shocked by how sudden it seems, Dorephan claims that he has been thinking about it for some time. He asks Sidon to lead Zora's Domain alongside Yona. Sidon is still uncertain, but after being reasured by Yona, he decides to accept his new status as the King of the Zora. Glad to see Sidon's acceptance, Dorephan decides that Link should bear witness to his coronation.

As the residents of Zora's Domain gather in the Square, Muzu calls for their attention. Wearing his crown, Sidon declares that he is the new King of the Zora. He asks his citizens to open their hearts to Yona, who has now become their Queen as well. The crowd cheers, and Yona commends Sidon, Link, and all of the Zora for surviving the onslaught of Sludge. Since Hyrule is still in danger, Sidon asks the Zora to help Link, which is what he and Yona plan on doing. At the end of their speech, the crowd cheers once more.
Returning to the Throne Room, Sidon recalls that the Sage of Time they saw in Qia's vision appeared to be Zelda. He then wonders who the Zelda who attacked Dorephan could have been. As a result, Sidon resolves to find the answer by asking her himself. Although he is unable to leave as the new King, Sidon decides to start gathering information on his own. He also requests that Link come visit Zora's Domain in the future, declaring that the two of the will always be connected. If "Sidon of the Zora" is the last Main Quest completed during "Regional Phenomena", Dorephan will suggest that Link return to Lookout Landing. Following this conversation, "Sidon of the Zora" will be completed.
