净化海域的“淤泥雕像”任务完成后，约娜询问林克来扎拉领域的原因。得知他正在寻找泽达后，她欢迎他到领域寻找。她还建议林克拜访西顿，他目前在普莱姆斯的Mipha法院。离开后，“索顿之子”将开始。

在Mipha法院，林克可以找到索顿，利用他的水之力分离淤泥和水。当他注意到林克时，他惊呼道是否真的是他？索顿大声宣布他是见到的。他透露得知林克失踪时感到担忧，并询问发生了什么事。

在得知 林克的故事后，索顿怀疑淤泥来自兰埃鲁大泉的上空天空岛。为了保持水的纯净，索顿建议林克与贾哈托在 Toto 河口会面，虽然这可能与天空岛有关联。他提醒林克，他很高兴再次见到他，热情邀请他来探望。

在Toto河口，林克可以开始为“堕落的石板”任务，与贾哈托交谈。之后帮助贾哈托恢复在那里发现的石头板后，他了解如何通过箭（带有王之标记）射入河中的水滴，找到通往天空的路。他建议林克去咨询多弗芬，开始“通往天空的路”。在任务中，林克可以找到多弗芬，他在纯净圣所里，他透露他被一个由泽达控制的淤泥怪物袭击了。为了防止混乱蔓延到扎拉，他躲了起来。之后，他向林克透露“王之标记”指的是一具扎拉国王的鳞片，并且他主动让林克得到它。最后多弗芬要求链接把国王的鳞片和他的现状告诉索顿。
回到Mipha法院，索顿听到关于多弗芬的事情，尽管他决定仔细听取，但还是欢迎了联系，并感谢了他的分享。注意到他们获得了更多的线索指向天空方向，索顿决定尝试找到“河中的鱼”，这与石板上描述的一致。他要求林克告诉他相关信息。
完成“通往天空的路"后，在东水库湖发现了光柱的入口。回到Mipa法院后，会发现索顿正在和约娜交谈。他坚持说这太危险了，但约娜表示她有事情与他商量。此时，约娜也注意到了林克，并要求了解他的调查情况。听到他们已经接近天空访问方法，索顿鼓励了林克的工作。约娜建议将索顿也加入搜索，认为他一直躲在边上。她相信，如果加入链接，他将会自由行动且能克服任何危险。
在这期间，由于约娜努力寻找问题所在时，一群靠近的淤泥开始移动。此时，一个淤泥怪物出现了，索顿并不知道他们是否被那只怪物控制。约娜确认可以由他和她的童伴 - chroma 和 kira 清理水域，因此索顿就让两人负责，然后他和链接对抗了这个淤泥怪物。索顿向林克提出了用他的水之力创建一个围绕他的保护，以此攻击这个怪物。
当淤泥被击败后，索顿庆祝了胜利。他转向约娜，询问她和她的童伴是否没事。约娜确认一切都好，于是担心地告诉索顿让她们回到扎拉领域。约娜拒绝，认为林克的探索对保护是必要的，并且索顿应该一同参与进入。尽管索顿对此有所顾虑，但約娜坚持说他们会做好准备，而且她相信他无法失去爱人。
索顿再次试图劝解，约娜就要求协助，并表示一定会支持他和链接。虽然仍有迟疑，约航还是最终同意了。他决定先行前往光柱。约娜松了一口气，看到索頓恢复了他的正常状态，并邀请链接和他们一起。

在东水库，林克可以找到索丹在他一个岩石上俯瞰着光柱的位置。这时，他们听到某种奇怪的声音。虽然索丹瞬间有些疑惑，但他还是决定将焦点集中于光柱的入口。突然，他有了主意并跳入湖中，利用速度创造了一个漩涡，从而打开了湖底的洞穴。索顿建议链接去寻找多弗芬，这会开启"通向天空之路"。在任务中，林克可以找到多弗芬在纯净圣所里，他透露他与泽达控制的一个淤泥怪物相遇。为了防止更多混乱蔓延到

overview_en:
During the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quest, Purah tasks Link with investigating strange occurrences throughout Hyrule in an effort to find Princess Zelda. After "Tulin of Rito Village", "Yunobo of Goron City", and "Sidon of the Zora" have all been completed, Purah will direct Link to visit Gerudo Town, since it is the only place he has yet to visit.
Past the Kara Kara Bazaar, the entire Gerudo Desert will be covered by a Sand Shroud. When Link arrives in Gerudo Town, he will find that the Gerudo have fled to the Gerudo Shelter after their First Encounter with the Gibdos. There are two ways that Link can access the Shelter, The first is by using Ascend while in the waterways beneath Gerudo Town, and the second is by jumping into the hole under the Desk in the Relationship Classroom. In either scenario, the Gerudo Soldiers Ploka and Merina will detect his presence and attempt to apprehend him.
However, the Gerudo Soldiers are stopped by Buliara, who informs them that he has received Riju's permission to enter both Gerudo Town and the Gerudo Shelter. She directs Ploka and Merina to inform all of those residing in the Shelter. After they leave, she reasons that Link must have an important reason to come visit during the Sand Shroud. She is shocked to hear that Zelda is still missing, though she is impressed that Link was able to make it to Gerudo Town through the Sand Shroud. She explains that after the Sand Shroud began, the Gibdos attacked the Gerudo and forced them to retreat to the Gerudo Shelter. As a result of this, the Gerudo are currently unable to assist in the search for Zelda. Buliara informs Link that Riju is currently training at the North Gerudo Ruins. Following their conversation, "Riju of Gerudo Town" will begin.

At the North Gerudo Ruins, Link can find Riju and her Sand Seal, Patricia. She is practicing her Power of Lightning on a Dummy, though she is unable to hit it directly. When she notices Link nearby, she sheathes her Scimitars of the Seven. Although she did not expect him to come, Riju remarks that he has a habit of showing up during strange circumstances. After hearing Link's story, Riju sympathizes with him and pledges to help as much as she can. However, she is unable to do so until she has dealt with the Sand Shroud, but her investigation has been halted by the appearance of Gibdos. Riju asks Link if he saw her practicing, and she explains her Power of Lightning could be effective against the Gibdos. Since she only learned it recently, though, she is still struggling to control it. Once she masters it, she will be able to end the Sand Shroud and help search for Zelda.
Riju asks Link to help her train by shooting an Arrow at the Dummy, which she believes can help her aim. Once he does so, she is able to successfully strike it with Lightning, and she decides to move on to a more difficult task. Turning to a set of three Dummies, she asks Link to shoot an Arrow between them so she can hit all of them at once. She warns him that the further away a target is, the longer it takes her to build up enough energy to hit it. After hitting these Dummies, Riju celebrates being able to use her Power of Lightning and declares that the Gibdos do not stand a chance against her.
Turning back to Link, Riju thanks him for his help. Suddenly, the two of them hear a strange noise, which leaves Riju confused. At that moment, Faundi arrives, informing Riju that a swarm of Gibdos are descending on Kara Kara Bazaar. Upon hearing this, Riju declares that she and Link should aid with the defenses. Afterwards, both she and Patricia will depart from the North Gerudo Ruins.
At Kara Kara Bazaar, Buliara can be seen commanding the Gerudo Soldiers as the Gibdos approach. She is concerned that they will not fare well without any help. Just then, Riju rushes by her, and she uses her Power of Lightning to strike down a pair of Gibdos. Riju apologizes for taking so long, and she rallies the Soldier to follow her into battle. She then asks Link not to let her down. During the battle, Riju notices that the Gibdos seem to be coming from a nearby Hive. She claims that they need to destroy it before they are overwhelmed by Gibdos.

After all the Gibdos are defeated and their Hive is destroyed, Riju commends Buliara for holding their defensive line. She claims that the Gibdos' weakness to Lightning puts them at an advantage. At the other side of Kara Kara Bazaar, Riju, Buliara, and Link and Riju notice a figure that appears to be Zelda. Suddenly, the ground begins to shake as three large tornadoes appear around Gerudo Town, which frightens Riju. Zelda then walks into the Sand Shroud, and although Riju calls out to her, she does not stop. Out of concern for Zelda, Riju commands that Buliara return to Gerudo Town with her. She informs Link that they will be leaving, telling him to meet her at Gerudo Town.
Link can find Riju and Buliara standing outside the Royal Palace of Gerudo Town. When he approaches them, Riju points out the Gibdo Hive near the North Gate, which supposedly appeared at the same time as the tornadoes. She also points out two more Hives, located outside the East Gate and the West Gate, and as a result, she believes a large-scale Gibdo attack is imminent. Since the Hives are invulnerable into they begin releasing Gibdos, the Gerudo have no choice but to wait until they strike. Once again, Riju hears a strange sound, this time accompanied by a voice beckoning her somewhere southwest of Gerudo Town. Riju is still confused, and Buliara asks if she and Link are well. Riju dismisses her concerns, deciding that she should focus on defending Gerudo Town for now. She then runs into the Royal Palace's Throne Room, where she sits on her Throne.
When Link follows Riju, she notes that no one has reported seeing Zelda after she was sighted at Kara Kara Bazaar. She instructs Link to speak with Buliara and the other Gerudo Soldiers to help organize Gerudo Town's defenses. During this time, Link is able to ask Buliara about their plan and the Gibdos. If he asks about their plan, she tells Link to discuss deploying their forces with Teake in the Barracks. He can also talk to Padda in the Palace Courtyard to take advantage of their supplies.
By talking to Teake, Link is able to place the Sword Troops, the Spear Troops, and the cannoneer Barta at either the North Gate, the East Gate, or the West Gate. If he approaches Padda, she will allow him to take the Materials and Weapons they have stored in the Palace Courtyard. She is also capable of building a single Barricade to defend one of Gerudo Town's gates. Once Link has finished preparing, he can return to Riju and inform her of this fact.
Back outside the Royal Palace, Riju admits that she is curious about the strange voice they heard, but their conversation is interrupted by Gibdos beginning to emerge from their Hives. Barta calls out to alert her fellow Gerudo Soldiers. Riju then insists that they will need to defeat the Gibdos before they can investigate the voice. Although Teake is concerned about their numbers, Riju assures the Gerudo Soldiers that this is their opportunity to defeat the Gibdos. Jumping in front of the Soldiers, she commands them to show the power of the Gerudo. Buliara also chimes in, stating that they should protect both Riju and Gerudo Town. At this point, the battle against the Gibdos will begin, and Link can use Riju's Power of Lightning to defeat them and destroy their Gibdo Hives.

Once the battle is over, the Gerudo will cheer to celebrate their victory over the Gibdos. Back in the Royal Palace's Throne Room, Riju thanks Link on behalf of the Gerudo for his assistance, and she shares her belief that the Gibdos may stop appearing around Gerudo Town. Since the Gibdo Hives turned to Sand after being destroyed, Riju wonders if the Gibdos share some connection to the Sand Shroud. Thinking back on the voice that they heard, Riju is reminded of the Mural in the Underground Shelter, and she asks Link to come view it with her.
In the Gerudo Shelter, Riju points out the Mural in the Underground Shelter to him. She believes it was painted by ancient Gerudo when they were also hiding in the Shelter. The Mural states, "Standing back-to-back with the throne, witness red pillars across a vast sea. Unite the pillars in light to reveal the lightning stone and open the way. You who can hear my voice, come to me. I await you." Riju recalls that the voice mentioned something similar, and she thinks that the Mural could be a clue to finding it.
While standing behind Riju's Throne, Link is able to see the remains of a Red Pillar in the distance. By smashing the rocks covering its floor, Link reveals a Light Beam, which reflects off of a Mirror and shoots into the distance. By following the beam, he will find another Red Pillar, and by turning its Mirror, he will be able to reflect the Light Beam further into the distance. At the third Red Pillar, he must reattach the Poles to the Mirror's lever, which allows him to direct the Light Beam back toward the first Pillar. Once all three Red Pillars are connected by the Light Beam, a Battery will rise at their exact center.
When Link arrives at the Battery, he will find a figure resembling Zelda standing in front of it. Before he can approach her, he is interrupted by Riju Surfing in on Patricia. She points out Zelda to him, but when they look back at the Battery, she is gone. Riju explains that after seeing the Light Beams, she hurried to their center as quickly as she could. Though she feels like seeing Zelda twice is relevant, she dismisses it as a mystery for later. She is impressed that Link was able to solve the Mural in the Underground Shelter's riddle, and she wonders if using her Power of Lightning is the next step.

After Link shoots an Arrow at the Battery, the Lightning Temple will emerge from beneath the Sand of Dragon's Exile. When Link uses Riju's Power of Lightning to destroy the Gibdo Hive-like structure over its entrance, Queen Gibdo will appear from inside. As it uses its wings to kick up Sand, Riju determines that it is the source of the Sand Shroud. She then rallies Link to defeat it alongside her. Partway through the fight, Queen Gibdo will retreat to the top of the Lightning Temple. Riju states that they may be able to reach it by traversing the Temple.
While walking through the Lightning Temple, Link and Riju eventually reach the Room of Ascension, where Riju states that they must be where the Mural in the Underground Shelter was trying to guide them, and she is certain they will find the origin of the voice they have heard. When Link activates the Terminal in the center of the Room, the Temple's Travel Point will glow. The platform they are standing on also starts to rise, but it only floats a few feet before falling back down. The voice then speaks to Riju again, explaining that she can use her Power of Lightning to charge the platform's four Batteries and reach the top of the Temple. Riju decides that they should follow the voice's instructions.

By using Riju's Power of Lightning on the Lightning stone, Link can charge the Batteries for the platform. As the Batteries are charged, Riju will count how many are left. After all of the Batteries are charged, Riju instructs Link to return to the center platform. When Link activates the Terminal this time, he and Riju will be lifted to the Lightning Temple 7F. Upon their arrival, Riju notices the glow of a Secret Stone nearby. When Riju's Power of Lightning is used on the Gibdo Hive-like structure in the room, Queen Gibdo will reappear and attack them one more. Riju then declares that this is their chance to defeat it.

Once Queen Gibdo is defeated, a Heart Container will appear. The Sand structure blocking the Secret Stone will also crumble. As Link approaches Riju, the Secret Stone will suddenly shrink and rush before her. When she touches it, it will begin to glow, and a bright light will overtake both her and Link. The Spirit of Ardi, the Sage of Lightning, appears before them, and Riju recognizes her as the voice that has been calling out to them. She identifies herself as Riju's distant ancestor, revealing that she was a Sage who served the first King of Hyrule, Rauru. Ardi expresses her pride for Riju using her Power of Lightning to defend the Gerudo. She reveals that the Demon King Ganondorf sent Queen Gibdo to stop Riju from obtaining her Secret Stone. Upon hearing Riju's confusion, Ardi proceeds to show them a vision of the Imprisoning War.
In the early days of Hyrule, the Chief of the Gerudo transformed in the Demon King Ganondorf and sought to destroy the kingdom. Rauru and the Six Sages fought the Demon King using Secret Stones, which amplified their abilities. However, they were unable to defeat him, and so Rauru sacrificed himself to seal the Demon King away.
Following the battle, the Sage of Time visited Ardi at the Lightning Temple. She revealed that the Demon King Ganondorf would one day break free from his restraints, but when that happens, a swordsman named Link will oppose him. She asked Ardi to lend her power to him. As a result, Ardi swore that her successor would awaken to fight the Demon King with Link, claiming that the Gerudo must make amends for bringing him into the world.
As the vision ends, Ardi reveals that the Demon King Ganondorf is still a threat to Hyrule. She asks Riju to take up her Secret Stone, inherit the title of Sage of Lightning, and fight alongside Link. At that moment, Ardi will disappear, and Link and Riju will be returned to the Lightning Temple. Upon reflecting on her new responsibilities, Riju declares that they sound like fun. She accepts her role as a Sage.

The Secret Stone becomes a Secret Stone of Lightning, turning orange as an inscription appears upon it. It then attaches itself to Riju via an Earring. Declaring herself the new Sage of Lightning, Riju shows off her new ability to summon a Sage Avatar of herself. She tells Link to give her his hand, at which point she makes the Vow of Riju, Sage of Lightning. As proof, her Vow inscribes itself on the ring finger of his Right Arm, allowing him to summon her Sage Avatar whenever he needs. Now able to repay Link for all the help he has given her, Riju asks if he wants to return to Gerudo Town.
As the Sand Shroud disappears, Dalia, Kalani, Pearle, Nali, and Pritana can all be seen exiting the Gerudo Shelter. In the Royal Palace's Throne Room, Buliara smiles to herself as she looks toward the Lightning Temple. Upon their return, Riju thanks Link for his assistance, claiming that reports of Gibdo attacks have almost entirely ceased. Although it will take time to rebuild, Buliara is grateful that the Gerudo can live aboveground once again. All of the Gerudo Soldiers in the Royal Palace's Throne Room proceed to bow to Link.
Despite Gerudo Town being safe, Buliara notes that they have found no information about Zelda. Riju then informs her that in the vision she and Link saw, the Sage of Time appeared to be Zelda. If that was Zelda, Riju then wonders who the individual resembling her in the present could be. Though Riju is hesitant to leave Gerudo Town currently, she promises to search the area as part of the Search for Princess Zelda. She also swears to support him with her Sage powers. If "Riju of Gerudo Town" is the last Main Quest completed during "Regional Phenomena", Buliara will then direct him to report back to Lookout Landing. Riju hopes that Link will visit again in the future. Afterwards, "Riju of Gerudo Town" will be completed.
overview_zh:
1. 在“区域现象”主线任务中，普拉的任务是让林克调查赫鲁尔各地的奇怪事件，以寻找公主塞尔达。在完成“图林（利托村）”、“尤诺波（戈隆城）”和“西顿（祖拉）”之后，普拉将引导林克前往格鲁多镇，因为这是他尚未访问的地方。
2. 穿过卡拉卡集市后，整个格鲁多沙漠将被沙雾覆盖。当林克到达格鲁多镇时，他会发现格鲁多人已逃往格鲁多避难所，这是他们第一次遭遇吉德后的。 林克可以通过两种方式进入避难所：一是利用在格鲁多镇的水下通道“上升”；二是跳入王座下的洞穴（关系课堂）的孔中。无论哪种方式，格鲁多的士兵普洛卡和梅丽娜都会察觉到他的存在并试图逮捕他。
3. 然而，格鲁多的士兵被布露拉阻止，她告知他们已经获得了瑞朱允许进入格鲁多镇和格鲁多避难所。 她指示普洛卡和梅丽娜去通知躲在避难所里的所有人。 在离开后， 布露拉认为林克必须有充分的理由前来探望。 她对塞尔达仍然失踪感到震惊，但对林克能够通过沙雾到达格鲁多镇表示赞赏。 她解释说，沙雾出现后，吉德袭击了格鲁度人，迫使他们逃往格鲁多避难所。 因此，格鲁度人在目前无法协助寻找塞尔达。 布露拉告知林克瑞朱正在北格鲁度遗迹进行训练。 随后会开始“瑞朱（格鲁度城）”任务。
4. 在北格鲁度遗迹中，林克可以找到瑞朱和她的沙鼠帕特里卡。她正在练习雷之力量，但无法直接击中它。 当她注意到林克在附近时， 她会将手中的剑收起。 尽管她没有预料到林克的到来，但瑞朱表示他总是出现在奇怪的时期。 听到林克的故事后， 瑞朱表示会尽一切努力帮助他。 然而， 她不能直到解决沙雾问题。 但她的调查已因吉德的出现而中断。 瑞朱询问林克是否看到了她练习雷之力量， 并且这种力量对吉德有效。 因为她最近才学会了这个技能，但此时她仍在努力控制它。 一旦她掌握了这项技能， 就可以结束沙雾并协助寻找塞尔达。

overview_en:
During the "Find the Fifth Sage" Main Quest, Purah asks Link to search for clues as to the remaining Sage's whereabouts among ruins from the ancient past. In Kakariko Village, he can find Paya and Tauro looking up at the Floating Ring Ruin. Upon hearing that the Zelda who ordered them to stop was actually a Phantom Ganon, they are initially shocked, though Paya recalls that she seemed different than the real Zelda. Tauro realizes that the Floating Ring Ruin may be a threat to Demon King Ganondorf, and he decides that they should investigate as soon as possible.
Paya agrees with Tauro, giving him permission to open the Floating Ring Ruin. Tauro is so excited that he begins using phrasing from Lurelin Village, which Paya notes. However, Tauro does not know how to access the Ring Ruin. Despite the Floating Ring Ruin being hollow, there is no entrance leading to its interior. As is the case with the other Ring Ruins, he believes that there could be a Ring Ruins Stone Slab with Zonai writing inside. First, he wants to confirm the existence of the Stone Slab, though he decides to inform the other members of the Zonai Survey Team. Afterwards, "Secret of the Ring Ruins" will begin.
Using Ascend, Link is able to enter the Floating Ring Ruin and take a Picture of the Ring Ruins Stone Slab inside. Tauro will be confused having seen this, though he believes he imagined it. When Link shows his Picture to Tauro, he is shocked, calling over Paya and Calip to see it. As they examine the Picture, Tauro is able to decipher the words "Mineru" and southeast. Calip notes that Mineru could be the name of a Sage  
Although Tauro is excited, he notices that Paya appears to be thinking. She is able to translate more of the Zonai writing, referring to a Dragon land in the southeast. Once Tauro confirms it, she attributes her knowledge to studying the Zonai language. Fearing Paya is upstaging him, Calip points out that the Ring Ruins Stone Slab could be referring to the Zonai Ruins. Tauro praises Calip for this, which he appreciates. Looking back on what they have learned, Tauro determines that they can find out more by visiting the Zonai Ruins. He asks Calip to accompany him, which he agrees to. They plan to established their base camp near the Popla Foothills Skyview Tower. Tauro and Calip then depart for Faron.
At the Popla Foothills Skyview Tower, Link can find Calip near a makeshift Tent. He welcomes Link to his base, revealing that Tauro has already left to see the Zonai Ruins near Dracozu Lake. If it is daytime, Calip expresses his hope to find more clues, though he claims he needs to rest before joining Tauro. At night, Calip is worried that Tauro has yet to return, wondering if he is caught up in his investigation.

Among the Zonai Ruins, Link can find a Note on the Table written by Tauro, telling Calip to meet him inside a room revealed by rubble falling away. There, he encounters Tauro, who is examining a Zonai mural. He is happy to see Link, and he reveals that he has made a huge discovery. Tauro directs his attention to the mural, which he thinks may have been preserved due to Zonai Technology. He has been able to decipher some of the Zonai writing as well, which states to wear the "electric garb" found along the "forest serpent". This reminds Tauro of a Song that referred to the Dracozu River as a forest Dragon. Continuing his translation, Tauro states that a Zonai Charge must be offered to an Altar located at a "tail," and he believes that he can make more discoveries by uncovering the meaning behind this riddle. Tauro also points out a Treasure Chest in the room, which he has been unable to open.
Using his Right Arm, Link is able to open the nearby Treasure Chest and receive the Charged Shirt. He can also find two similar rooms that are marked by Tall Dragon Pillars, within which he can find Treasure Chests containing the Charged Headdress and the Charged Trousers. Near the southwestern end of the Dracozu River, Link comes across one last room marked by a Tall Dragon Pillar. When he holds and drops a Zonai Charge or Large Zonai Charge on the Altar inside while wearing the entire Charged Set, the eyes of the Tall Dragon Pillars will begin to glow and their horns start to spark. All of them are simultaneously stuck by Lightning, and as the Sky above them clears, the Thunderhead Isles and Dragonhead Island will be revealed.
Drawn by the Lightning, Tauro and Calip arrive at the Altar. They are shocked to find Link inside, though Calip is relieved that he is unharmed. Tauro asks Link if he knows what happened. He is impressed by Link's findings, though Calip laments that they are unable to visit the Sky Islands themselves. Since he needs to make a report to Purah, Tauro leaves Calip in charge of investigating the Zonai Ruins further. Though Calip is hesitant at first, Tauro's assurances convince him to stay.
When Link reaches Dragonhead Island, he can find an interior chamber blocked by a Challenge Door. In order to open it, he needs at least 10 Hearts. Inside the chamber is the Zonai Relic, and when interacted with, he will hear the voice of Mineru telling him to follow the beam of light it emits. At this point, "Secret of the Ring Ruins" will be finished, and "Guidance from Ages Past will begin.
overview_zh:
露帕要求林克在“寻找到第五位智者”主线任务中，寻找古代遗迹中的线索，以确认剩余智者的下落。在卡卡里科村，他可以找到佩亚和塔鲁，他们正在凝视着漂浮的戒指遗迹。当得知派由莉命令他们停止时，他们最初感到震惊，但佩亚回忆说她与真正的露帕不同。塔鲁意识到漂浮的戒指遗迹可能对甘多夫国王构成威胁，因此他决定尽快调查。

佩亚同意塔鲁的要求，让他打开漂浮的戒指遗迹。塔鲁非常兴奋，开始使用萝勒林村的用语，这让佩亚注意到了。然而，塔鲁不知道如何进入戒指遗迹。尽管漂浮的戒指遗迹是空的，但没有通往其内部的入口。与其他的戒指遗迹一样，他认为里面应该有一个带著宗派文字的戒指遗迹石板。首先，他想确认石板的存在，但他决定告知其他宗派调查小组的成员。之后，“戒指遗迹之秘密”将开始。

使用“升天术”，链接进入了漂浮的戒指遗迹并拍摄了戒指遗迹石板的照片。塔鲁看到后感到困惑，但认为自己只是在做梦。当链接向塔鲁展示照片时，他非常震惊，并叫来佩亚和卡利普查看。当他们仔细观察照片时，塔鲁能够解读出“米内尔”和南东方向这两个词。佩亚注意到“米内尔”可能是一个智者的姓名。虽然塔鲁很兴奋，但他注意到佩亚似乎在思考。佩亚可以翻译更多宗派文字，提到东南方向有一个龙族的所在。当塔鲁确认后，佩亚将她的知识归因于研究宗派语言。担心佩亚会抢了他的风头，卡利普指出戒指遗迹石板可能指的是宗派遗迹。塔鲁赞扬了卡利普，他非常感激。回顾他们所学，塔鲁决定可以进一步了解的情况是通过前往宗派遗迹来探索。他请卡利普陪伴他前往，卡利普同意了。他们计划在波普拉山脚 Skyview 塔附近建立营地。塔鲁和卡利普随后前往法隆。

在波普拉山脚 Skyview 塔上，链接可以找到卡利普，他在一个临时搭建的帐篷附近。他欢迎链接的到来，透露塔鲁已经去到了 Dracozu 湖附近的宗派遗迹。如果白天，卡利普表示希望发现更多的线索，但他声称需要先休息再与塔鲁会面。在夜晚，卡利普担心塔鲁没有回来，并猜测他可能被困在了调查中。

在宗派遗迹中，链接可以找到塔鲁在一张桌子上写的笔记，告诉卡利普在他房间里见面。在那里，他遇到了塔鲁，塔鲁正在研究宗派壁画。他也很高兴见到链接，并且透露他做出了一个巨大的发现。塔鲁将注意力吸引到了壁画上，认为它可能因为宗派科技的原因得以保存。他已经能够解读一些宗派文字，其中有一句是“戴上森林巨蟒" 所用的 "电力装备"。这让塔鲁联想到关于 Dracozu 河被视为森林龙的诗歌。继续翻译的时候，塔鲁 称宗派需要向一个祭坛提供 "充电"，他认为通过了解这个谜语，他们可以发现更多的线索。塔鲁还指出了房间里的一个宝箱，但他无法打开。

使用“右臂”，链接能够打开附近的宝箱并获得"电力的衣物"。他还找到了两个带有高耸龙柱的房间，其中每个房间都包含有一个宝箱，里面装有 "电力帽子" 和 "电力长裤"。在 Dracozu 河的西南端，链接发现了最后一个标记着高耸龙柱的房间。当他对着祭坛里放置 "电力的充电" 或 "大宗派 充电"，并戴上套装时，祭坛里的眼睛和角开始发出光芒和颤动。所有这些都同时被闪电击中，当天空上的雷云消散后，Thunderhead Isles 和 Dragonhead Island 将会被显现出来。

受到闪电的吸引，塔鲁和卡利普来到了祭坛。他们震惊地发现链接就在那里，虽然卡利普欣慰地看到他没有受伤。塔鲁询问链接发生了什么事。他对链接的发现感到印象深刻，但卡利普遗憾地说他们无法亲自访问天空岛。既然他需要向露帕报告，塔鲁让卡利普负责进一步调查宗派遗迹。尽管卡利普一开始有些犹豫，但他被塔鲁的建议说服了。

当链接到达 Dragonhead 岛时，他发现了一个被挑战门阻挡的内部房间。为了打开门，他需要至少有10个生命值。在房间里是 "宗派文物"，通过与它互动后，他会听到 "米内尔" 的声音，告诉他跟随光束所指的方向。此时，“戒指遗迹之秘密”将完成，"曾经的启示开始"。

overview_en:
When Link interacts with the Zonai Relic on Dragonhead Island, he hears the voice of Mineru, who tells him to take it and follow the beam of light it emits. By doing so, he will complete the "Secret of the Ring Ruins" Main Quest and start "Guidance from Ages Past".
In Tobio's Hollow, Link is lead toward a large owl statue with a pedestal in front of it. When he brings the Zonai Relic to the pedestal, the owl statue will raise, revealing the entrance to the Tobio's Hollow Chasm. The Zonai Relic then shoots another beam of light toward the pedestal at its center. Placing the Zonai Relic on the pedestal causes the surrounding platform to descend into the Depths. As they move, Mineru speaks to Link again, urging him to meet with her as soon as possible.
The platform lands in front of the Construct Factory, and the Zonai Relic shoots a final beam of light toward the mold at its entrance. Using Ultrahand, he can place the Relic into the head slot. When he does so, Mineru formally introduces herself to him as the Sage of Spirit. She reveals that she has lost her original body and is therefore unable to speak with him in person. In order to create a new body for herself, she asks Link to retrieve parts from the Left-Arm Depot, the Left-Leg Depot, the Right-Arm Depot, and the Right-Leg Depot.
As Link places the parts into the mold, Mineru will count how many are left. After Link assembles Mineru's Construct, it will activate itself and emerge from the mold. Mineru thanks Link, revealing that they now must recover her Secret Stone. Opening the Map, Mineru points Link towards its location and asks him to accompany her. Due to the danger of their journey, she tells Link to use a nearby platform to explore the uses of the Construct. She beckons Link to hurry.
When they reach the Spirit Temple, Mineru's Construct is unable to pass crumbled stairs. By Fusing a Rocket from the nearby Supply Site to the Construct, Link is able to bring it to the Temple's entrance. When they approach the statue at its center, Mineru's Construct fires a beam at it, which activates the nearby Travel Point and causes the platform they are standing on to descend.

The Secret Stone of Spirit can be seen across a stretch of Gloom, requiring Link to ride Mineru's Construct in order to reach it it. However, they are stopped by Electric fences rising from the ground, and the Seized Construct appears. Mineru recognizes it as her own creation, but she is able to tell it is being controlled. Since it is being controlled by Demon King Ganondorf, Mineru declares that they must defeat the Construct.
Once the Seized Construct has been defeated, the Gloom inside the Spirit Temple will dissipate and the fences will drop. A Heart Container will also appear for Link. As Link examines the Secret Stone of Spirit, his Purah Pad will suddenly begin to glow. Mineru's Spirit emerges from the Pad and enters the Secret Stone, which shrinks and embeds itself into her Construct. A purple light then engulfs Link.

When the light fades, Link can see Mineru standing in front of him. Once again, she introduces herself to him, this time revealing that she is a Zonai. She expresses her happiness to finally meet Link, thanking him for helping recover her Secret Stone. Mineru reveals that she originally planned to contact him when he first acquired the Purah Pad and take over the Seized Construct, but she did not realize they would have to fight it instead. Expressing her gratitude, she asks Link to give her his hand. Once he does so, she makes the Vow of Mineru, Sage of Spirit, which engraves itself on the middle finger of his Right Arm. She claims that this has formed a bond between her and Link, swearing to help him however she can.
Returning to reality, Mineru continues to speak to Link from her Construct. She reveals that she lived through the founding of Hyrule, and during that time, she lost her body and became a Spirit. Since then, she waited in the Purah Pad for Link to awaken her, and she blames Demon King Ganondorf for delaying their meeting. In her era, Zelda appeared after awakening as the Sage of Time, and she was involved in a tragedy. She decides to tell Link about Zelda's resolve, which starts "The Imprisoning War" Memory.
Although Demon King Ganondorf was sealed during the Imprisoning War, Mineru reveals that she was injured and would soon die. In that time, Zelda came to her with the Decayed Master Sword, which is where it went after it disappeared from the Temple of Time. This starts the "Critical Decisions" Memory.
Following Mineru's meeting with Zelda, the two of them began to prepare to guide Link in the future, which involved Mineru residing in the Purah Pad as a Spirit. Using a forbidden process, Zelda was able to restore the Master Sword, which Link must use to defeat Demon King Ganondorf. Mineru believes that the restored Master Sword can be found somewhere in Hyrule, and she tells Link to see out the Great Deku Tree to find it. She then urges Link to continue his journey to defeat Demon King Ganondorf. Afterwards, "Guidance from Ages Past" will be completed, and "Trail of the Master Sword" will begin.
overview_zh:
链接在龙头岛与佐奈遗物互动后，听到米纳的呼唤，告知他拿走并跟随光束。完成“圣物的废墟”主线任务，开启“来自过去的指引”。

在托比奥的小洞穴中，链接被引导到一只巨大的猫头鹰雕像前。将佐奈遗物放在底座上，雕像抬起，露出托比亚小洞穴的入口。遗物再次向底座发光。将遗物放置在底座，平台下降至深渊。米纳再次与链接交谈，敦促他尽快见她。
平台停留在建筑工厂前，遗物射出一道光束指向入口处的模具。使用Ultrahand，可以在头插处放置遗物。这样做后，米纳正式向他介绍为“精神贤者”。她透露自己失去了原身，因此无法亲自与他交流。为了创造新的身体，她要求链接从左臂储藏区、左腿储藏区、右臂储藏区和右腿储藏区获取零件。
链接将零件放入模具中，米纳会数清剩余的个数。当链接组装好米纳的构造体时，它会自动激活并从模具中出现。米纳感谢链接，透露他们现在必须找回她的秘密石。打开地图，米纳指示他前往它的位置，并请他陪伴她。由于他们的旅程危险，她建议链接使用附近的平台来探索构造体的用途。她敦促他赶快去。
当他们到达精神神庙时，米纳的构造体无法通过塌陷的楼梯。通过将附近的可利用资源（例如火箭）附加到构造体上，链接将其带到神庙入口处。当他们靠近中心的神像时，米纳的构造体向它发射光束，激活附近的传送点，同时该平台下降。

精神神庙中的秘密石可以被看到，需要用米纳的构造体穿越烟雾才能到达。然而，地面上出现的电线屏障和控制构造体的出现阻止了他们。米纳认出那是自己的创造物，但她发现了它正在被控制。由于恶魔之王甘多夫正在控制它，米纳宣布他们必须击败这个构造体。
一旦控制过的构造体被击败，烟雾在精神神庙中消散，屏障也消失了。链接还获得了一个心之容器。当链接检查灵石时，他的Purah Pad突然发光。米纳的本体从 Pad 中出现，进入灵石中，然后它缩小并嵌入其中。随后整个区域笼罩在紫色光芒之中。
当光芒消散后，链接可以看到米纳站在他面前。她再次向他自我介绍，透露她是佐奈人。她很高兴能与链接见面，感谢他帮助找回了他的秘密石。米纳透露她原本计划在他获得 Purah Pad 之后的第二时间联系他并控制这个构造体，但她没有想到他们必须与之战斗。她表达了感激之情，要求他伸出手。当他这样做时，她完成了“精神贤者的誓言”，这被刻在了他的右手上的中指上。她说，这已经形成了她在精神领域作为贤者之间的联系，并承诺尽一切可能来帮助他。
回到现实中，米纳继续从她的构造体那里与链接交谈。 她透露自己见证了海拉鲁的建立，并且在她这个时代，她失去了身体而成为了拥有灵子的存在。 从那时起，她一直在 Purah Pad 中等待着链接觉醒。 如今甘多夫延误了他们的相遇，她指责他。 在她的年代里，塞尔达在成为时间贤者后出现，并且她参与了这场“囚禁之战”中。 她决定与链接分享塞拉的决心，这将启动“ imprisonment war ”记忆。

尽管恶魔之王甘多夫在“ imprisonment war ”期间被封印，但米纳透露自己受伤且即将死亡。 在此期间，塞尔达带来了受损的“时间贤者”。 这使得他们在消失后可以找到它：这一事件将启动“Critical Decisions”记忆。
在塞尔达与米纳会面的过程中，二人开始指导链接，这将包括米纳作为精神贤者在 Purah Pad 中。 他们用一种禁用的方法为塞尔达复活了贤者，她必须使用这把贤者来击败甘多夫。 米纳相信这把恢复的贤者可能就在海拉鲁某处，她建议他去大德库树那里寻找它。 之后，“来自过去的指引 ”将完成，“时间贤者之刃”也将开始 。

overview_en:
After Link starts the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quest, Josha will go to meet Robbie at her lab in Lookout Landing. The two can then be found arguing with each other. When Link approaches them, Robbie comments on how nice the day has been. Noticing Link, Robbie makes a remark about his Purah Pad and its development. At this point, Josha becomes annoyed and accuses Robbie of not listening to her, which draws his attention back to her. Josha reveals that she wants to investigate the Depths herself, but Robbie insists it is too dangerous for someone as young as she is, fearing what Purah would do to him if something happened to her. Despite this, Josha claims that she needs to know more about a "figure" in order to understand the Depths.

When Link asks about the figure, Josha apologizes for leaving him out of the conversation. Josha explains that she has become interested in a Slate, which was brought back by the Zonai Survey Team after an investigation of the Depths. She theorizes that it could be evidence of a civilization in the Depths, and she wants to search for more clues. She laments that because of the danger, Robbie will not let her go.
To cheer Josha up, Robbie offers to investigate the Slate with Link on her behalf. He claims that they will search for a figure resembling the one of the Slate, and if they are successful, they will use the Camera to take a Picture of it to show Josha. When Link expresses confusion, Robbie explains that he can use the Camera to capture a Picture of nearby scenery, which is then stored in his Album. He promises to teach Link how to take Pictures in the Depths. Since there are many Monsters in the Depths, Robbie also asks Link to protect him. Robbie then leaves for the Hyrule Field Chasm, asking Link to meet him there when he is ready.
Josha tries to ask Robbie to wait, but he leaves anyway. She apologizes to Link for getting him involved in her Chasm Research, revealing that Robbie can be overly eager when it comes to helping her. To help Link in the Depths, Josha gives him 10 Brightbloom Seeds and a bundle of five Arrows. She suggests that in order to navigate the Darkness, he attach the Brightbloom Seeds to Arrows he shoots, which will light up the surrounding area. She then directs Link to go through the Southern Gate to reach the Hyrule Field Chasm. Josha expresses her excitement to see Link's Picture, and she asks him to take care of Robbie as well. Following this conversation, "Camera Work in the Depths" will begin.
At the Hyrule Field Chasm, Link will discover that Robbie has already descended into the Depths. At the bottom of the Chasm, he will find Ponnick looking for Robbie. When Link approaches him, he reveals that Robbie instructed him to guide Link to his location. However, Ponnick did not bring enough Brightbloom Seeds to keep up with Robbie, and now he has lost him. He claims that Robbie was initially only visiting the Nisoij Lightroot nearby, but he kept walking past it,  Ponnick then asks Link if he has any Brightbloom Seeds. If Link says that he does not, Ponnick impresses upon him the danger of exploring the Depths without Light. If Link claims to have Brightbloom Seeds, Ponnick will be relieved. Either way, Ponnick tells him that they can be found in Caves on the Surface, and he can throw them or shoot them on Arrows to cause them to bloom into Brightblooms. Before Link leaves, Ponnick once again expresses his sadness about not having enough Brightbloom Seeds.
Once Link reaches the Nisoij Lightroot, he can find a Note on the Table written by Robbie, in which he reveals that he is heading toward the Iayusus Lightroot to the west. Along the way is another Note on the Table, wherein Robbie claims to have spotted something resembling the figure on Josha's Slate. Robbie can be found near a Campfire at the Iayusus Lightroot, where he points out the Statue That Points the Way that resembles Josha's Slate. However, he complains about the Darkness making it difficult to see. He wishes that the Iayusus Lightroot was able to give off more Light.
After Link activates the Iayusus Lightroot, Robbie is surprised and states that he feels refreshed, comparing it to being on the Surface. He then decides to begin examining the Statue That Points the Way. Recalling that Link has not yet used his Camera, Robbie asks to see the Purah Pad. He then discovers that the Camera and Hyrule Compendium have been locked, though he is able to fix this for him. After doing so, Robbie instructs Link to take a Picture of the Statue That Points the Way, noting that this is an opportunity to learn how to use it and test that it is still working.
Once the Picture has been taken, Robbie asks to see it. When he sees it, Robbie is pleased with the results, and he is certain Josha will be too. Robbie claims that in the future, there will be more for them to investigate in the Depths. He then decides to return to Lookout Landing, telling Link to join him there soon.
At Lookout Landing, Robbie tells Link to show Josha the Picture he took. Once she sees it, Josha is excited, noting that it matches her Slate. She thanks Link and claims that this is evidence of a civilization that lived in the Depths, hoping to find more of their ruins soon. Although she is eager to move onto her research, Josha gives Link five pieces of Zonaite as a reward, which were found during early surveys. She claims to feel a strange enemy from them, and she thinks they could be useful for finding Zelda. Josha plans on sifting through the artifacts brought up from the Depths to see if she can find more Slates. Once again, she thanks Robbie and Link for their help. Afterwards, "Camera Work in the Depths" will be completed.
overview_zh:
链接开始“区域现象”主线任务，乔莎将前往 Lookout Landing 的实验室与罗比会面。两人随后发现相互争吵。当链接接近他们时，罗比称赞天气很好。看到链接，罗比评论了 Purah Pad 和它的发展情况。此时，乔莎感到恼火，指责罗比没有倾听她的意见，从而引起他的注意。乔莎透露她想自己调查深渊，但罗比坚持认为这对于她来说太危险了，因为万一发生什么，保罗会对她不利。尽管如此，乔莎声称需要更多关于“人物”的信息才能理解深渊。

当链接询问这个人物时，乔莎为未告知他而道歉。乔莎解释说，她对一个 Slate 产生了兴趣，这次 Slate 是由 Zonai 调查团队从 Deep 中带回来的。她推测这可能证明了在深渊中存在文明，并且她希望找到更多线索。尽管如此，因为有危险，罗比不允许她去。

为了让乔莎开心，罗比提议与链接一起调查 Slate。他表示他们会寻找类似于 Slate 的人物，如果成功，他们将用相机拍摄照片，然后向乔莎展示。当链接感到困惑时，罗比解释说，他可以用相机捕捉附近的景物，这些景物将被存储在他的相册中。他承诺教导 Link 如何在深渊中使用相机。由于深渊中有许多怪物，罗比也请 Link 保护自己。罗比随后前往 Hyrule 领域的水洞，请 Link 在他准备好时在那里会合。
乔莎试图让罗比等待，但他还是离开了。她向链接道歉，说他因为参与她的水洞研究而付出了代价。为了帮助 Link 在深渊中，乔莎给了他 10 朵 Brightbloom Seeds 和五个箭。她建议在黑暗中，将 Brightbloom Seeds 附着在箭上发射，让周围的区域发光。然后她引导链接进入 Southern Gate 以到达 Hyrule 领域的水洞。乔莎对看到 Link 的照片感到兴奋，并要求他照顾罗比。

在 Hyrule 领域的水洞，Link 将发现 Robbie 已经进入了深渊。在水洞底部，他会找到 Ponnick 在寻找 Robbie。当 Link 接近时，他向他透露，Robbie 让他引导 Link 到他的位置。然而，Ponnick 没有带够 Brightbloom Seeds 来跟上 Robbie 的进度，现在他已经迷失了。他说起初 Robbie 只来过附近的 Nisoij Lightroot，但他一直往前走，然后 Ponnick 问 Link 是否有 Brightbloom Seeds。如果 Link 说没有，Ponnick 将会告诫他在深渊中探索的危险。如果 Link 声称有 Brightbloom Seeds，则 Ponnick 会很高兴。无论如何，Ponnick 都告诉他，可以在地面的洞穴里找到，然后可以将它们投掷或装在箭上发射以使它们绽放成 Brightblooms。在 Link 离开前，Ponnick 又一次表达了他没有足够的 Brightbloom Seeds 的遗憾。

当 Link 抵达附近的 Nisoij Lightroot 时，他可以找到 Robbie 在桌子上留下的笔记，其中披露他将前往 Iayusus Lightroot 以西边为目标。在另一张笔记上，Robbie 声称自己已经发现了与 Josha Slate 相似的东西。Robbie 可以被发现在他附近的营火旁，而 Iayusus Lightroot，在那里他指出了一个指向的方向的雕像，这个图像与 Josha 的 Slate 相似，但他抱怨黑暗使得他看不清。他希望 Iayusus Lightroot 能发出更多的光。

在 Link 激活了 Iayusus Lightroot 后，罗比感到惊讶，并表示自己感觉焕然一新，这就像站在地表一样。然后他决定开始检查指向的方向的雕像。当 Link 还没有使用相机时，罗比要求让他看到 Purah Pad. 然后他发现相机和 Hyrule Compendium 都被锁定了，尽管他成功地解开这个情况。之后，罗比指导链接用相机拍摄指向的方向的雕像，同时他也指出这是一个学习如何使用它的机会，并且测试其是否还工作。

在 Link 拍摄照片后，罗比要求看看。当他看到时，罗比对结果感到满意，而且他认为乔莎也会这样。“未来，他们还有更多的东西可以在深渊中调查，”他说，然后决定回到 Lookout Landing，并请 Link 尽快加入。

在 Lookout Landing，罗比让 Link 向乔莎展示他拍摄的照片。当乔莎看到时，她觉得很熟悉，这与她的 Slate 一模一样。 她感谢链接，并且表明这是证明了深渊曾经存在文明的证据，希望可以很快找到更多的遗迹。 尽管她已经准备好继续研究，但乔莎仍然给予 Link 五个 Zonaite，这些 Zonaite 最初是在前期考察中找到的。她说她感觉到来自这些东西的奇怪敌意，他们可能会对帮助寻找 Zelda 有用。

在“Camera Work in the Depths”将结束时，游戏开始进入新的章节。

name_zh: 沉睡于地底神殿的谜团
overview_en:
"A Mystery in the Depths" becomes available after one of the Main Quests associated with "Regional Phenomena" has been completed. At Lookout Landing, Link will find Josha and Tauro arguing about whether he should be involved in Chasm Research. Tauro wants to help Josha, but she thinks that he should finish investigating the Ring Ruins first. When the two of them notice Link nearby, Tauro decides to give up and return to Kakariko Village. Josha explains that although she admires Tauro, she is afraid he would abandon her Chasm Research if something more interesting came along, and she thinks Link would fit her needs perfectly. If Link agrees to help her, Josha will thank him and invite him into her lab. Following this, "A Mystery in the Depths" will start.
When Link speaks to Josha, she reveals that the Zonai Survey Team found more Slates that she was able to piece together into a complete mural. She observes that the Statues That Point the Way appear to be leading to an unknown structure associated with the Zonai. By following it, Josha thinks one could find something associated with the Ancient Powers of the Zonai. Since Josha is too young to go into the Depths, she asks Link to investigate the structure on her behalf, and she gives him 10 Giant Brightbloom Seeds and a bundle of 10 Arrows to help him. She believes that investigating for her could provide Link with both clues to Zelda's location and a new Ancient Power.

By following the Statues That Point the Way in the Depths, Link will eventually come upon the Great Abandoned Central Mine. There, he will find two Researchers investigating an inactive Steward Construct, which they have been unable to figure out. Using his Right Arm, Link is able to restore the Steward Construct, which also activates the Mine's Travel Point. The Steward Construct then grants Link the ability to Autobuild.
The Researchers are shocked that Link was able to receive the Ancient Power. They ask for a demonstration, and after consulting a text that describes Autobuild, they request that Link repair their broken vehicles. First, Link must reattach the Small Wheel to the vehicle on the Round Pedestal. When he does so, he will be able to use Autobuild to recreate the vehicle from the pieces left on the Square Pedestal. After both vehicles have been repaired, the Researchers will be shocked express their satisfaction.

Suddenly, the Researchers call for their master before teleporting away, revealing that they were Yiga Footsoldiers. A voice can then be heard, noting that the rumors about an Ancient Power appear to be true. From behind Link, Master Kohga appears alongside the Yiga Footsoldiers, and he commends both Link and his subordinates for confirming the rumor as part of Operation Steal the Ancient Power. After looking at Link, however, Master Kohga recognizes him from their encounter at the Yiga Clan Hideout, which resulted in him entering the Depths and swearing vengeance on Link. With a dance, he reintroduces himself to Link as the leader of the Yiga Clan. He accuses Link of cheating, claiming that it is not fair that he can Autobuild while they have to build their vehicles by hand. Since they were planning to offer the ability to the Magnificent One, Master Kohga declares that he will take it back. He teleports into the nearby courtyard and summons a massive vehicle, where he challenges Link to a fight.
After Link defeats Master Kohga, he complains about his strength. He decides to leave Link alone for now, gloating that he has already found many other Abandoned Mines in the Depths. Having seen Link use his Right Arm to receive Autobuild, he plans to try and get it from a Steward Construct at another Mine, which he will use to destroy the world with the Magnificent One. Master Kohga summons a Wing with four Fans and a Steering Stick attached, using it to retreat. A stone Treasure Chest containing a Huge Crystallized Charge then appears in front of Link, and the "Master Kohga of the Yiga Clan" Side Adventure will begin.
When Link returns to Josha at Lookout Landing, she notices that he appears pleased and asks what happened. Upon hearing about Autobuild, she is shocked, and she decides to search for anything relevant to it among her artifacts. She is able to find a Schema Stone, which grants Link the Schematic for a Hot-Air Balloon. She suggests that he test it out by repairing Robbie's broken Hot-Air Balloon. After she removes the chains holding down the Balloon and the Basket, she asks Link to demonstrate Autobuild for her.
Using Autobuild, Link is able to reassemble Robbie's Hot-Air Balloon, much to Josha's surprise. She shouts to Robbie to get his attention, and he is shocked to see his Hot-Air Balloon has been fixed. Josha is happy to have been able to see the Ancient Power of the Zonai, giving Link a piece of Large Zonaite as a reward. Although she does not know its uses, she believes Link could make use of it, since he is able to use Ancient Powers. Josha has been inspired to continue her Chasm Research, and she hopes that Link will tell her anything else he discovers about the Depths. Following this conversation, "A Mystery in the Depths" will be completed.
overview_zh:
“《深渊的谜》”在完成与“区域现象”相关的某个主任务后解锁。在Lookout Landing，林克会遇到Josha和Tauro正在争论是否应该参与到“察斯研究”中。Tauro希望帮助Josha，但她认为林克应该先调查Ring Ruins。当两人注意到林克时，Tauro决定放弃并返回Kakariko Village。Josha解释说，虽然她敬佩Tauro，但她担心Josha如果遇到更感兴趣的事情会放弃她的研究，而且她觉得林克非常适合她的需求。如果林克同意帮助她，Josha将感谢并邀请他进入实验室。接下来，“《深渊的谜》”开始。
当林克与Josha交谈时，她透露 Zonai团队找到了更多的石板，她成功地拼凑成了一个完整的壁画。她观察到“指引之路的雕像”似乎指向一个与Zonai相关的未知结构。通过跟随这些雕像，Josha认为可以找到与Zonai古代力量相关的东西。由于Josha太小无法进入深渊，她请林克代替调查这个结构，并给予他10个大型Brightbloom种子的种子和10根箭，以供他使用。她相信调查此项工作将为林的“塞尔达”位置提供线索，并且还能获得一个新古代力量。
通过在深渊中跟随雕像之路，林克最终到达了巨大的废弃中央矿洞。在那里，他发现两个研究人员正在调查一个关闭的状态的管家装置，他们无法弄明白。利用林克的右臂，林克能够修复管家装置，这也会激活矿道的交通枢纽。然后，管家装置赋予林克“自动建造”的能力。
研究人员震惊于林克能够获得古代力量。他们要求演示，并在咨询描述自动建造的文本后，请求林克修理他们的损坏车辆。首先，林克必须将小轮子重新安装在圆形底座上的架子上。当他这样做时，他就可以使用“自动建造”来重建该辆车，剩下的零件放在正方形底座上。当两辆车都修复好后，研究人员会感到非常满意。

突然，研究人员呼唤自己的领主，然后消失，揭示他们是Yiga士兵。随后，有人说道，关于“古代力量”的传言似乎是真的。从林克身后，Master Kohga与Yiga士兵出现，他赞扬了林克及其部下在确认该传言方面所做的工作，这是他们“偷取古代力量”行动的一部分。不过，Kohga从林克身上看到了Yiga氏族的同伙，而他反过来从林克那里获得了仇恨，即林克进入深渊并宣誓要报复林克的。通过一个舞蹈，他向林克自我介绍为Yiga氏族领袖。他指责林克欺骗，声称他能获得“自动建造”的能力是不公平的。自他们计划将这种能力提供给“传奇之者”之后，Kohga说他会拿回它。他进入附近的庭院并召唤出大型车辆，在那里他挑战了林克。
在林克击败Master Kohga后，他抱怨自己的力量。他决定暂时让林克走开，并大声宣称他已经找到了其他废弃矿洞。看到林克使用他的右臂获得“自动建造”的能力后，他打算去另一个矿洞上获取那个，并通过它毁灭世界。“传奇之者”。Kohga召唤了一个有四个扇形和一根操纵杆的翅膀，并使用了它来撤退。然后出现在Link面前的石制宝箱中装载了一个巨大的克里石发射器，“Yiga氏族Master Kohga”的附带冒险开始了。
当林克回到Lookout Landing，与Josha再次交谈时，她注意到他看起来很高兴，并询问发生了什么事。当听到“自动建造”后，她感到震惊，并决定在他的手中找到任何相关的制品。她成功地发现了一个Schema Stone，这提供了热气球的图纸。她建议他先测试一下罗比破损的热气球。在拆除固定气球和篮子的链条之后，她要求林克向她展示“自动建造”的能力。

使用“自动建造”，林克能够重新组装罗比的热气球，让Josha感到非常惊讶。 她大声喊叫并引起了罗比的注意，他看到热气球被修理后，感到震惊。 Josha很高兴能看见“古代力量”的Zonai，并作为奖励给予了他一块大型Zonaite，虽然她不确定它的用途，但她相信林克可以使用它，因为他可以获得“古代力量”。 Josha受到了启发，继续她的“察斯研究”，并且希望林克能告诉她关于深渊的其他任何发现。在此之后，“《深渊的谜》”的故事完成。

overview_en:
At New Serenne Stable, Link can encounter Cado and his Donkey looking out toward the North Hyrule Plain. He is relieved to see that Link has reappeared after going missing, but he then asks where Zelda is. Upon hearing Link's explanation, he is shocked to hear that she is still unaccounted for. Cado suggests that Link speak with Impa, who is investigating the Geoglyph on the North Hyrule Plain. He believes that she could be able to help Link find Zelda. Following this conversation, "Impa and the Geoglyphs" will begin.

Link can meet with Impa on the North Hyrule Plain, where she is attempting to figure out what the Geoglyph is depicting. When Link approaches her, she is surprised to see him after his absence. Impa is relieved that he is returned, and she asks where Zelda is. Upon hearing that she is still missing, Impa declares that they must continue to search for her. She explains that when the Upheaval began, Geoglyphs appeared all throughout Hyrule, and she and Cado have been traveling to investigate them. During her travels, Impa saw the Geoglyph on the North Hyrule Plain from a distance, but she is unable to tell what it depicts up close. She attempted to view it from the Sky using her Hot-Air Balloon, but the Wind detached the Balloon from its Basket.
Using Ultrahand, Link will be able to realign the Balloon to the Basket and attach the two pieces. Similarly, if he already has Autobuild and obtained the Hot-Air Balloon Schema Stone, he will be able to automatically reassemble the pieces. Once Link has fixed Impa's Hot-Air Balloon, she will thank him for doing so and invite him to view the Geoglyph with her. If Link agrees, Impa asks him to light a Fire beneath the Balloon so they can float. Link can use the nearby Torch to bring Fire from Impa's Campfire to the Balloon. He can also throw Items related to Fire below the Balloon, such as a Fire Fruit or a Ruby.
After lighting a Fire in Impa's Hot-Air Balloon, she and Link will begin to float into the Sky. In the air, Impa begins to feel faint. Despite this, she is excited to finally see the entire Geoglyph. She claims that she read a Book in Kakariko Village that described images being drawn around Dragon's Tears, and while she believes this could be referring to the Geoglyphs, she is unable to discern much more than that. Since the Geoglyphs could be connected to Zelda, Impa suggests that Link try to find the Geoglyph's Dragon's Tear, telling him he can return to the ground with his Paraglider if he needs to.
Returning to the North Hyrule Plain, Link will be able to find a puddle in the Geoglyph's left eye. When he examines it, Recall will activate on his Right Arm, which causes the Dragon's Tear to float and begin to glow. This triggers the "Where Am I?" Memory. Once the Memory ends, "Impa and the Geoglyphs" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在New Serenne Stable，林可以遇到卡多和他的驴子，他们正看向北方海拉鲁平原。他很高兴看到林已经出现，但他随后问找了泽尔。听到林解释后，他震惊于泽尔仍然失踪。卡多建议林与伊姆帕联系，她正在调查北海拉鲁平原上的地貌。他认为她或许能帮助林找到泽尔。之后会开始“伊姆帕和地貌”。

林可以在北海拉鲁平原上与伊姆帕见面，那时她正在试图弄清楚地貌是什么。当林靠近时，她惊讶于林在失踪后再次出现。伊姆帕很高兴他回来了，并询问泽尔的情况。听到泽尔依然失踪，伊姆帕宣布必须继续寻找她。她解释说，“风暴”开始后，全海拉鲁都出现了地貌，而她和卡多一直在调查它们。在她的旅途中，伊姆帕曾在远离北海拉鲁平原时看到地貌，但无法在一眼望到时清楚地辨认它。她尝试使用热气球从高空观察，但风将气球吹离篮子。

通过Ultrahand，林可以重新对齐气球并将其连接到篮子上。如果他已经拥有AutoBuild并且获得了热气球的结构石，他也可以自动组装它们。在林修复了伊姆帕的热气球后，她会感谢他并邀请他一起观察地貌。如果林同意，伊姆帕请他点燃气球下方的火焰，以便他们能够升空。林可以使用附近营地的火堆点燃火并将其传递到气球上，也可以将类似火果或红宝石等物品扔到气球下方。

在热气球的火焰被点燃后，林和伊姆帕开始升入天空。此时，伊玛感到不适。尽管如此，她很高兴终于能看到整个地貌。她声称自己曾在卡卡里柯村读过一本书，描述了在龙眼周围绘制图像，虽然她认为这可能与地貌相关，但她无法从中获得更多信息。由于地貌可能与泽尔有关，伊姆帕建议林找到地貌中的龙眼，并告诉他如果需要返回地面可以使用降落伞。

回到北海拉鲁平原时，林可以在地貌左眼的一处找到一个水洼。当他观察时，他的右臂会激活Recall，导致龙眼的泪珠浮起并开始发光。这触发了“我在这里吗？”的回忆。在回忆结束后，“伊姆帕和地貌”就会完成。

overview_en:
After Link views the Memory "Where Am I?" during "Impa and the Geoglyphs", Impa will appear nearby and ask him what is wrong. After hearing that Link was able to see a vision of the past, she theorizes that Princess Zelda could be connected to the Geoglyphs and their Dragon's Tears. Impa suspects they can find more clues by continuing to investigate the Geoglyphs, and she claims that ancient literature states they can find out more at the Forgotten Temple. Once this conversation is over, "The Dragon's Tears" will begin.
At the entrance to the Forgotten Temple, Link can find Cado tending to Impa's Hot-Air Balloon. He is happy to see Link, and he reveals that once they arrived, Impa went further into the Temple to keep investigating. He plans to join her after he has moored the Hot-Air Balloon. By venturing into the Temple, Link can next meet Impa near the Mayausiy Shrine. She once again thanks Link for fixing her Hot-Air Balloon, and she claims that due to the Forgotten Temple's size, she is having trouble finding anything related to the Geoglyphs.

Past the Mother Goddess Statue is another smaller chamber, at the back of which Link can come across the Floor Map. Impa and Cado follow behind him, and Cado decides that they should see it up close. Impa notices that the walls surrounding the Floor Map depict the Geoglyphs, and the one after that which they saw on the North Hyrule Plain is located near Rito Village. Cado then points out that the locations of all the Geoglyphs are marked on the Floor Map. Impa is shocked that there were still secrets to find within the Forgotten Temple, and she states that they should go and investigate the remaining Geoglyphs. This worries Cado, who insists that she should rest before they leave again. Impa tells Link to look into any Geoglyphs he comes upon during his travels, since they could help lead them to Princess Zelda.
Excluding the one found on North Hyrule Plain, a total of 10 Geoglyphs remain for Link to investigate. By finding their Dragon's Tears, he will be able to view one of Zelda's Memories from the ancient past. The locations of the Dragon's Tears and their respective Memories are as follows:

After Link views the first 11 Memories from the Dragon's Tears, he will be startled by the Light Dragon roaring from above him. As she flies, the Light Dragon sheds another Dragon's Tear, which lands at the tip of Rist Peninsula. By examining the final Dragon's Tear, Link will be able to view "Tears of the Dragon".
When the Memory ends, several Silent Princesses can be seen to have sprouted around where the Dragon's Tear landed. The Light Dragon roars once again, and Link watches as she flies away. As he does so, "The Dragon's Tears" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在《英灵与巨石》中，林克看到“我在哪里”的回忆时，伊姆帕会出现并询问他是否有什么问题。得知林克能看到过去景象后，她推测公主塞尔达可能与巨石和它们的龙眼有关联。伊姆帕认为他们可以继续调查巨石以找到更多线索，并且据古代文献记载，在遗忘神庙里可以找到更多信息。

在遗忘神庙入口，林克可以看到卡多正在照料伊姆帕的热气球。他很高兴见到林克，并透露，当他们到达后，伊姆帕已经进入神庙继续调查。他计划在将热气球停靠好之后加入她。通过进入神庙，林克可以再次与伊姆帕见面，位于玛雅斯里神殿附近。她再次感谢林克修理她的热气球，并表示由于遗忘神庙的规模过大，她难以找到与巨石相关的信息。

在母神雕像后，有一个更小的房间，林克可以在那里找到地毯图。伊姆帕和卡多随后跟着他，卡多决定亲眼看看。伊姆帕注意到了围绕着地毯图的墙壁上描绘了巨石，而他们之前在北赫鲁尔平原看到的巨石就在里托村附近。卡多还指出地图上标示出了所有巨石的位置。伊姆帕震惊于遗忘神庙内仍有秘密等待着发现，并表示他们应该去调查剩下的巨石。这让卡多感到担忧，他坚持说他们应该休息后再出发。伊姆帕告诉林克，他在旅行过程中看到任何巨石都要留意，因为它们可能有助于找到塞尔达公主。

不包括在北赫鲁尔平原发现的那个，总共有 10 个巨石供林克调查。通过找到它们的龙眼，他将能够观看塞尔达公主的一个古代记忆。以下是龙眼的及其各自记忆的位置：

在林克观看前 11 个龙眼的记忆后，一个光龙从他头上咆哮。当它飞翔时，光龙又掉下一个龙眼，落在里斯半岛的顶端。通过研究最后的龙眼，林克将能够观看《龙眼的》。
当记忆结束后，可以看到几个沉默公主在龙眼落下的地方生根发芽。光龙再次咆哮，林克看着它飞走。正如执行上述步骤一样，《龙眼的》也会完成。

overview_en:
When Link speaks to Purah after completing "Crisis at Hyrule Castle", "Find the Fifth Sage", and "Recovering the Hero's Sword", she comments how useful it is that the Mineru is helping him and the other Sages fight Demon King Ganondorf. After hearing that Link has found the Master Sword, she is shocked to hear that it was on the head of the Light Dragon. She thanks Link for finding it, reminding him that Zelda sacrificed herself so that it could be restored. She remarks that without the Master Sword, Link does not look like himself.
Since Link is ready to face Demon King Ganondorf, Purah declares that they must figure out his location. She discerns that he must be somewhere in the Depths, as Hyrule Castle and anywhere else on the Surface seem unlikely. For more information, she suggests that he speak to Josha, who has been leading Chasm Research. She informs Link that she is relying on him. At this point, the "Destroy Ganondorf" Main Quest will begin.
When Link faces Master Kohga at the Abandoned Hebra Mine during the "Master Kohga of the Yiga Clan" Side Adventure, he reveals that he serves Demon King Ganondorf, who is dwelling in the Depths beneath Hyrule Castle. This portion of the Central Hyrule Depths is only accessible through the Hyrule Castle Chasm. While traversing Gloom's Approach, the Sage Avatars and Mineru's Construct will disappear.

After passing through Gloom's Approach, the Forgotten Foundation, the Imprisoning Chamber, and Gloom's Lair, Link will find himself at Gloom's Origin. There, the first wave of the Demon King's Army will appear as part of the War in the Depths of Hyrule, which consists of several Gloom-Wreathed Bokoblins and Boss Bokoblins that charge towards him. However, they are deterred by a single Arrow shot towards them. Tulin tells Link that he does not need to fight alone as he and the other Sages arrive. He activates his Secret Stone of Wind and continues, saying that they are unstoppable when they fight together. Yunobo's Secret Stone of Fire activates as well, and he claims he will make his ancestors proud by fighting with Link. Sidon activates his own Secret Stone of Water, promising to protect Hyrule alongside Link. Riju's Secret Stone of Lightning is also activated, revealing that since the Gerudo owe him, she is here to help him as well. Lastly, Mineru activates her Secret Stone of Spirit, vowing to atone for her past failure during the Imprisoning War by defeating Demon King Ganondorf now. All five Sages gather behind Link, drawing their Weapons.
As Link and the Sages fight the Demon King's Army, waves consists of Gloom-Wreathed Lizalfos, Gibdos, and Moblins will appear in succession. Once all four waves have been defeated, the wall of Gloom will dissipate, and Sidon reasons that Demon King Ganondorf must be there. However, they are interrupted by a gathering of Gloom behind them, which revives Colgera, Marbled Gohma, Mucktorok, Queen Gibdo, and the Seized Construct. Riju declares that the Bosses are not enough to stop them, and the Sages rush to face them. Sidon tells Link that it is their fate to fight the Bosses and that he should not worry. Yunobo assures Link that they will handle them, before taunting Marbled Gohma with the power of a Sage. Tulin claims they will be fine, since they have already defeated these Bosses before. As she prepares to face the Seized Construct, Mineru informs Link that the rest is up to him. Several Boulders fall in front of Link, forcing him to continue on toward Demon King Ganondorf.

Further within Gloom's Origin, Link will find Demon King Ganondorf sitting atop of a pillar of Gloom. He is disappointed that he has yet to destroy the world, and he believes that since Link is fighting for peace, he in an unworthy opponent. Using his Secret Stone of Darkness, he summons a cloud of Gloom, which reverts him to his appearance from before he became the Demon King. He vows to reshape the world and rule over it as king. Jumping down before Link, he tells him that he is witnessing both the revival of a king and the birth of his new world. Link then draws the Master Sword, and the two proceed to battle.
After depleting all of Demon King Ganondorf's health, he remarks that he almost forgot what the thrill of battle felt like, and he claims to be far away from his power's limits. Surrounding himself in Gloom once again, he activates his Secret Stone of Darkness and assumes his form as the Demon King. He tells Link to enjoy his final moments, threatening to take more than his arm. He then continues his fight with Link. During their battle, the Sages return to fight by Link's side, allowing Link access to their abilities once again. When half of Demon King Ganondorf's has been depleted, he unleashes a Gloom attack that knocks out the Sages, and he tauntingly beckons Link to face him on his own.

Once Link defeats Demon King Ganondorf, he falls backwards and shouts. He claims that there is still a way for him to rule over the world and that he cannot be stopped by Link. Tearing his Secret Stone from his headpiece, he claims that he is willing to sacrifice himself if it means he can destroy Link and shroud Hyrule in Darkness. Demon King Ganondorf then swallows his Secret Stone of Darkness, beginning the process of draconification. He is overtake by Gloom, and as beam appears above him, the Demon Dragon begins to take form. He grabs Link in his mouth, and the Sages shout as the two burst through the ceiling.

The Demon Dragon emerges from beneath Hyrule Castle, still carrying Link in his mouth. Suddenly, the Light Dragon appears, and the Demon Dragon roars as she approaches. This causes Link to fall out of his mouth, though he is caught by the Light Dragon and carried further into the Sky. Link manages to stand as the two Dragons face each other, and he draws the Master Sword yet again.
During the battle, the Light Dragon carries Link above the Demon Dragon, allowing him to drop down and attack the weak spots on his back. After Link destroys a weak spot, the Demon Dragon will fling him off, but he is yet again caught by the Light Dragon and carried upwards. After all four weak spots have been destroyed, a Blood Moon will rise, and the Demon Dragon's Secret Stone of Darkness can be seen on its head. When he lands on the Demon Dragon's head, Link will be able to attack and shatter the Secret Stone, defeating the Demon Dragon.
The Demon Dragon writhes, causing Link to fall off its head and be caught by the Light Dragon one last time. The Light Dragon flies away with Link, and after the Secret Stone finally shatters, the Demon Dragon flies into Sky. Several beams of light appear from his body, before a large beam encompasses him and destroys him. Link and the Light Dragon watch from a distance, and afterwards, "Destroy Ganondorf" will be completed.
overview_zh:
链接与普拉（完成“城堡危机”、“寻找第五贤者”和“夺回英雄之剑”后）交谈，并评论米涅的帮助以及贤者的对抗邪王甘纳多的作用。得知链接已获得宝剑后，她震惊地发现宝剑正佩戴在光明龙头上。她感谢链接，提醒他泽尔为了复原宝剑而牺牲了自己。她表示，若没有宝剑，链接就无法成为自己的样子。

由于链接已准备好面对邪王甘纳多，普拉宣布他们必须找到他的位置。她推断他一定在深渊，因为赫鲁尔城堡和表面其他地方不太可能。为了获得更多信息，她建议联系约沙，他在领导“裂隙研究”。她告知链接，这取决于他。此时，“击败甘纳多”的主线任务将开始。

当链接与依雅氏族（在“依雅氏族”次冒险中）对付马科哈时，他透露甘纳多正住在赫鲁尔城堡深渊地下的地方。这个中央赫鲁尔深渊部分的入口只有通过城堡裂缝才能进入。在穿过“幽暗之道”期间，贤者和米涅的战士将消失。

经过“幽暗之道”、“遗忘之地”、“囚禁之室”和“幽暗洞穴”，链接会找到自己身处“幽暗根源”。在那里，邪王的军队的第一批士兵会出现，这构成着在赫鲁尔深渊中的战争，包括多个被幽暗笼罩的博科林和大型博科林，他们向他冲来。但由于单一的一把箭击中，它们被阻止了。图林告诉链接，他不必独自战斗，而贤者会及时赶到，他们一起行动就能战胜所有邪王的军队。图林的“风之石”也被激活了，他表示可以凭借贤者的力量来战胜邪王甘纳多，并且他说，他们能够战胜恶魔，这让他在自己赢得战争时都感到快乐。。塞东也做了同样，让他相信和 Link 一起，他们也能战胜恶魔。里朱也一样，她也声称自己将帮助 Link 来赢战 成功 。而米涅的“精神之石”也激活了，“我会弥补之前的失败，来击败邪王甘纳多！”；五个贤者在Link 的身后，拿出他们的武器。

当链接和贤者与恶魔军进行战斗时（包括被幽暗笼罩的利萨夫斯、Gibdos 和莫布林），会在不同时间陆续出现。当四个阶段的失败都达成时，幽暗之壁将会消失，而塞东表示“甘纳多正就在这里”。但是他们却被一个幽光包围着，导致冷戈拉、Marbled Gohma、Mucktorok 、Queen Gibdo 以及 Seized 的构建再次出现。里朱声明“这些都是不够的”，贤者们迅速冲向了恶魔一方。塞东告诉 Link 命运会让你们战胜他们，然后他会保护Link 一起战斗。图林也提醒 Link 他们已经能够战胜他们，让他不要担心。而米涅则表示，今后还是要靠 Link 独自来完成任务。 。
随后，链接要面对面前的岩石堆；如果他没能通过，就必须和邪王甘纳多 缠斗。

在“幽暗根源”内部，Link 会发现甘纳多的剑正立在这座幽暗之壁上，剑是深一筹浅两度的力量。“我，甘纳多”感到过分失望，他认为自己的力量正在衰退，他称 Link 作为对手并不值得他付出努力。“我的王”则告诉 Link, 他自己要面对这一切。

然而，紧接着，链接随即举起宝剑，双方马上展开战斗，“啊”！ 。
在 Link 逐渐耗尽甘纳多的血气后，甘纳多表示“差点我忘了战斗是怎样的感觉？”并声称他仍然拥有强大的力量。“啊啊！”

此时，甘纳多又再次启动了他的黑暗之石，从自身周围凝聚出充满幽暗的雾气，从而变回邪王甘纳多的原始形象。他宣示要改写世界，并成为统治者的霸主， 。随后，甘纳多下砸，告诉 Link 可以亲眼见证他的复兴和新世界的诞生。“啊！”，Link 也举起宝剑，与甘纳多同仇敌我，开始战斗。
当链接完全击败了甘纳多的血气后，甘纳多自言“快要耗尽了呢”并称他感觉自己的力量正在减弱，“啊哦”、“ 啊！”，

之后 紧接着，甘纳多再次启动黑暗之石，从自身周围凝聚出充满幽暗的雾气，从而在邪王甘纳多的形象。他告诉 Link 可以亲眼见证他的复兴和新世界的诞生。“啊！”，Link 也举起宝剑，与甘纳多同仇敌我，“啊”！ 。此时，链接开始战胜邪王的甘纳多时突然出现了几道光芒从甘纳多身上散发出来。

在战斗结束后，“啊啊！” Link 的“啊”声打破了寂静，他称现在还有机会让世界听他的……不！ 最终。
随后，甘纳多告诉 Link 他想要一个机会，让他统治这个世界时，“啊！”，

此时，甘纳多也启动了他的黑暗之石，从自身周围凝聚出充满幽暗的雾气；此时甘纳多的形象是“恶魔王”形象，他开始威胁 Link：“想让谁都听见我的声音！” 。
Link 与甘纳多大战后，甘纳多自言：“啊哈哈哈哈哈！要让你把手臂切掉！” 之后 ，Link 开始与甘纳多作斗。此时，Link 和 Sages 的战斗， Link 也逐渐获得了 Sages 的能力。（时机：当 Link 击败了大部分恶魔时，甘纳多突然使出“幽暗攻击”，将链接和贤者们击倒），但 Link 随后又成功站稳阵脚。

当甘纳多的血气完全耗尽后，Link 喊道，“啊！”，声称有一个办法让他统治世界，并且无法阻止他。
随后，甘纳多挥舞着自己的黑暗之石， “我愿意牺牲我自己来消灭你！让赫鲁尔陷入黑暗！” 。

此时，甘纳多的黑暗之石也随之融化，开始恶魔化的过程，瞬间爆发了一道光芒， 出现了巨大的…”，。
随后，甘纳多向 Link 拉近距离， 突然，Link 被他“吞”进嘴里，
这时，“啊啊！”，
贤者们也在这处帮忙进行抵抗 ，之后 ،

此时，随着邪王甘纳多的死亡，“啊啊！” ，
此时，光芒开始从体表释放出来， 。随后，巨大的…消失。
Link 和光明龙在远处遥望着, 之后，《击败甘纳多》任务也因此完成。

overview_en:
As Link explores the Great Sky Island after leaving the Room of Awakening, he will come across a Steward Construct that reactivates when he approaches it. It recognizes him, claiming that Princess Zelda left something for him with it. A compartment within the Steward Construct slides open, revealing the Purah Pad. It claims that the Purah Pad will be useful for navigation. When Link takes it into his hands, it opens to a Map of the Great Sky Island.
The Steward Construct informs Link that Princess Zelda is waiting at the Marker indicated on the Map. Link then asks where they are, and the Steward Construct explains that they are in the Garden of Time. It points out the Temple of Time nearby, which it claims hosted rites for Hyrule in the ancient past. However, it reveals that no one has visited recently. The nearby Terminal activates, and the Main Quest "Find Princess Zelda" will begin.
By following the Marker, Link will find himself in front of the Temple of Time. However, when he tries to activate the Terminal in front of the door with his Right Arm, it will glow red, barring him entry. A figure then appears behind Link, revealing that the door will only open if he has enough power. He apologizes for startling Link, and he introduces himself as Rauru, the source of Link's new Right Arm. Rauru suggests that Link attempt to visit three of the Shrines of Light on the Great Sky Island to restore some of his Right Arm's Ancient Powers, which will allow him to access the Temple of Time. Following their conversation, the Main Quest "The Closed Door" will begin.

After Link completes the Ukouh Shrine, the In-isa Shrine, and the Gutanbac Shrine, he will be able to return to the Temple of Time and open its door. Inside, he will find a glowing vision of a Secret Stone hovering above the Temple's Altar. When he touches it, he will be overcome by Light, and Princess Zelda will appear floating before him. She extends her hand toward him, and when Link takes it, she begins to glow and grants him the power of Recall. Afterwards, she fades away, and Link will return to the Temple of Time.
Rauru appears again, showing a familiarity with Recall. He also notes that Zelda is gone, theorizing that what he saw was an echo of her will. Rauru claims that using Recall will be useful for Link, at which point he disappears once more. With Recall, Link is able to reverse the gears within the Temple of Time, allowing him to access the upper chamber. There, he finds a Challenge Door, which will drain his Hearts as he pushes it. Rauru claims that he is currently too weak to open it, but he reveals that by visiting the final Shrine of Light on the Great Sky Island and offering his Lights of Blessing to the Great Goddess Statue, he may regain enough strength. He asks Link to show him the Purah Pad, informing him that he will be able to Warp to the Travel Point indicated on the Map. A Marker appears near the Room of Awakening, where the final Shrine can be found.
Once Link has completed the Nachoyah Shrine, he can return to the Great Goddess Statue and offer his four Lights of Blessing in exchange for a Heart Container. With four Hearts in his Life Gauge, Link will be able to successfully push open the Challenge Door. Rauru appears before Link yet again, expressing how relieved he is that Link was able to pass through the Door. He admits that Link has yet to recover from being attacked by Gloom while he was Beneath Hyrule Castle, though receiving Lights of Blessing was able to help him heal. He is happy that he was finally able to meet Lin}, recalling that he is just as Zelda described him. As he disappears, Rauru leaves it up to Link to continue helping Zelda.
Following the path behind the Temple of Time, Link will come across a glowing ball of Light. When he examines it, Recall begins to resonate, and the Decayed Master Sword speaks. Link places it in the Light, where it proceeds to disappear. It then reappears in front of Princess Zelda, who listens as it speaks to her. Link is shocked by the Light Dragon bursting through the clouds, revealing Hyrule below. He then hears the voice of Zelda, who tells him to find her. At this point, the Main Quest "To the Kingdom of Hyrule" will begin.
While Link travels throughout Hyrule, he will discover many clues to Princess Zelda's whereabouts as part of the Search for Princess Zelda. During Main Quests "Impa and the Geoglyphs" and "The Dragon's Tears", he views the Memories "Where Am I?" and "An Unfamiliar World", which reveal that Zelda Time Traveled to Ancient Hyrule after disappearing from from the Imprisoning Chamber. There, she met Rauru and Sonia, the rulers of Hyrule. As part of "Guidance from Ages Past", Mineru reveals that Zelda served as the Sage of Time during the Imprisoning War, where she aided Rauru and the other Sages in sealing Demon King Ganondorf. Following this event, "A Master Sword in Time" shows Zelda obtaining the Decayed Master Sword, and she realizes how she can help Link in the future. Lastly, "Tears of the Dragon" shows Zelda undergoing the process of draconfication, sacrificing herself to become the Light Dragon so that she can restore and empower the Master Sword for Link.

After Link and the Light Dragon defeat the Demon Dragon during "Destroy Ganondorf", Link's Right Arm begins to glow. He finds himself floating above the Light Dragon, who begins to absorb power from his Arm. The Spirits of Rauru and Sonia appear behind Link, channeling their Light and Time powers through him. As a result, the Light Dragon reverts back to Princess Zelda, and Link's original arm is returned to him. Taking each other's hands, Rauru and Sonia disappear together. As Light overcomes him, Link falls unconscious.

When Link wakes up, he is falling through the Sky, and he spots Princess Zelda falling below him. By Diving toward her, he is able to reach for her, finally grabbing onto her hand. Link pulls Zelda close to him, and the two of them fall into the Bottomless Pond. He carries her out of the Water, where she finally awakens after being placed on the ground. She is initially confused, but upon seeing that Link is carrying the Master Sword, she realizes that he was able to defeat Demon King Ganondorf. Asking if she is dreaming, she celebrates Link's victory. She likens her time as the Light Dragon to being asleep, explaining that she woke up when she felt a warm and loving embrace. She thanks Link, claiming that she wants to tell him about all the people she met in the past. With a smile, Zelda declares that she is home. Afterwards, "Find Princess Zelda" will be completed.
overview_zh:
链接在离开“觉醒之室”后探索天空岛，会遇到一个管家构造体，它会在他靠近时激活。该构造体认识他，声称公主塞尔达在此留给他东西。构造体的隔间打开，显示了普拉哈板，据说它对导航有帮助。当链接拿起它时，会显示天空岛的地图。
管家构造体告知链接，塞尔达在地图上标记的地点等待着他。然后，链接询问具体位置，构造体解释说他们现在身处“时间花园”，并提到该花园曾是古代的英灵神殿。然而，它表明无人在此逗留过。附近的终端激活，“寻回公主塞尔达”主线任务开始。
通过遵循标记，链接会到达英灵神殿，但如果他尝试使用右臂激活前门，则将发出红色光芒，阻止进入。随后出现了一个人影，向链接道歉并自称是拉鲁，他是与链接右臂相关的源头。拉鲁建议链接去天空岛中的三个“光明神龛”恢复右臂的古代力量，以便可以进入英灵神殿。在对话之后，“关闭的门”主线任务开始。

通过完成“乌库·哈基”神龛、“因莎”神龛和“古塔巴克”神龛后，链接能够返回英灵神殿并打开其门。里面有一道闪耀的幻象，覆盖在神坛上，触摸时会使塞尔达显现出来，并向他伸出手，当链接抓住它时，她开始充满力量并在链接身获得回溯的能力。之后，她消失了，而链接返回到英灵神殿。
拉鲁再次出现，展示了对回溯的熟悉。他还指出塞尔达已不在，推测这只是她的意志的回响。拉鲁声称，回溯对于链接有帮助，他随后消失。有了回溯的能力，Link可以反转英灵神殿中齿轮，从而进入上层空间。在那里，他发现了一个“挑战之门”，它会消耗他，因为他试图推进它。拉鲁表示，他现在太弱了无法打开它，但他透露如果能在天空岛的最后一个神龛处，将祝福的光芒献给大地之神雕像，他就能获得足够的力量。他要求 Link 示他普拉哈板，并告知他们可以回到“唤醒之室”上的旅行点。一个标记出现在“唤醒之室”，在那里可以找到最后的那个神龛。
当链接完成“纳霍亚”神龛后，他就可以返回大地之神雕像并用四个祝福的光换取一颗心脏容器。获得四个生命条后，LINK就能成功打开挑战之门。拉鲁再次来到与 LINK 的相会，表达了它能安全通过之后的心情。他承认，LINK 仍然没有从在“白皇议廷”被黑暗的攻击中完全恢复，但那份祝福的光给了他一定的治愈。他很高兴终于可以见到“林”，并且正好符合塞尔达对他的描述。随着他的消失，拉鲁鼓励 LINK 继续帮助塞尔达。

沿着英灵神殿后面的路，链接会遇到一个闪耀的光球。当他仔细观察它时，“回溯”开始响起，并让破败的 MASTER 剑说话了。Link 将其放置在光中，使其消失后重新出现在塞尔达面前，她听取她的讲述。LINK 震惊地发现龙的力量爆发出狂，并将 Hyrule 显示出来。随后他听到塞尔达的声音，让她寻找自己。此时，“前往英灵王国”主线任务开始。
当 LINK 在英灵里时找到很多关于塞尔达的信息，这部分是“寻回公主塞尔达”。在完成“伊姆帕与地貌”和“龙之泪”之后，他会体验 “我是谁？” 和 “一个陌生世界”，它们透露塞尔达在从“囚禁之室”中消失后来到了古代英灵。在那里，她与拉鲁和索尼亚相遇，后者是时期的统治者。作为“时间旅行的回响”，米涅告诉 LINK 塞尔达在时空战争中成为“计时法师”，当时协助拉鲁和其他诸圣关闭了邪恶的甘多风。随后，“时间上的 MASTER 剑”让塞尔达获得了破败后的 MASTER 剑，并意识到她未来能帮助LINK 的作用。“龙之泪”展示了塞尔达经历变形的过程，为了救人类而牺牲自己成为光翼。
当 “摧毁甘多风” 的 LINK 和 光翼一同战斗时，Link 右臂开始发光。他悬浮在光翼上方，光翼开始吸收他的力量。随后，拉鲁和索尼亚的灵魂从光翼后出现，将他们的光与时间的力量传递给他。结果，光翼恢复了塞尔达，而且 Link 的原始手臂也回到了他的手中。他们伸出双手，然后消失。光芒覆盖 LINK，随后他失去了意识。

当 Link 醒来时，他悬浮在空中，并看到塞尔达也在下方坠落。通过飞向她，他最终抓住了她的手，并将塞尔达拉向自己。两人一同坠入深渊水池中。Link 将她从水中捞出，并让她复苏，放在地上。起初感到混乱，但在看见 Link 身上拿着 MASTER 剑后，他意识到LINK 已成功击败了 악당。 询问他是否在梦境里，塞尔达对他的胜利庆祝。她将时作为光翼的光进行形容为“睡眠”，解释说当感受到温暖、充满爱的地方就可以醒来。她将感谢 Link，说想要告诉他所有她在过去遇到的伙伴们 。带着微笑，“我回来了”。之后，“寻回塞尔达”任务完成。
