overview_en:
At the Hudson Construction headquarters in Tarrey Town, Link can find Hudson and Rhondson discussing Mattison's upcoming move. Although Mattison has been acting cheerful, Hudson is worried that she is only pretending to be brave about leaving soon. Rhondson claims that he is making the journey more difficult for Mattison, and she tells him that they should be supporting her. Hudson agrees, revealing that he wants to do something big for Mattison before she leaves.
Rhondson notices Link nearby, welcoming him and asking if he is in search of a dream home. However, she claims that Hudson Construction is not yet ready to open for business. The pair then recognize Link, and Hudson reveals that Tarrey Town has been thriving due to his help. He also informs him that they have a daughter, Mattison, which causes him to become emotional. Rhondson tells Hudson to put himself together. He apologizes and decides to head back to work, though he promises to think of something to do for Mattison. Following this conversation, "Mattison's Independence" will begin.
When Link speaks to Hudson again, he apologizes that he and Rhondson were unable to make time for him. He laments how indecisive he is about Mattison, which contradicts Hudson Construction's motto of "It's son and done." When Link asks about her, Hudson reveals that she will have to move to Gerudo Town soon, since it is Gerudo law that their children cannot associate with men until they grow up. Once a Gerudo child starts becoming aware of the world, an escort from Gerudo Town comes to take them. Despite it being considered an honor among the Gerudo to spend time in Gerudo Town, Hudson is having a hard time letting Mattison go. Since he and Rhondson are so busy, he wishes someone would spend time with Mattison before she leaves.
Mattison can be found in the Room on the Second Floor above the Hudson Construction headquarters, where she is using her Notebook to study the Gerudo language. When Link asks her about it, Mattison is surprised, believing her escort has arrived. She explains that since she is moving to Gerudo Town soon, she is memorizing as many Gerudo words as she can to teach to the residents of Tarrey Town. She offers to teach Link as well, inviting him to join in on a Gerudo Quiz she is giving Monari.

Mattison meets with Monari in front of the Goddess Statue and the Unity Bell in the center of Tarrey Town. She greets Monari, who asks if they are having another lesson. Mattison confirms this, revealing that Link is joining their class as a new student. For the first question in the Gerudo Quiz, Mattison asks what the Gerudo word for "grandmother" is. Monari struggles to find the answer, but Link is able to give the correct answer, "vaba". Monari is pleased that there is someone else who is knowledgeable about Gerudo, since she has learned a lot from Mattison's lessons. Mattison hopes that by teaching Gerudo to the residents of Tarrey Town, Rhondson will feel less lonely when she leaves. Next, Mattison wants to help Hudson, so she decides to ride the Railcar help him at the Hudson Construction Site. As Mattison runs off, Monari shares her belief that Mattison is too young to be worried about her parents' happiness. However, she does not think that she will be able to make it to the Railcar due to how strict Hagie has become about it.
At the Railcar station, Mattison appears despondent, and she reveals that Hagie will not let her ride unless she pays him. She wants to get onto the Railcar without him noticing, but she needs someone to block his view for her. Using Ultrahand, Link can place an Object in front of Hagie to prevent him from seeing Mattison. Alternatively, he can also throw a Puffshroom at Hagie. Afterwards, he can tell Mattison it is safe to go, and she decides to trust him and run for the Railcar. When she reaches it, she celebrates and thanks Link for his help, before she departs for the Hudson Construction Site.
When Link arrives at the Hudson Construction Site, Link can find Hudson and Mattison inspecting a Hot-Air Balloon outside of the Workshop. Mattison is pleased to see Link, and she notes that Hudson has been mumbling to himself. Turning to Link, Hudson reveals that he decided to make a Hot-Air Balloon to help Mattison reach Gerudo Town. However, he is unsure of how to make it special for her. Mattison claims that she already loves the Hot-Air Balloon, comparing it to the sun. The inspires Hudson to color the Balloon's fabric yellow, but he needs 10 Sundelions in order to do so. Mattison offers to help search for them, but Hudson informs her that they are too rare. Mattison claims she saw one attached to a Fallen Ruin from the Sky before, which intrigues Hudson.
After Link has gathered 10 Sundelions, he can return to the Hudson Construction Site to give them to Hudson. He and Mattison are shocked to receive them, and they celebrate him for doing so. However, Mattison is disappointed that she was unable to help Hudson find them. Attempting to assure her, Hudson asks if she wants to help him dye the Balloon. Mattison agrees, and the two sing the Hudson Construction theme song as they work through the night.
In the morning, Hudson declares that the Sun Balloon is complete. Looking toward Mattison resting nearby, Hudson comments on how happy he is to watch her. Rhondson then arrives at the Hudson Construction Site, and Hudson realizes that Mattison's escort has arrived. Hudson decides that they should ride back to the entrance of Tarrey Town using the Sun Balloon, and he invites Link to fly back with them.

Floating in the Sun Balloon, Mattison states that she feels like a Bird. Rhondson tells her to calm down, concerned that she will fall out. Hudson directs everyone's attention to the sunrise, which intrigues Mattison. Rhondson calls the sunrise a blessing for Mattison's journey, and she claims that no matter where they are, they will always be under the same sun. As a result, she says that she will always be with her daughter. Hudson then warns everyone to hold on, as they will be landing soon.
After they land, the residents of Tarrey Town gather to see Mattison off. Mattison expresses her gratitude to Hudson for making the Sun Balloon. Hudson starts to tell Mattison she can come home if she ever gets lonely, but he decides to be strong instead. A Gerudo Soldier then walks up to the group, and Hudson asserts it is now time for her to leave. Monari promises to look after Hudson and Rhondson for her, and she is looking forward to hearing her stories when she grows up. Hunnie promises to come visit Mattison and play with her. Mattison thanks them, vowing to become a wonderful woman like her mother and meet a nice man like her father. She then waves goodbye to the residents of Tarrey Town, and she and the Gerudo Soldier leave together.
Now that Mattison is gone, Hudson asks Rhondson if he was able to keep smiling. Rhondson assures him that he did great, stating it would have been bad if they cried when Mattison did not. She encourages Hudson that, if he is ready, they need to pull themselves together and start a new phase of their life. Hudson agrees, and he is able to compose himself. He apologizes to Link and thanks him for his help. As a reward for the Sundelions, he gives Link a Silver Rupee. Rhondson then gives him another Silver Rupee. Should Link ever visit Gerudo Town, Hudson asks him to check on Mattison, though Rhondson reminds him that men are not allowed inside. The two of them then return to their work, and "Mattison's Independence" will be completed.
overview_zh:
Link在塔雷镇的汇德公司总部找到了浩登和罗恩森，两人正在讨论马蒂森的搬迁。虽然马蒂森表现得很开朗，但浩登担心她只是假装坚强。罗恩森说他故意让马蒂森的生活变得艰难，并告诉他们应该支持她。浩登同意，透露他想在马蒂森离开前为她做一件大事。
罗恩森注意到链接在附近，向他问及是否正在寻找梦想中的家园。但他表示汇德公司尚未准备好营业。两人随后认识了链接，浩登透露塔雷镇的繁荣离他有很大关系。他还告诉他有两个孩子之一是马蒂森。罗恩森劝告浩登振作起来。他道歉并决定返回工作岗位，但承诺会为马蒂森寻找合适的礼物。
链接再次与浩登交谈时，向他表示对此感到抱歉。他抱怨自己和罗恩森无法抽出时间陪伴马蒂森，这与汇德公司“就事了”的座右铭相悖。链接询问马蒂森时，浩登透露她很快将不得不搬到葛鲁多镇，因为葛鲁多的法律规定不允许他们的孩子在成年之前与男人交往。一旦葛鲁多儿童开始意识到世界，葛鲁多的护送人员会前来带他们离开。尽管在葛鲁多社会中这样做被视为一种荣誉，但浩登很难让马蒂森离开。由于他和罗恩森日程繁忙，他希望有人能陪伴马蒂森。
马蒂森可在汇德公司总部上层的房间里使用她的笔记本学习葛鲁多语。当链接询问她时，马蒂森感到惊讶，认为她的护送人员已经到达。她解释说，因为她很快就要搬到葛鲁多镇了，所以她会尽可能多地记住葛鲁多单词来教给塔雷镇的居民。她邀请链接一起学习，并参加她与莫纳利的葛鲁多问答游戏。
马蒂森在塔雷镇中心的神女女神雕像和团结之钟附近与莫纳利会面。她向莫纳利问好，然后询问是否还要进行课程。马蒂森确认了，透露链接将作为新学生加入他们的班级。首先的问题是“祖母”的葛鲁多语词汇是什么？莫纳利难以回答，但链接成功地回答说：“vaba”。由于莫纳利从马蒂森的课程中学到了很多东西，因此她很高兴有人知道葛鲁多的语言。马蒂森希望通过向塔雷镇的居民教导葛鲁多语，让罗恩森在离开时不会感到孤单。接下来，马蒂森希望帮助浩登，于是她决定骑着火车去汇德公司网站，以便协助他。当马蒂森离开时，莫纳利表示认为马蒂逊太小了仍然担心父母的幸福，但她不相信自己会回到火车上。
在火车站，马蒂逊显得沮丧，她说必须支付才能乘坐火车。她想偷偷地上车，但需要有人帮她挡住浩吉的视线。通过使用Ultrahand，链接可以在浩吉眼前放置一个物体来阻碍他看清马蒂逊。或者，他也可能将 Puffshroom 扔向浩吉。之后，他可以告诉马蒂逊现在可以上车了，并且她决定信任他并冲向火车站。当她到达时，她庆祝并感谢链接的帮助，然后离开了汇德公司网站。
当链接到达汇德公司网站时，他发现浩登和马蒂逊正在工作坊外部检查一个热气球。马蒂逊很高兴见到链接，并且注意到浩登一直在喃喃自语。浩登转向链接说，他决定为马蒂逊制作一个热气球来帮助她到达葛鲁多镇。但他不确定如何让它独一无二。马蒂逊称，她已经非常喜欢热气球，并将其与太阳相提并论。这促使浩登将气球的材质染成黄色，但他需要10只圣狮才能做到这一点。马蒂逊表示可以帮助他寻找它们，但浩登告知他这些非常稀有。马蒂逊坦言自己曾在飞行的废墟上看到过一只圣狮，而这令浩登感到好奇。
当链接找到了10只圣狮后，他可以将它们送给浩登。两人都被这一发现震惊了，他们庆祝他成功地发现了它们。然而，马蒂逊对此感到失望，因为她无法帮助浩登找到这些东西。在试图安慰她时，浩登问她是否想帮忙染色的气球。马蒂逊同意了，两人在夜晚一起唱着汇德公司的主题曲。
黎明时，浩登宣布：“太阳气球”已经完成。他看着位于附近的马蒂逊，评论道他很高兴看到这一切。然后罗恩森来到了汇德公司网站，浩登意识到马蒂逊的护送人员已经到了。浩登决定让他们乘坐太阳气球返回塔雷镇的入口，并邀请链接一起飞回。
在“太阳”气球上，马蒂逊说她感觉就像一只鸟。“罗恩森警告说，这是个危险，担心她会掉下来。” 浩登指挥大家将目光投向日出，这引起了马蒂逊的好奇。“罗恩森说，这是马蒂逊的旅程中的祝福，在任何地方，他们都会一直沐浴在阳光下。因此，无论他们身在何处，她与女儿始终在一起。随后，浩登警告大家保持警惕，因为他们即将着陆了。”
到达后，塔雷镇的居民聚集出来，欢迎马蒂逊。马蒂逊表示感谢浩登为她制作“太阳”气球。浩登开始向马蒂逊讲述，如果她将来感到孤独，可以回家，但他决定要坚强。“葛鲁多士兵”走到人群前，浩顿说现在是时候离开了。“莫纳利答应照顾浩顿和罗恩森，并期待听到他们的故事。”“Hunnie”承诺会来探望马蒂逊，与她一起玩。马蒂逊表示感谢，并誓要成为像她的母亲那样美好的人，并且会遇到像她父亲那样好的人。然后，她向塔雷镇的居民告别，随后和葛鲁多士兵一起离开了。
现在，马蒂逊已经离开，浩登向罗恩森询问他是否一直保持微笑。“罗恩森”向他保证，她说那应该很糟糕，当马蒂逊没有微笑时。她鼓励浩登，如果他有时间的话，他们需要振作起来开始新的生活阶段。浩登同意了，并且可以平静下来。“浩顿向链接和罗恩森道歉并感谢他们。”作为回报，他对链接说：“我这就把银币送给你。”然后罗昂逊也给了他一枚。当链接将来访问葛鲁多镇时，浩登的询问马蒂森，但罗昂逊提醒他男人是不允许进入的地方。他们两人回到了工作岗位上，并将“马蒂逊的独立”完成。

overview_en:
The progress for "A New Signature Food" is linked to "A Letter to Koyin".
Reede, wanting to win the Mayoral Election against Cece, is looking for another product to put Hateno Village on the map. With elections coming up quickly, his thoughts drift to a food from the past.
overview_zh:
“A New Signature Food”的进展与“致科因”有关。

为了在 mayoral 选举中击败 Cece，Reede 正在寻找一款新的产品来让 Hateno Village 闻名。由于大选即将到来，他开始考虑从过去的食物中寻找灵感。

overview_en: The first part of the Side Adventure is a short stealth mission to follow Cece to her destination, a silo across the street. It is possible to witness her actions by climbing up the silo and entering through the window on the second floor. Ascending into the silo does not trigger quest progression but will instead result in being removed from the silo.
overview_zh: 第一种支线任务：跟随塞瑟到达目标地点——一个位于街道对面的储罐。可以通过攀爬储罐并进入二楼的窗户观察她的行动。虽然进入储罐不会推进主线剧情，但会使你离开储罐。

name_zh: 你是萨格诺派？还是科沙尤西派？
overview_en:
The Side Adventure begins after speaking to Cece at Ventest Clothing Boutique. Reede barges into the Armor Shop to confront Cece for her part in redeveloping Hateno Village and its new image as a fashion center for Hyrule. He demands for Cece to stop placing Mushroom-themed art pieces throughout the Village because the light they produce interferes with the growth of the plant life in the Village. He claims that the foundation of Hateno Village's culture and prosperity are threatened as a result. Though his wife, Clavia, suggests keeping an open mind toward Cece's changes, Reede insists that Cece is manipulating the people of the Village and that it is his responsibility to stop the new developments.
Cece pushes back against Reede's argument, insisting that she is responsible for rejuvenating the Village. After Reede claims that the residents prefer Hateno to remain a peaceful and quiet Village, Cece suggests a Mayoral Election to let the residents decide the future of the Village. Reede agrees and returns home. By speaking to Cece again after this, Link can begin the Side Adventure in earnest.
Cece asks Link which side he is on for the Mayoral Election. If Link answers that he is a Cece voter or undecided, she welcomes him to Team Cece. She then explains to Link that though she believes her victory to be assured, there are still a number of residents who are leaning toward Reede. She devises a plan to gift each of them a Hylian Shroom to win them over. However, she needs a volunteer to help distribute them because she and her sister, Sophie are too busy operating the Armor Shop. Regardless of whether Link agrees to help, she hands Link eight Hylian Shrooms and explains that there are an equal number of Reede supporters that they must convince to flip their vote.
Cece further explains that Link does not need to give the Hylian Shrooms to children, travelers, or any of the Sheikah. Additionally, she mentions that there is no reason to give them to people wearing the Mushroom-Themed Outfits or any of Reede's family. This leaves most of the candidates as part of the farming families or the elderly among the Village. The eight people that Link must present a Hylian Shroom, and their locations during midday, are as follows:

If Link loses the Hylian Shrooms, Cece will be angry and insists that Link must replace them himself by scavenging them or buying new ones. Upon giving each of the prospective voters a Hylian Shroom, Link can report his progress to Cece. As thanks for his hard work, Cece gives Link a Big Hearty Truffle in anticipation for the Mayoral Election. This completes the Side Adventure.
By starting this Side Adventure, Link can also begin the Side Adventures "A New Signature Food", "Cece's Secret", and "Reede's Secret". These Side Adventures must be completed in order to resolve the Mayoral Election in the eponymous Side Adventure, "The Mayoral Election".
overview_zh:
《副情节》从与“文特斯服装店”的塞赛对话开始。瑞德闯入“盔甲店”，向塞赛控诉她对哈特诺村和它作为海拉鲁时尚中心的改造，以及在村里布置蘑菇主题艺术品阻碍植物生长等问题提出指责。他声称，这些行为威胁着哈特诺村的文化和繁荣。尽管他的妻子克拉维建议保持开放态度，但瑞德坚持认为塞赛在操纵村民，而他有责任阻止新的发展。

塞赛反驳，强调自己正在努力改造村庄。在瑞德表示村民更希望哈特诺保持宁静的说法后，塞赛建议举行选举，让居民决定村子的未来。“盔甲店”的经营者和她的姐姐索菲忙于营业，因此需要链接帮忙分发蘑菇给选民。无论链接是否同意，塞赛都将8个“海拉鲁蘑菇”交给链接，并解释说，他们需要说服同样数量的瑞德支持者改变立场。

塞赛还指出，链接不需要给孩子们、旅行者或谢克哈人，以及穿着“蘑菇主题服装”的人或瑞德家族成员这些人的蘑菇。这意味着大部分潜在选民都是村里的农民和老人。链接需要将以下8个人（及他们的中午时段位置）送上蘑菇：
如果链接无法获得蘑菇，塞赛会生气，并要求他自己去寻找或购买新的。在将蘑菇交给每个潜在选民后，链接向塞赛汇报进展。作为对他的努力的奖励，塞赛赠予链接一颗“大棕色三文鱼”。这标志着副情节完成。

通过开始这个副情节，同时也可以开始其他副情节：“一款新菜肴”，“塞赛的秘密”和“瑞德的秘密”。这些副情节必须按顺序完成才能解决主要的副情节，“ mayoral election”。
目标：

overview_en:
Near Sifumim Shrine, Link can encounter Rozel and Bolson overlooking Lurelin Village, which has been invaded by a Pirate Ship. Rozel is shocked by the state of the Village, and Bolson believes that they will not be able to return until the Monsters have been driven out. Bolson suddenly feels as though they are being watched, and the pair turn around to face Link. Assuming that Link is a tourist, Rozel warns him to stay away.
Rozel explains that Monsters have overrun Lurelin Village, and Bolson reveals that although all of the residents were able to escape, they are now scattered across Hyrule. As a master builder, Bolson claims he would be able to rebuild the Village if the Monsters were to leave. Rozel theorizes that the attack could be a result of the Upheaval, likening the Monsters to Pirates. He declares that it is too dangerous to return to Lurelin Village until all of the Monsters have been eradicated. Following this conversation, "Ruffian-Infested Village" will begin.
Within Lurelin Village, Link will be faced by the Monster Forces that have taken over. The Monsters are present throughout the Village, as well as on the Pirate Ship in the center of the bay. During this time, he can find Numar trapped in the remains of the Village Head's House, whispering for help. After all of the Monsters have been defeated, Numar will call the remaining residents over to come and see.
Rozel, Bolson, Numar, and Armes gather on the beach in front of Link. Rozel is surprised that all of the Monsters are gone, and Numar reveals that he saw Link defeat them all. Bolson claims that he predicted Link was stronger than he looks. Rozel thanks Link for his help, speculating that the Monsters could have completely destroyed Lurelin Village if he had not intervened. Armes believes that they can rebuild by working together, and Bolson promises to contribute as well. Rozel is touched that Bolson would help, despite being a visitor. Turning to Link, Rozel apologizes for not being able to give him a reward, but he claims the residents can show him hospitality once Lurelin Village has been rebuilt. Bolson rallies everyone to work together, stating that Lurelin Village has been given a fresh start. Afterwards, "Ruffian-Infested Village" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在西斐米神殿附近，林克可以遇到罗塞尔和波松，他们目睹了被海盗船入侵的卢雷琳村。罗塞尔对村庄的现状感到震惊，而波松认为必须等到怪物驱逐出去之后才能返回。波松突然感到有人在监视他们，两人转过身面对林克。假设林克是游客，罗塞尔警告他远离。
罗塞尔解释说，怪物占据了卢雷琳村，波松透露虽然所有居民都逃脱，但现在分散在普鲁皇家各地。作为一名建筑大师，波松声称如果怪物离开，他可以重建村庄。罗塞尔推测这次袭击可能是由于“震荡”造成的，将怪物比作海盗。他宣布必须等到所有怪物被消灭后才能返回卢雷琳村。之后，“被海盗入侵的村庄”事件开始。
在卢雷琳村，林克将面对占据村庄的怪物。怪物遍布整个村庄，以及位于港口中心的这艘海盗船上。在此过程中，他可以找到努玛，他被困在村长府残骸中，向他们求助。在击败所有怪物后，努玛会叫剩下的居民过来看看。
罗塞尔、波松、努玛和阿梅斯聚集在林克面前的海滩上。罗塞尔惊讶地发现所有的怪物都消失了，努玛透露他亲眼看到林克击败了他们。波松声称他预见到林克比看起来更强。罗塞尔感谢林克的帮助，推测如果没有林克出现，怪物可能会完全摧毁卢雷琳村。阿梅斯认为他们可以合作重建，波松也承诺提供帮助。罗塞尔被波松的善意所感动，尽管他是客人的话。转过身面对林克，罗塞尔为自己无法给予他报酬而道歉，但他表示一旦卢雷琳村重建完毕，居民会给予他款待。波松号召大家共同努力，表示卢雷琳村获得了新的开始。之后，“被海盗入侵的村庄”事件完成。

overview_en:
After completing the "Ruffian-Infested Village" Side Adventure, Link can find Rozel and Bolson talking to each other on the beach of Lurelin Village. When he approaches them, Rozel thanks Link again for driving out the Monsters. Now that the Monster Forces are gone, he and Bolson are planning to focus on rebuilding the Village. He reveals that none of the residents will return until their Houses have been rebuilt. Bolson wants to repay Rozel and the other villagers for taking him in, and so he offers his construction expertise. He is also excited to restore Azure Bay and the Lucky Treasure Shop. However, he does not have the requisite Logs and Hylian Rice.
If Link offers to help, Rozel initially tries to reject him, but Bolson accepts. He declares that they will start by recreating the destroyed buildings' foundations. To do that, he needs 15 Logs, specifying that they cannot be Palm-Tree Logs. He also requests 20 bundles of Hylian Rice, which he plans to use to repair the thatched roofs. Rozel thanks Link again, informing him that he will be inspecting the damage that Lurelin Village sustained. Bolson dubs their project the Great Lurelin Village Revival, telling Link that he is counting on his assistance. Afterwards, "Lurelin Village Restoration Project" will begin.
When Link brings Logs to Bolson, he will ask for permission to take them. If Link agrees, Bolson thanks him for his contribution. Should Link leave any Logs with Bolson without speaking to him, he will yell at him for being rude. Following the delivery, he then informs Link how many Logs he has delivered so far, as well as how many more he needs. Once all of the Logs have been delivered, Bolson declares that he can now start rebuilding. When Link delivers the Hylian Rice, Bolson will be pleased. After all of the supplies have been delivered, Bolson asks Link to wait while he rebuilds the foundations.
Bolson completes the foundations on his own, and he then declares it is time to start the repairs. A total of five buildings need to be repaired: the Fishing Resort, Azure Bay, the Lucky Treasure Shop, the Village Head's House, and Armes's House. He explains that each building has different requirements in order to be rebuilt, and he asks Link which one he wants to start with. Link is then able to choose if he wants to fix an establishment or a House, after which he picks one to work on.
If Link decides to repair the Fishing Resort, Bolson reveals that it is famous for its spa treatments, and he asks Link to move in front of the Inn so they can discuss it. At the Fishing Resort, Bolson explains that the building's structure has remained, but its interior has filled up with Water. In order to remove the Water, Bolson first needs the debris inside to be cleared away. Using Ultrahand, Link is able to pull out two Boards, a Palm-Tree Log, and two Iron Poles from inside the Fishing Resort. After all the debris has been cleared, Bolson will proceed with fixing the Fishing Resort.
Upon finishing the Fishing Resort, Bolson declares it to be some of his best work, and he states that it is ready for the owner to return. At that moment, Chessica returns to Lurelin Village, and she is surprised to find that the Fishing Resort is still intact. She explains that she was hiding in Gerudo, but she came back because she missed the ocean. As a reward, she gives Link five Voltfruits. She invites Link to partake in the Fishing Resort's Salt Spa, revealing that she plans to reopen immediately.
If Link chooses to restore Azure Bay, Bolson explains that they are known for providing a wide variety of Meals. At the restaurant, Bolson explains that they need to put a Palm-Tree Log through the hole in the building to the left to serve as a support. He advises that the Log needs to be straight. After removing the Wooden Boxes in the way, Link will be able to maneuver a Palm-Tree Log into the correct position using Ultrahand. Once this is done, Bolson will proceed to rebuild the structures.
Once the construction is completed, Bolson brags about his handiwork, and he is eager for the owner to return. Kiana, Sebasto, Zuta, and Kinov then arrive, and they are shocked to find their Houses and Azure Bay has been fixed. To reward Link, Sebasto gives him Tough Seafood Fried Rice. Kiana claims this is the dish she is most proud of, and she invites Link to eat at Azure Bay in the future.
The final establishment that Link can repair is the Lucky Treasure Shop. At the Shop, Bolson explains that it used to be a landmark due to the Palm Tree that grew through its roof. Bolson wants Link to place the Palm-Tree Log in the Plant Pot on the Shop's second floor. He also suggests that Link use a straight Palm-Tree Log. Once a Palm-Tree Log has been placed into the Plant Pot, Bolson comments that it is perfect and proceeds with his construction.
After the Lucky Treasure Shop has been rebuilt, Bolson will be pleased with his work and declares the owner will love it. At that moment, Cloyne returns to Lurelin Village, and he is surprised to find that the Lucky Treasure Shop has been restored.  He explains that he decided to return after hearing that the Monsters had been driven out, and he is happy to be able to reopen the shop that his father left to him. As a reward, he gives Link five Bomb Flowers, which he claims he picked while he was away. Now that he is able to operate the Lucky Treasure Shop, Cloyne invites Link to partake without having to pay any Rupees.
The first House that Link can rebuild is the Village Head's House. In front of the House, Bolson explains that the secondary building requires a Palm-Tree Log to act as a central pillar. He reminds Link to find a straight Palm-Tree Log to use. After Link inserts a Palm-Tree Log through the opening, Bolson claims it is perfect before continuing with his construction.
Once the detached portion of the Village Chief's House is finished, Bolson is relieved to have somewhere to rest. Rozel and Numar both arrive, and they are happy to see the House has been fixed. Numar rewards Link with three Armored Porgies, which he encourages him to Cook with them. He then becomes worried about the Precious Painting that was on display, and he goes to check if it is intact.
The final building that Link can help restore is Armes's House. At the House, he explains that they once again need to replace the central pillar with a Palm-Tree Log, which he reminds Link must be straight. Once this is done, Bolson will construct the rest of the House on his own.
With Armes's House complete, Bolson claims that his work is that of a true craftsman. Armes is surprised to see that his House has been repaired, and he is relieved he will be able to return to his job. Since he was unable to help, he gives Link a Purple Rupee to express his gratitude. He also invites Link to take any of the extra Fish he catches from the Water, which he plans to leave in front of his House.

Once all five buldings in Lurelin Village have been restored, Rozel declares that they should celebrate with a feast. As the sun sets, the residents of Lurelin Village gather on a hill behind the town. Rozel recalls the day the Pirate Ship arrived, and he expresses his gratitude to Link for driving out the Monsters and helping restore the Village. He also thanks Bolson for his part, but Bolson claims he was paying them back for the hospitality he received. Rozel declares that Link is Lurelin Village's savior, and Armes reveals that, after discussing it with the other villagers, they did not have enough Rupees or other valuables to repay him. Instead, they decided to extend their hospitality to him, and as a result, he will never have to pay for anything in Village. This includes a staying at the Fishing Resort, eating at Azure Bay, and playing the Treasure-Chest Game. Overcome by his emotions, Bolson invites Zuta and Kinov to participate in the "Lurelin Revival Dance" alongside him. After the feast, Link will be transported in front of the Fishing Resort, and "Lurelin Village Restoration Project" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在完成“恶棍村”任务后，林克可以在路雷琳村的海滩上找到罗塞尔和波尔森。当他接近他们时，罗塞尔再次感谢林克赶走怪物。由于怪物的力量消失了，他和波尔森计划重建村庄，并表示需要用木材（15根）以及谷米（20袋），来修复房屋，具体来说，不允许使用棕榈树木。然后，罗塞尔再次感谢林克，告知他将检查路雷琳村的损坏情况。波尔森称他们的项目为“路雷琳村复兴”。
当林克提供帮助时，最初罗塞尔试图拒绝，但波尔森同意了。他们决定从重建建筑物的地基开始。为了做到这一点，他们需要15根木，只能是棕榈树的木。他还请求20袋谷米用作屋顶材料。罗塞尔再次感谢林克，并告知他将检查路雷琳村的损坏情况。
当林克送上木材后，波尔森会询问是否可以带走。如果林克同意，波尔森会表示感谢。如果林克在与波尔森交谈后就离开了，他会对林克表示不满。送完所有木材后，波尔森会告诉林克已送达多少木（具体数量），以及还需要多少木。当所有木都送达时，波尔森宣布可以开始重建。当林克送上谷米后，波尔森会很高兴。在所有材料到达后，他会要求林克稍后再到，以便他完成地基的建设。
波尔森独立完成了地基，然后宣布可以开始修复工作。需要修复的建筑物有：度假渔场、碧蓝湾、幸运宝藏店、村长家和阿默斯的房子。他解释说，每个建筑物都有不同的要求，并询问林克想先修复哪个。林克可以选择修复建筑或房屋，然后选择一个进行维修。
如果林克决定修理度假渔场，波尔森会告诉他这里以温泉疗养闻名，并邀请林克走到旅馆前讨论。在度假渔场，波尔森解释说建筑物结构未受损，但内部被水淹没。为了移除水，首先需要清理里面的杂物。通过使用Ultrahand，林克可以取出两个木板、一根棕榈树木和一个铁柱。所有杂物清理后，波尔森将继续修复度假渔场。

完成度假渔场后，波尔森表示这是他最好的作品，并告诉他房主可以回来了。此时，西斯卡回到路雷琳村，看到度假渔场完好无损。她解释说自己躲在格鲁多里，但回来的原因是想看看大海。作为回报，她给了林克五个 Voltfruits。邀请他到度假渔场的盐SPA中，并告知他计划立即重新开放。
如果林克选择修复碧蓝湾，波尔森会解释这里以提供各种美食而闻名。在他所在的餐厅里，波尔森解释说他们需要使用棕榈树木作为支撑来通过建筑物的一侧洞。建议使用一根笔直的棕榈树木。在移除房间内的木盒后，林克可以使用Ultrahand将一根笔直的棕榈树木移到正确的位置。完成这个步骤后，波尔森将继续修复建筑物。

建筑物完工后，波尔森会为自己的工作感到自豪，并期待房主回来。此时，基亚娜、塞巴斯托、祖塔和基诺都赶来，他们看到自己的房子和碧蓝湾被修复了。作为回报，塞巴斯托给了他一个“Tough Seafood Fried Rice”，而基亚娜表示这是她最引以为傲的菜肴。邀请林克到碧蓝湾就餐。
最后一个可修复的地方是幸运宝藏店。在那里，波尔森解释说这个商店曾经是一个标志性建筑，因为有生长在其屋顶上的棕榈树。他想让林克将棕榈树木放在商店二楼的盆里。他还建议使用一根笔直的棕榈树木。一旦将棕榈树木放入盆中，波尔森表示这是完美的，并继续进行施工。

在幸运宝藏店被修复后，波尔森会很高兴，并告知房主一定会喜欢。此时，克莱恩回到路雷琳村，看到幸运宝藏店已被恢复。他解释说他决定返回是因为听到了怪兽被赶走了的消息。他很高兴能够重新经营自己的店铺。作为回报，他给了林克五个 Bomb Flowers，并表示是他外出时捡到的。现在他可以经营幸运宝藏店，邀请林克来而不必支付任何 Rupees。
第一个可修复的房屋是村长的房子。在村长的房子前，波尔森解释说该建筑需要一根棕榈树木作为主要支撑柱。他提醒林克找到一根笔直的棕榈树木来使用。当林克将棕榈树木插入开口时，波尔森表示这是完美的，然后继续进行施工。
在完成村长房子的部分后，波尔森感到很轻松的地方可以休息了。罗塞尔和努玛都赶到，看到房子被修复了，他们高兴地告诉林克消息。努玛奖励林克三个Armored Porgy，并鼓励他用它们烹饪食物。然后他担心放在那里展出的贵重画作是否完好无损，然后去检查它是否完好。
最后一个可修理的建筑物是阿默斯的房子。在那里，他说需要再次将中央柱更换为棕榈树木。并提醒林克使用一根笔直的棕榈树木。一旦这些步骤完成，波尔森将开始后续施工。

完成阿默斯房子的部分后，波尔森宣称这是他真实的手艺。阿默斯惊讶地发现他的房子被修复了，并说他可以重新回到工作岗位。由于无法帮忙，他送给林克一个 Purple Rupee 来表示感谢。他还邀请林克自由捕获水中的鱼，并将它们放在他的家门口。

当所有五个建筑物在路雷琳村被修复后，罗塞尔宣布他们应该用大宴会来庆祝。随着太阳的落下，路雷琳村的居民聚集在镇后面的一个山坡上。罗塞尔回忆起海盗船到达的那天，感谢林克赶走怪物并帮助重建村庄。他还感谢波尔森，但波尔森说他只是还债了。罗塞尔宣布林克是路雷琳村的大救星，而阿默斯透露，经过与其他村民的讨论，他们没有足够的 Rupees 或其他贵重物品来报酬他。因此，他们决定继续向他提供帮助。这意味着他将永远不用为任何东西付费。包括在度假渔场住宿、在碧蓝湾就餐和玩“宝藏箱游戏”。被感动不已的波尔森邀请祖塔和基诺也加入“路雷琳复兴舞”一起参加。宴会结束后，林克将被送到度假渔场，"路雷琳村复兴项目" 将完成。

name_zh: 调查真相！传言中的塞尔达公主！！
overview_en:
After activating the Skyview Tower in Lookout Landing, Link may talk to a Rito named Penn, a reporter who is writing an article about the activation. He works for a Newspaper company based in Hebra called the Lucky Clover Gazette. Penn explains that the Gazette is a little short-staffed at the moment and that they could use another reporter, so he invites Link to come visit them in Hebra if he is interested.
When Link walks into the headquarters of the Lucky Clover Gazette, he will find Traysi leaning over a table and Penn standing nearby. If this is his first time meeting Link, Penn will note that Link must be quite observant, since he did manage to find them even though they are based in an old Stable, and he will ask if he wants to become a reporter. If he spoke to Link in Lookout Landing, he will recognize him and salute him for coming all the way there, as they are quite far from where they first met.
Traysi then turns around, annoyed that Penn keeps disrupting her work. Penn apologizes, and he explains that Link is here to join their staff. Traysi then turns towards Link, and when she recognizes him, she asks Penn to leave the room. Once Penn is gone, Traysi asks Link for an update on what has been happening. She is already familiar with the story because Purah has asked the Gazette to look into Princess Zelda's disappearance, which they have already started investigating. However, many people across Hyrule have been sending tips about someone matching Princess Zelda's description, and they are struggling to keep up on all the leads. Traysi was going to send Penn on his own, but she thinks it would be better if he had Link acting as his partner. In exchange for his help, she offers to give him the full Froggy Armor.
Following this, Traysi has Penn come back inside and brings him up to speed. Link and Penn must visit most Stables in order to follow up on the tips the Gazette has received so far and gather more information. After this conversation, "Potential Princess Sightings" will begin.
The following Stables feature a Side Adventure related to "Potential Princess Sightings!":

Since he can go on these investigations in any order, Link's reward will depend on how many of them he has done so far. The rewards include Rupees, the Lucky Clover Gazette Fabric, the Froggy Sleeve, and the Froggy Leggings. For the final piece of the Froggy Armor, he will need to go back to the Gazette headquarters.

Once Link has completed his twelfth investigation, Penn will fly down and congratulate him for his good work, before handing him a Gold Rupee. While he is proud of their accomplishment, he still seems saddened that it is over. He then flies to let Traysi know what they have learned and finish his story. When Link returns to the Lucky Clover Gazette, he finds that Traysi is happy with the results of their investigations and the Newspaper's popularity. She then agrees to give Link his final reward, the Froggy Hood, which is the last piece of Froggy Armor. Although they still do not know where Princess Zelda might be, Traysi assures him that should she learn anything new, he will be the first one to know about it. 
Traysi then mentions she has given Penn some paid time off for his good work. She recalls asking Penn whether he had offered Link a proper goodbye. Penn apparently flew off out of embarrassment, even though he had not finished writing his article yet. Following this conversation, "Potential Princess Sightings!" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在激活 Lookout Landing 的 Skyview Tower 后，Link 可以与名为 Penn 的一位 Rito 记者交流，他正在撰写关于此次活动的文章。Penn 在 Hebra 的《幸运四叶草报》社工作，该公司目前人员不足，需要一名额外的记者，因此邀请 Link 前往 Hebra 视察。
当 Link 进入《幸运四叶草报》总部时，会看到 Traysi 坐在桌旁，而 Penn 则站在附近。如果这是他们第一次见面，Penn 会注意到 Link 的观察力很强，尽管他们在旧稳定的住所，但他还是找到了他们，并询问他是否想成为一名记者。如果他曾在 Lookout Landing 与 Link 交流过，他会认出他并致以问候，因为他们的距离相当远。
Traysi 抱怨 Penn 经常打扰她工作，Penn 道歉了，并解释说 Link 现在是他们的员工。然后 Traysi 转向 Link，当她认出他时，她请 Penn 离开房间。Penn 离开后，Traysi 向 Link 询问情况。她得知 Purah 已要求报社调查 Princess Zelda 的失踪事件，并且已经开始调查。然而，在 Hyrule 各地的人们都提供了关于与公主相似人物的线索，但他们难以跟上所有线索。Traysi 原本打算让 Penn 自己去，但她认为让他和 Link 合作会更好。作为回报，她向他提供完整的 Froggy Armor。
之后，Traysi 让 Penn 回到办公室，并向他介绍情况。Link 和 Penn 需要拜访许多马厩来跟进报社收到的线索，以收集更多信息。在此之后，“潜在公主踪迹”将开始。

以下几处马厩都与“潜在公主踪迹！”相关的次要冒险：
由于 Link 可以按任意顺序进行调查，他的奖励取决于他已经完成多少次。奖励包括 Rupees、《幸运四叶草报》制服、Froggy 袖和 Froggy 裤腿。要获得完整的 Froggy Armor（蛙兵），他需要回到报社总部。

当 Link 完成第十二次调查后，Penn 会飞下来并祝贺他，然后将一个 Gold Rupee 递给他。虽然他为他们的成就感到自豪，但他仍然有些沮丧。他会飞去告知 Traysi 他们所了解的一切，并完成他的报道。当 Link 返回《幸运四叶草报》总部时，Traysi 很高兴得知他们调查的结果，以及报纸的受欢迎程度。她同意将 Froggy Hood 作为最终奖励给 Link，这是 Froggy Armor 的最后一个部件。尽管他们仍然不知道 Princess Zelda 在哪里，但 Traysi 保证如果她发现了任何新的线索，Link 会最先知道。
Traysi 还提到她已经请 Penn 休假，以感谢他的工作。她回忆起自己问过 Penn 是否应该正式告别 Link。Penn 因为尴尬而飞走了，即使他还没有完成自己的文章。在此之后，“潜在公主踪迹！”将完成。

overview_en:
After talking to Traysi at the Lucky Clover Gazette and starting the "Potential Princess Sightings!" Side Adventure, Link can meet up with Penn at Outskirt Stable to look into another lead regarding Princess Zelda's whereabouts. Penn has already started investigating and is talking to Nell, a Hylian traveler who just had a strange encounter along the road south of the Stable. When he came around the three-way intersection a woman came up to him and begged for his help because someone she knew was in great danger. She would not reveal the identity of this person, however, fearing it may make the situation worse. He agreed to follow her but he could not keep up and ended up losing track of her entirely.
Penn points out that this could be someone important, if revealing their identity to stranger might put them at risk. Despite the chances of this person being Princess Zelda being low, Penn still wants to follow up on the lead just in case. Before they break off, Nell mumbles to himself that the woman had seemed strangely fixated on his hair. This begins the Side Adventure "The Beckoning Woman".
When Link reaches the three-way crossroad, he will find Ralera lamenting about her friend. He asks her if she is feeling alright, at which point she will look taken aback. She notes under her breath that he has blond hair, before collecting herself and asking for his help saving a regal friend of hers. If Links agrees, she thanks him and explains that her friend is currently in hiding from the ones wanting to harm her. She turns towards the eastern road, which is now populated by Enemies, and asks Link not to be seen as that could lead the monsters straight to her friend. She then runs ahead along the path.
After making his way through the Enemies, Link walks up to Ralera, who is waving to him a little further down the road. She apologizes for leaving him behind and explains she hurried out of worry for her friend. She then turns to the cliff just north of where they are and asks Link to meet her at the top near a patch of fallen debris, before running off again.
Once Link reaches the top of the cliff, he will find Ralera waiting for him. She murmurs to herself again, this time with a smile, that Link is definitely the person she has been looking for. She turns to the cliff on the other side of the road, explaining that her friend is waiting for them there and that she will go ahead to meet up with her, before running ahead once more.
When Link travels to the other side, Ralera is already there to greet him. She apologizes for the trouble she put him through and explains that she had to test him. Because of the courage he has shown by overcoming every challenge she has thrown his way, along with his "disgusting" commitment to doing the right thing and his blond hair, she asks if he is indeed Link, the Princess' protector. He nods, and she excitedly tells him how glad she is to finally meet him, and that she will now be leading him to the last stop on their journey, his grave.
Then, in a puff of smoke, Ralera reveals her true identity as a Yiga Footsoldier and is joined by two additional Footsoldiers. Once all three have been defeated, the original Yiga warns Link to be careful next time because they definitely will not be letting him off that easily, before vanishing in another puff of smoke.
Penn then arrives to the scene. He is surprised by how far away Link has gotten from where they investigation started. He learned that the woman was actually luring people away, and that he was scouting the area from above when he heard her voice. He asks what Link has found out so far, and he is very shocked to find out that woman was a member of the Yiga Clan all along, and that her disguise was just a ruse to lure Link, the famous swordsman, into their trap. Since he does not realize that Link is the same swordsman, he just remarks on how unlucky it is that Link keeps being targeted mistakenly. Penn is very glad to see that Link is safe, and that he will not have to report on his untimely death.
He gives Link his reward, which can change depending on how many investigations they have already done already. He then wishes him well and takes off with his signature flourish.
overview_zh:
在“潜在公主目击事件！”支线任务开始后，链接与“幸运四叶草报社”的Traysi交谈并与Penn在Outskirt Stable会面，再次调查公主塞尔达的下落。Penn已经进行了调查，并正在与Nell交谈，Nell是一位来自希里的旅行者，她最近在Stable附近的南方路上遭遇了奇怪的事情。当他到达三个交叉路口时，一位女性向他求助，声称认识的人正处于危险之中。她拒绝透露此人的身份，担心这会使情况更糟。他同意跟随她，但无法跟上进度，最终失去了踪影。

Penn指出，如果泄露此人身份，可能会带来风险，但这仍然值得一探究竟。尽管塞尔达公主的可能性较低，但他仍希望继续调查。在他们分开之前，Nell自言自语说那女人似乎对他的头发很感兴趣。这开启了“召唤女子”支线任务。

当链接到达三个交叉路口时，他会发现Ralera正在为她的朋友担心。她问他是否没事，这时他表示自己一切正常。在低声中透露他有金色的头发，然后整理了一下思路，向他请求帮助拯救一个贵族的朋友。如果链接同意，她会感谢并解释说她的朋友目前躲藏起来，以避免被伤害。她朝着东边的路走去，那里已经有人存在（敌人），并警告链接不要暴露自己，否则可能会引诱怪物找到他的朋友。然后她继续前进。

在击败敌人后，链接走到Ralera身边，她在路边向他挥手。她为没能及时赶到为朋友道歉。她转向位于他们所处位置北方的一片悬崖，并要求链接在那里相会，然后再离开。
到达悬崖顶端后，链接发现Ralera已经在那里等待。她再次低声自语，这次带着微笑，表示Link就是她一直在寻找的人。她转身看向对面那条路，解释说她的朋友就在那里等着，然后又离开了。

当Link到达另一侧时，Ralera已经登场。她为之前的麻烦道歉，并解释说她必须考查他。因为他的勇气、克服所有挑战的决心以及金色的头发。她惊讶地问他是否是Link，塞尔达公主的守护者。
他表示知道；然后她激动地告诉他很高兴能与他相见，并且现在会带他前往他们的最后一站——他的坟墓。

随后，Ralera揭示了自己的真实身份为Yiga部的一名士兵，并由两名其他士兵加入。在击败了三人后，原Yiga部警告Link注意，他们不会再那么轻易放过他，然后消失。

Penn随后赶到现场。他对此感到意外，发现链接已经离开调查的起点很远的地方。他得知那个女人一直在引诱人，并且当他从上方观察时，听到了她的声音。他向链接询问情况，并被告知那个女人实际上是Yiga部的一个成员，而且此举只是为了引诱著名的剑客Link进入他们的陷阱。考虑到他并没有意识到，这就是Link，Penn称这真是个不幸事件，很高兴Link安全了，也不用写死亡报告了。

Penn向链接支付了报酬（根据调查数量而定），并祝他一路平安，随后消失。

overview_en:
As part of the "Potential Princess Sightings!" Side Adventure, Link can find Penn at Highland Stable investigating a rumor connected to Princess Zelda. According to Penn, people at the Stable are hearing a voice that sounds like Zelda's echoing from Fural Plain night after night. Penn investigated himself but fled after hearing it and becoming frightened. He questions if the voice was really Zelda's and reminds Link all they can do is look for the truth. He then suggests they investigate together and tells Link to come speak to him again at night.
Once night falls, Penn will fly out into Fural Plain and call for Link to follow him. However, upon hearing the mysterious voice nearby, he becomes so scared he cannot move. Link can follow the voice to the Haran Lakefront Well, where he will find Sagessa singing. When confronted, Sagessa is confused by what Link is talking about. She then explains what she was actually singing. Since people were throwing Weapons down the Well in accordance with what they thought the voice was saying, Sagessa put them in a pile near the wall since they could be dangerous. She tells Link he is free to take them if he wants.
Back outside the Well, Link explains the situation to Penn, who muses the Well both made Sagessa's voice sound like Zelda's and distorted her words. Penn thanks Link for his help and rewards him before flying off to write an article on the story.
overview_zh:
在“潜在公主 sighting！”侧任务中，林可以找到佩恩在海伦稳定寻找与公主塞尔达有关的传闻。根据佩恩的话，稳定的工作人员晚上经常听到一个声音，这个声音听起来像是塞尔达的声音，并从法尔平开荡声响。佩恩自己也去调查，但在听到后变得恐惧而逃离。他质疑这是否真的是塞尔达的声音，提醒林他们只能寻找真相。然后，他建议两人一起调查，并要求林在晚上再次与他联系。
夜幕降临时，佩恩会飞到法尔平，并呼唤林跟随。然而，当他听到附近神秘的低语声时，他变得非常恐惧，无法动弹。林可以跟随着声音来到哈兰湖畔的水井，在那里他会发现萨格莎在唱歌。当被告知时，萨格莎对林所说的内容感到困惑。她解释说，由于人们根据他们认为声音所说的内容，向水井扔武器，因此萨格莎把它们放在墙边附近积攒。她说，如果林想要，他可以拿走这些武器。
回到水井外，林向佩恩说明了情况，佩恩评论这或许是水井让萨格莎的声音听起来像是塞拉的，并扭曲了她的话语。佩恩感谢林帮助了他，并给予他报酬后飞走了再次写报道。

overview_en:
After starting the Main Quest "Regional Phenomena", Link can encounter the Monster-Control Crew, Squad One north of the Hyrule Garrison Ruins. When Link speaks to the Squad's captain, Hoz, he greets him, recalling that they previously met at Hyrule Castle. He reintroduces himself as the captain of Squad One, and he reveals that he has returned to fighting Monsters. Hoz then informs Link that they are planning to attack the Monster Forces at a Monster Fort nearby, and he invites Link to join them. Following this conversation, "Bring Peace to Hyrule Field!" will begin.
As the Monster-Control Crew approaches the Monster Fort, Hoz will warn them to be careful. Outside of the Fort, he orders his soldiers to stop and regroup, after which he commands them to attack. Upon entering the Monster Fort, the Monster Forces inside will begin to attack Link and the soldiers. During the attack, Hoz stays behind to give orders and help possible survivors. His squad relentlessly attacks the Monsters until every single one is slain. If they take too much damage, they will be knocked out.
Once all of the Monsters have been defeated, Hoz commends his Squad for their efforts. He then thanks Link and asks him to meet with him outside of the Monster Fort. After exiting the Fort, Hoz makes note of Link's combat abilities. If Link does not have the Master Sword equipped, Hoz will then ask him about its location. If Link does have the Master Sword, however, Hoz will be impressed by its divine glow, and he is grateful to have seen it. As a reward for his assistance, Hoz gives Link a Silver Rupee, which was part of the bounty for the Monster-Control Crew. Next, Hoz plans to bring the Monster Control Crew, Squad One to Fort Hateno in Necluda. Hoz and his soldiers cheer for Link, praying that Hylia protects him. "Bring Peace to Hyrule Field!" will then be completed.
overview_zh:
在完成主线任务“区域现象”后，林克可以遇到位于海拉鲁要塞废墟北部的“怪物控制部，一号部队”。当林克与该部队的队长霍兹交谈时，他向林克问好，回忆起他们之前曾在海拉鲁城堡相遇。他自我介绍为一号部队的指挥官，并透露他已恢复战斗。 霍兹随后告知林克，他们计划袭击附近的怪物据点，并邀请林克加入。 此后，“解放海拉鲁平原！”任务开始。
当“怪物控制部，一号部队”接近怪物据点时，霍兹警告他们小心。 在据点的外部，他命令士兵停止并重新集结，然后下令攻击。 进入怪物据点后，内部的怪物部队将向林克和士兵发起攻击。 战斗中，霍兹留在后方指挥并帮助可能的幸存者。 他带领士兵持续攻击怪物，直到所有怪物都被消灭。 如果他们受到太大的伤害，会失去战斗能力。
当所有怪物被击败后，霍兹赞扬了他的部队的努力。 然后他感谢林克并邀请他与自己在怪物据点的外部见面。 离开据点后，霍兹注意到了林克的战斗能力。 如果林克没有持有圣剑，他会询问它的位置。 但是，如果林克持有了圣剑，霍兹会对它的神圣光芒感到惊讶，并且感谢能看到它。 作为对他的协助的奖励，霍兹给予林克一枚银币，这是“怪物控制部”的任务的一部分。 接下来，霍兹计划带领“怪物控制部，一号部队”前往位于内丘的哈特诺要塞。 霍兹和他的士兵为林克欢呼，祈祷海拉保护他。 “解放海拉鲁平原！”任务完成后。

overview_en:
There are three ways to begin this Side Adventure, depending on progression in other parts of the story.
If Link has not completed "Tulin of Rito Village", "Yunobo of Goron City", "Sidon of the Zora", "Riju of Gerudo Town", or freed the Great Deku Tree from Phantom Ganon, Hestu can be found at Lindor's Brow, near the Lindor's Brow Skyview Tower, cowering in fear from a group of "scary trees". Speaking to him will initiate the first stage of the Side Adventure, where the Evermeans must be defeated. Defeating them then progresses to the second stage, where Hestu is in need of a Korok Seed for his Maracas.
If Link has completed at least one of "Tulin of Rito Village", "Yunobo of Goron City", "Sidon of the Zora", or "Riju of Gerudo Town" but not freed the Great Deku Tree, Hestu can be found at various spots around Lookout Landing. If the Side Adventure was not already completed at Lindor's Brow, speaking to Hestu will begin the Side Adventure at the second stage, where he requests a Korok Seed.
When Link has freed the Great Deku Tree from Phantom Ganon, Hestu will then remain in Korok Forest. If the Side Adventure was not already completed at Lindor's Brow or Lookout Landing, speaking to Hestu will begin the Side Adventure at the second stage where he requests a Korok Seed.
In any case, the Side Adventure is completed upon giving Hestu one Korok Seed in exchange for expanding an Inventory slot. At Lindor's Brow, he will let Link trade Korok Seeds for one more upgrade before leaving, and at Lookout Landing or Korok Forest he will remain to provide as many upgrades as Link can exchange for.
overview_zh:
根据故事的进展，有三种方法开始这个支线任务。

如果林克尚未完成“图林的任务（Rito Village）”、“尤诺波的任务（Goron City）”、“西登的任务（Zora）”、“里朱的任务（Gerudo Town）”，或释放了大德库树，则可在 Lindor's Brow 附近，靠近 Lindor's Brow Skyview Tower，找到 Hestu，他正被一群“可怕的树”吓得瑟瑟发抖。与他交谈将启动支线任务的第一阶段，即必须击败 Evermeans。击败他们后，进入第二阶段，此时 Hestu 需要一颗 Korok 种子来制作 Maracas。

如果林克已经完成了“图林的任务（Rito Village）”、“尤诺波的任务（Goron City）”、“西登的任务（Zora）”或“里朱的任务（Gerudo Town）”，但尚未释放了大德库树，则可在 Lookout Landing 的各个地点找到 Hestu。如果在 Lindor's Brow 处未进行支线任务，与他交谈将在第二阶段启动支线任务，此时他会要求一颗 Korok 种子。

当林克释放了大德库树时，Hestu 将留在 Korok Forest。如果在 Lindor's Brow 或 Lookout Landing 处尚未完成支线任务，与他交谈将启动支线任务的第二阶段，此时他会要求一颗 Korok 种子。
无论如何，完成支线任务的方式是：给予 Hestu 一颗 Korok 种子以换取扩充 Inventory slot 。 在 Lindor's Brow 处，Hestu 会让林克用一棵 Korok Seed 来升级，之后回到 Lookout Landing 或 Korok Forest，他将一直提供给林克升级的机会。

name_en: Legend of the Great Sky Island
overview_en:
The "Legend of the Great Sky Island" is only available after Link completes any two Dungeons related to the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quest and obtains the Zora Armor, which is received upon completion of the "Restoring the Zora Armor" Main Quest. After this, a Steward Construct will appear on the rooftop of the Temple of Time on the Great Sky Island. It will emit a light atop the Temple when Link is at a distance to signal its presence.

By speaking to the Construct, Link can initiate the Side Adventure. The Steward Construct explains that it is there to fulfill its role in performing a ceremony. The purpose of this ceremony is to test individuals to see if they are worthy to hear the story of the Great Sky Island.
If Link agrees to attempt the ceremony, the Steward Construct explains its rules. Participants must light the three unlit Bonfires scattered across the Great Sky Island within the span of 12 hours. As a means of measuring the time, the ceremony is conducted in between the tolls of the Time Bell, which rings at 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM each day to signal the start and end of day for the residents of the Garden of Time. In order to start on time, the Construct asks Link to wait for the morning toll. When the morning bell rings, the Construct explains the final stipulation of the ceremony: challengers are not permitted to touch ground on any surface except for the top of the Temple of Time.
As part of the challenge, several small Sky Islands appear throughout the Great Sky Island. These Sky Islands each bear Waterfalls, which Link is intended to climb with the power of the Zora Armor. However, it is possible to complete the ceremony by using Zonai Devices as well. The locations of these Bonfires are marked on Link's Map, and are as follows:

Upon successfully lighting all three Bonfires and returning to the rooftop of the Temple of Time without setting foot on any part of the Great Sky Island, Link will be congratulated as the Steward Construct explains the tale of how the Great Sky Island came to float in the Sky after previously sat on the Surface. According to the Steward Construct, it was chosen as a place for a future hero to be kept safe from Demon King Ganondorf's reach. After the Imprisoning War, the remnants of the ancient Six Sages united to raise it into the Sky for this reason, and tasked the Steward Construct with awarding the Zonai Fabric to the one who would complete the ceremony. This concludes the Side Adventure.
Link is unable to attempt the ceremony again after this. The small Sky Islands will also disappear upon completion of the ceremony. The Steward Construct will remain atop the Temple of Time to retell the story and asks that Link takes care of the Paraglider Fabric that it gave him.
overview_zh:
“天空之岛的传说”只有在林克完成与“区域现象”主线任务相关的任意两个地下城，并获得“恢复祖拉盔甲”的主线任务后才能开启。之后，一个管家机关会在天空之岛的《时间神殿》屋顶上出现。当林克距离该机关一定时，它会发出光芒，以表明其存在。

通过与该机关交流，林克可以开始支线冒险。管家机关解释说，它的任务是进行仪式。这个仪式的目的是测试个人是否能够听到关于天空之岛的故事。
如果林克同意尝试这项仪式，管家机关将解释规则：参赛者必须在 12 小时内点燃天空之岛上散布的三座未燃的篝火。为了测量时间，该仪式将在《时间神殿》每天早上 7:00 和晚上 7:00 的钟声之间进行，以便向花园居民告知一天何时开始和结束。为了准时开始，机关要求林克等待早上的钟声。当早上的钟声响起后，机关会解释仪式最后的规定：挑战者不得在天空之岛的任何部分（除了《时间神殿》屋顶）以外的地面上踏足。
作为一项挑战的一部分，天空之岛上会出现多个小岛屿。这些小岛屿都具有瀑布，林克需要使用祖拉盔甲的力量爬上去。然而，也可以使用祖尼设备来完成仪式。这些篝火的位置已标记在林克的地图上，如下所示：

一旦成功点燃所有三座篝火并返回《时间神殿》的屋顶，而不踏足天空之岛上的任何部分，林克将被管家机关宣布完成了仪式，并讲述了天空之岛的故事，即它原本位于地面上，后来被抬了起来。根据管家机关的说法，这片土地被选为未来英雄能够远离魔王甘农达的据点。在囚禁战争后，古代六位贤者团结起来将它升到空中，并委托该管家机关颁发祖尼布料给完成仪式的人。此举标志着支线冒险结束。
林克无法再次尝试这项仪式。完成仪式后，小岛也会消失。管家机关会停留在《时间神殿》的屋顶上，讲述故事，并要求林克妥善保管它给予他的滑翔翼布料。

overview_en: After completing the second stage of the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quest by awakening one of the Six Sages, a Sky Island falls to the ground and lands in the pond in the southwest of Lookout Landing, drawing the attention of its residents. Wortsworth, the Zonai Survey Team's expert on the Ancient Hyrulean language, inspects it and finds that a Stone Tablet on it contains text dating back to the Founding of the Kingdom of Hyrule.
overview_zh: 完成“区域现象”主线任务的第二个阶段，唤醒其中一位六位贤者后，一座天空岛坠落，落在 Lookout Landing西南角的池塘中，引起当地居民注意。沃特斯沃思，Zonai调查队的古代赫鲁族语言专家，检查了该岛并发现其中一块石碑上刻有文字，这些文字可以追溯到赫鲁王国建立的时期。

overview_en:
After draining the Water from the entrance to the Great Plateau, Link can find a small Bargainer Statue embedded in the ground. When examined, a Mysterious Voice speaks through the Statue, directing Link to speak to them at the Temple of Time Ruins. Once there, the explains that draining the Water freed a portion of their self. It then reveals that it originates from the Depths and is using the Temple of Time Statue to speak to him. At this point in the conversation, "A Call from the Depths" will begin.
The Mysterious Voice tasks Link with finding its four Eyes at the Great Plateau's Chasms and throwing them into the Depths, after which Link must bring them to a location beneath the Temple of Time Ruins. In return, it promises Link a reward. The four Eyes are located at the Great Plateau North Chasm, the Great Plateau East Chasm, the Great Plateau South Chasm, and the Great Plateau West Chasm.
When Link brings an Eye to the source of the Mysterious Voice, he will find that it is the Great Abandoned Central Mine Bargainer Statue, which is located in a room under the Great Abandoned Central Mine. The Statue will express its gratitude toward Link. It explains that its Eyes were stolen from it in ancient times, and it has been waiting since then for someone to hear it and help. As a reward, the Great Abandoned Central Mine Bargainer Statue rewards Link with a choice of a Heart Container or Stamina Vessel, provided Link has not fully upgraded one or the other already. After this, the Side Adventure will be completed, and Link will be able to speak with the Bargainer Statue again to expand its shop inventory and purchase items.
overview_zh:
在清理大平原入口的水后，林克可以找到一个嵌入地面的小商铺雕像。检查时，神秘的声音通过雕像与他交谈，指示他前往时间神殿遗址。在那里，它解释说，清理水使一部分它的自我获得了自由。然后，它透露自己来自深渊，并且利用时间神殿雕像与他交流。这时，“深渊的呼唤”将开始。
神秘的声音让林克在大平原的峡谷中找到它的四个眼睛，并将它们扔进深渊，之后林克必须把它们带到时间神殿遗址下的一个地点。作为回报，它向林克承诺给予报酬。这四个眼睛分别位于大平原北峡谷、大平原东峡谷、大平原南峡谷和大平原西峡谷。
当林克将一个眼睛带给神秘声音的来源时，他会发现那里是位于大废弃中央矿的商铺雕像，它位于大废弃中央矿下的一个房间里。 雕像表达了对林克的感谢。 它解释说，它的眼睛在古代被偷走，并且一直在等待有人听到并帮助它。作为回报，“大废弃中央矿商铺雕像”会给予林克选择一个生命容器或能量容器（前提是林克尚未完全升级其中一个）。 此时，侧任务将完成，林克可以再次与商铺雕像交谈，以扩展其商店的商品，并购买物品。

name_en: Master Kohga of the Yiga Clan
overview_en:
After Link defeats Master Kohga at the Great Abandoned Central Mine during the "A Mystery in the Depths" Main Quest, he complains that he cannot beat him. He proclaims that he will let Link off easy, gloating that he has already found other Abandoned Mines in the Depths. Since he saw Link use his Right Arm to activate the Steward Construct and receive Autobuild, Master Kohga plans on using the same method to receive the Ancient Power at another Mine, which he will use to destroy the world with someone he refers to as the "Magnificent One" as part of Operation Steal the Ancient Power. He then summons a Vehicle made from a Wing, a Steering Stick, and four Fans, which he flees on as he tells Link not to follow him. A Treasure Chest containing a Huge Crystallized Charge appears, and at this point, the "Master Kohga of the Yiga Clan" Side Adventure will begin.
Once Link opens the Treasure Chest, the nearby Steward Construct approaches him. It thanks Link for driving the Yiga Clan out of the Great Abandoned Central Mine, and it reveals that the Abandoned Mine that Master Kohga left for is likely the Abandoned Gerudo Mine. To find the Mine, it suggests that it follows the Statues That Point the Way, which start near the Koradat Lightroot. It also tells him to meet with the other Steward Construct at the Great Abandoned Central Mine, which has a Schema Stone to offer him.
Link can next find Master Kohga struggling to activate a Steward Construct at the Abandoned Gerudo Mine. He initially thinks Link is one of his subordinates and tells him to try, but he soon realizes that it is Link. Master Kohga accuses Link of tricking him, as he has been unable to replicate Link's ability to activate Steward Constructs. He declares that he is going to fight Link and take Autobuild from him, and to this end, he summons a flying vehicle to use during their battle.
After Link defeats Master Kohga for the second time, he blames his loss on the Sand getting in his eyes. He decides to give up on Operation Steal the Ancient Power, revealing that the Yiga Clan have been collecting Crystallized Charges to restore the Ultimate Weapon for the Magnificent One to destroy the world with. He leaves for another Abandoned Mine, allowing Link to freely explore the Abandoned Gerudo Mine. Another stone Treasure Chest containing a Huge Crystallized Charge appears.
A Steward Construct residing at the Abandoned Gerudo Mine approaches Link, thanking him for getting rid of the Yiga Clan. It informs Link that Master Kohga is likely heading to the Abandoned Lanayru Mine. Since none of the Statues That Point the Way in the area lead to the Mine, the Steward Construct suggests using any Chasms in or around Lanayru. One Chasm, the Lanayru Wetlands Chasm, can be found in the Lanayru Wetlands, while the East Hill Chasm can be found near a Village in the mountains to the south.
At the Abandoned Lanayru Mine, Link can find Master Kohga once again failing to activate a Steward Construct. When he turns around, he is shocked to see Link standing behind him, and he accuses Link of trying to catch him off guard. Master Kohga explains that although the Yiga Clan's plan has changed, he was killing time by attempting to activate the Construct, since they have already mined everything in the area. Annoyed that Link followed him again, Master Kohga claims he is too busy ending the world to fight him one-on-one. Teleporting over the Water surrounding the Abandoned Mine, Master Kohga summons a Headlight Raft and two Yiga Footsoldiers. He then commands them to attack Link on his behalf.
The third time Master Kohga is defeated, he blames his Steering Stick for getting wet. He taunts Link, claiming that he already found all of the Crystallized Charges at the Abandoned Lanayru Mine before he arrived. He also reveals that the Yiga Clan has discovered the location of the Magnificent One, Demon King Ganondorf, and they are now close to destroying the world. Now that the Yiga Clan have enough Crystallized Charges, Master Kohga plans on raiding the final Abandoned Mine, at which point they will activate the Ultimate Weapon, offer it to the Demon King, and end the world. He tells Link that their next encounter will be the last. Master Kohga flies away on his Vehicle yet again, promising that Link will get what he deserves. Another stone Treasure Chest containing a Huge Crystallized Charge then appears.
The Abandoned Lanayru Mine's Steward Construct approaches Link, thanking him for getting rid of the intruders. It claims that it listened to his conversation with Master Kohga, and it believes that he is going to the Abandoned Hebra Mine. It reveals that there was a path from the Hyrule Ridge Depths that lead to the Mine, but it is no longer viable. However, it is able to remember there being a Chasm that leads directly to the Abandoned Hebra Mine.
In Rito Village, Link can find Ponnick standing along the southern edge. He greets Link, recalling that they have not seen each other since meeting at the Hyrule Field Chasm. Ponnick reveals that Josha tasked him with searching for a Chasm near Rito Village, which he was successful in doing. He points out the Rito Village Chasm to Link, which is located in a small cavern directly below them. Following a rest, he plans to report it to Josha, and he warns Link to be careful if he explores the Chasm.
At the Abandoned Hebra Mine, Link can find Master Kohga sitting in front of a Relay Base. He claims he was waiting for Link, and he informs him that the Yiga Clan have gathered enough Crystallized Charges to completely restore their Ultimate Weapon. He claims that today is the day they resurrect the Ultimate Weapon and destroy the world. Master Kohga then summons the Ultimate Weapon, which is revealed to be a modified Crafter Construct. Master Kohga plans on defeating Link, at which point he will join Demon King Ganondorf Beneath Hyrule Castle. An electric fence then rises from the ground, surrounding the arena. Master Kohga taunts Link, after which the fight begins.
Once Master Kohga has been defeated for the final time, he is disappointed that the Ultimate Weapon has been destroyed. He expresses his anger to Link, threatening to to seek revenge. Laughing, Master Kohga reveals a new technique he came up with in the Depths. He then summons the Kohga Rocket, and as he threatens Link, it begins to tilt toward Master Kohga. When he attempts to launch the Kohga Rocket, he accidentally shoots it at himself, causing him to be stuck at its end while it flails around the Abandoned Hebra Mine. He swears revenge on Link, before he is rocketed out of the Rito Village Chasm. Two stone Treasure Chests containing a Huge Crystallized Charge and a Diamond appear, after which "Master Kohga of the Yiga Clan" will be completed.
overview_zh:
链接在“深渊中的谜团”主任务中击败了梅斯特·科加后，抱怨无法战胜他。 他声称会轻松让链接获胜，并得意地说自己已经找到了其他废弃矿藏。 由于他看到链接使用了右臂激活管家构造机并获得自动构建，所以梅斯提·科加计划使用相同方法在另一座矿洞中获得古代力量，并将用该力量通过“伟大的存在”毁灭世界，这是“Yiga 氏族”的一部分。 然后他召唤了一辆由翅膀、方向杆和四个风扇制成的车辆，并告诉链接不要跟随他。 出现了一个包含巨大的结晶化能量的宝箱，此时，“Yiga 氏族的梅斯特·科加”侧剧情将开始。
一旦链接打开宝箱，附近的管家构造机会向他走去，感谢链接已把Yiga 氏族赶出“大废弃中央矿”，并透露已离开的矿藏很可能是“废弃杰鲁朵矿”。 他建议跟随“指引之路上的雕像”，这些雕像靠近“Koradat Lightroot”。 他还告诉让他与另一台管家构造机在“大废弃中央矿”会面，那里有一个可以提供给他。
链接接下来可以在“废弃杰鲁朵矿”中看到梅斯特·科加努力激活管家构造机。“最初他认为那是个下属”，并命令他尝试。但他很快意识到这是链接，梅斯提·科加控诉链接欺骗了他，因为他无法复制链接激活管家构造机的能力，他说道自己要与链接战斗，夺走他的“自动构建”，为了实现这个目的，他召唤了一辆飞行的车辆用于他们的战斗。
在链接第二次击败梅斯特·科加后，他归咎于沙子进入了他的眼睛。他决定放弃“夺取古代力量”的计划，并透露Yiga 氏族一直在收集结晶化能量来恢复“最终武器”，供“伟大的存在”用以毁灭世界。 他离开了另一座废矿，让链接可以自由探索“废弃杰鲁朵矿”。 又出现一个包含巨大的结晶化能量的石头宝箱。

在“废弃杰鲁朵矿”，管家构造机向链接走去，感谢他赶走了Yiga 氏族。 它告知链接，梅斯特·科加很可能要前往“废弃兰瑞乌矿”。 因为该地区的几个“指引之路上的雕像”都没有通往矿洞，因此他说，可以使用兰瑞乌矿附近的任何峡谷，“兰瑞乌湿地峡谷”，可以在“兰瑞乌森林”中找到。 另一个“东山峡谷”，可以在靠近南部的山村的村庄附近找到。
在“废弃兰瑞乌矿”，链接可以再次发现梅斯特·科加无法激活管家构造机。 当他转过身时，他震惊地看到链接站在他身后，并告之他试图设伏。 梅斯提·科加解释说，虽然Yiga 氏族的计划已经改变了，但他是为了拖延时间而试图激活该构造机，因为他们已经开采了该区域的全部资源。他烦恼于“链接”又一次跟踪他，梅斯提·科加声称他太忙以让他与他正面交战。 从矿洞周围的水中传送，梅斯提·科加召唤了两个Yigal脚步士兵和一艘“光束小船”。 然后他命令他们袭击联系人。
在链接第三次击败梅斯特·科加之后，他归咎于他的“方向杆”被弄湿了。 他嘲弄链接，声称自己已经在“废弃兰瑞乌矿”中找到了所有结晶化能量之前就到达那里，他也透露Yiga 氏族已经发现了“伟大的存在”，恶魔之王甘多尔夫，并且他们现在即将毁灭世界。 现在Yiga 氏族拥有已足够数量的结晶化能量，梅斯提·科加计划进攻最后的废矿，“此时”他们将激活最终武器并将其交给甘多尔夫，从而结束世界。“他告诉链接，他们的下一次遭遇将被认为是最后一次”，然后再飞去，承诺会让他受制于人。 另一个的石头宝箱里包含一个巨大的结晶化能量和一颗钻石，之后“Yiga 氏族的梅斯特·科加”将会完成。

name_zh: 萨托利山的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
There are two methods to start "The Satori Mountain Crystal". The first is by activating the Travel Point in front of the Usazum Shrine. The second is by interacting with the Shrine of Light's respective Mysterious Crystal. In either scenario, Link will hear a Mysterious Voice, telling him to bring the Crystal to the Usazum Shrine in exchange for a Light of Blessing. Upon hearing the voice, a beam connecting the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine will appear, and the Shrine Quest will begin.
The Mysterious Crystal corresponding to the Usazum Shrine can be found hanging from the neck of the Hinox that patrols the interior of the Satori Mountain Foothill Cave. The Hinox will drop the Crystal upon its defeat, at which point Link will be able to pick it up and bring it to the Usazum Shrine. At the Shrine, the Mysterious Voice will speak again, honoring its promise to give him a Light of Blessing. The Crystal will then expand in size, revealing itself to be the Shrine's entrance. Afterwards, "The Satori Mountain Crystal" will be completed.
overview_zh:
启动“圣悟峰水晶”有两方法：

1.  激活位于乌扎姆神殿前的传送点。
2.  与圣光神殿的神秘水晶互动。

无论采用哪种方法，林克都会听到神秘的声音，告知他将水晶带到乌扎姆神殿以换取祝福之光。 听到声音后，会形成一条连接神秘水晶和神殿的光束，并开始神殿任务。

与乌扎姆神殿相对应的神秘水晶悬挂在佐托峰山麓洞穴内的希诺斯身上。 击败希诺斯后，它会掉落水晶，林克就可以拾起并将水晶带到乌扎姆神殿。 在神殿，神秘的声音再次出现，兑现了它的承诺，给予林克祝福之光。 水晶随即变大，显示出神殿入口。 完成“圣悟峰水晶”。

overview_en:
After completing the Main Quest "Tulin of Rito Village", Link can find Laissa looking out west from Rito Village, trying to remember the location of something she saw. If he speaks to her, she will mention a Cave before greeting him. She recognizes Link as the individual who helped Tulin end the Extreme Cold Snap, and she explains that it is now easier for the Rito to find Caves to scavenge Food from. Laissa reveals that while she was looking for a white Bird, she saw a Shrine of Light inside of a Cave, but she cannot remember where it was. At this point in their conversation, "The White Bird's Guidance"s begin.
Laissa mentions that that Cave was stocked with Mushrooms and Fish, and she reiterates that she found it while seeking out a white Bird. If Link asks about the Bird, Laissa explains that she was on Vah Medoh's Perch in the morning when she saw the white Bird sitting on the shadow of Rito Village's spire. She went to investigate, and though she lost track of the Bird, she found the entrance to a Cave instead. If Link asks about further details, Laissa is unable to remember any beyond the white Bird and the Shrine of Light inside.
At 5:00 AM, the shadow of Vah Medoh's Perch will pass under a stretch of Snow shaped like a Bird, which is situated west of Rito Village. When Link reaches the Bird, he will find the entrance to the West Lake Totori Cave. After traversing through the Cave, he will reach the Wao-os Shrine, which completes "The White Bird's Guidance".
overview_zh:
完成主线任务“里多村的图林”后，林克可以在里多村西侧找到莱莎，她正在试图回忆某个地方的位置。如果与她交谈，她会提到一个洞穴，然后向林克问好。她认识到林克是帮助图林结束极端寒冷的英雄，并解释说现在更容易让里多族人找到可以采集食物的洞穴。莱莎透露，她在寻找白色的鸟的时候，在一个洞穴中看到了光之神殿，但她无法回忆起具体位置。此时，他们之间的对话将开始“白鸟指引”。

莱莎提到那个洞穴里有蘑菇和鱼，并且她是在寻找白色的鸟时找到的。如果林克询问关于这只鸟，莱莎解释说，她早上在瓦赫梅多塔的第一层，看到一只白色的鸟栖息在里多村尖塔的阴影下。她去调查，虽然失去了鸟，但却找到了一个洞穴入口。如果林克进一步询问，莱莎只能回忆起白色的鸟和洞穴中的光之神殿。

早上5点，瓦赫梅多塔的第一层边缘的雪形成了鸟状，位于里多村西侧。当林克到达这只鸟时，他将找到通往西湖托托里的洞穴入口。通过这个洞穴，他将到达瓦奥斯神殿，从而完成“白鸟指引”。

name_zh: 沉睡于吉萨的环形山的水晶
overview_en:
There are two methods to start "The Gisa Crater Crystal". The first is by activating the Travel Point in front of the Ikatak Shrine. The second is by interacting with the Shrine of Light's respective Mysterious Crystal. In either scenario, Link will hear a Mysterious Voice, telling him to bring the Crystal to the Ikatak Shrine in exchange for a Light of Blessing. Upon hearing the voice, a beam connecting the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine will appear, and the Shrine Quest will begin.
The Mysterious Crystal corresponding to the Ikatak Shrine can be found in between two Ice Likes in the nearby Gisa Crater Cave. When Link brings it to the Shrine, the Mysterious Voice will speak again, honoring its promise to give him a Light of Blessing. The Crystal will then expand in size, revealing itself to be the Shrine's entrance. Afterwards, "The Gisa Crater Crystal" will be completed.
overview_zh:
要启动“吉萨陨石水晶”，有以下两种方法：

1.  激活伊卡塔克神殿前的传送点。
2.  与光明神殿的神秘水晶互动。

在任何情况下，林克都会听到神秘的声音，告知他将水晶带到伊卡塔克神殿以换取祝福之光。 听到声音后，连接神秘水晶和神殿的光束将会出现，神殿任务开始。

对应于伊卡塔克神殿的神秘水晶位于附近的吉萨陨石洞穴中两块冰柱之间。 当林克将它带到神殿时，神秘的声音会再次响起，兑现了给予祝福之光的承诺。 水晶会扩大，并显示出作为神殿入口。 之后，“吉萨陨石水晶”任务完成。

name_zh: 海布拉山北方的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
Link has two methods by which he can start "The North Hebra Mountains Crystal". The first is by interacting with the Travel Point in front of the Sisuran Shrine, which is located at Hebra East Summit North. The second is by touching the Mysterious Crystal that corresponds to the Shrine. In both cases, a Mysterious Voice will speak to him, requesting that he bring the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine of Light in exchange for a Light of Blessing. Afterwards, a beam will appear that connects the Shrine and the Crystal, and the Shrine Quest will begin.
The Sisuran Shrine's Mysterious Crystal can be found embedded in the Ore Deposit of a Frost Talus that lies dormant nearby, which must be defeated in order to obtain the Crystal. From this point, he can bring the Crystal to the Shrine of Light by either carrying it or using Ultrahand. Once he does so, the Mysterious Voice speaks again to honor its promise. At this point, the Crystal expands in size, revealing that it is the entrance to the Sisuran Shrine. Link will now be able to enter the Shrine, and "The North Hebra Mountains Crystal" will be completed.
overview_zh:
链接可以通过两种方式开始“北赫布拉山脉水晶”：

1.  与位于赫布拉东峰北部，Sisuran神殿前的旅行点互动。
2.  触摸与神殿相对应的神秘水晶。

在两种情况下，一个神秘的声音会告知他，要求将神秘水晶带到光明神殿，以换取祝福的光芒。之后，一个连接神殿和水晶的束光将出现，并开始神殿任务。

位于赫布拉东峰北部的Sisuran神殿的神秘水晶，可以从附近的“冰霜巨石”矿脉中找到（需要击败该巨石）。然后，链接可以通过携带或使用Ultrahand的方式将水晶带到光明神殿。完成之后，神秘的声音再次告知他，履行承诺。此时，水晶会变大，以示其作为Sisuran神殿的入口。链接现在可以进入神殿，并完成“北赫布拉山脉水晶”任务。

name_zh: 沉睡于海布拉山西北的洞窟中的水晶
overview_en:
"The Northwest Hebra Cave Crystal" can be started via two separate methods. The first is by activating the Travel Point that correlates to Rutafu-um Shrine inside of the Hebra Mountains Northwest Cave. The second is by interacting with the Mysterious Crystal located nearby. In either scenario, a Mysterious Voice will speak to Link and instruct him to bring the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine of Light, with the goal of receiving a Light of Blessing. Following this, a green light will appear that connects the Crystal and the Shrine, and "The Northwest Hebra Cave Crystal" will begin.
The Mysterious Crystal that corresponds to Rutafu-um Shrine can be found submerged in a pool of Cold Water that is located in front of the Shrine. By standing on a platform that floats in Water, Link can use Ultrahand to lift the Crystal out of the pool. Alternatively, he can attach one of the Icicles inside of the Cave to the Crystal with Ultrahand, which he can then use to pull it to the shore. Upon bringing the Mysterious Crystal to Rutafu-um Shrine, it will grow in size, revealing the Shrine's entrance. Afterwards, the Shrine Quest will be completed, and Link will be able to enter the Shrine.
overview_zh:
“西北赫布拉洞穴水晶”可以通过两种方法开始。第一种是通过激活与赫布拉山脉西北洞穴内的鲁塔夫-乌神殿对应的传送点。第二种是通过与附近的神秘水晶互动。无论哪种方式，神秘的声音都会向林克指示将神秘水晶带到光之神殿，以获得祝福的光。之后，会有一个绿色的连接出现，将水晶和神殿连接起来，“西北赫布拉洞穴水晶”开始。
与鲁塔夫-乌神殿相对应的神秘水晶位于神殿前的寒水池中。林克可以在水中漂浮的平台上使用Ultrahand，将水晶从池中取出。或者，他可以使用Ultrahand将洞穴内的冰柱连接到水晶上，然后用它将其拉到岸边。将神秘水晶带到鲁塔夫-乌神殿后，水晶会变大，露出神殿入口。之后，神殿任务完成，林克可以进入神殿。

name_en: A Pretty Stone and Five Golden Apples
overview_en:
After defeating the Phantom Ganon inside the Great Deku Tree, Damia can be found with a Mysterious Crystal near the eastern entrance to Korok Forest. When spoken to, he expresses how pretty the Crystal is. If Link asks for it, Damia will initially refuse, but he reveals he will give it up should Link do something for him. If Link agrees to help, Damia claims he will relinquish the Crystal if he brings him five Golden Apples.
To help, Damia points Link toward Mido Swamp, where Golden Apples are known to grow. He warns Link of both Monsters and the Swamp's Bottomless Bog. However, he does not care whether the Golden Apples come from Mido Swamp or not. Following this conversation, "A Pretty Stone and Five Golden Apples" will begin.
Once Link is in possession of at least five Golden Apples, he can return to give them to Damia. Upon receiving the Golden Apples, Damia will allow Link to take the Mysterious Crystal.
The next phase of "A Pretty Stone and Five Golden Apples" is activated by either interacting with the Mysterious Crystal or activating the Travel Point of the Pupunke Shrine. Doing so will cause him to hear a Mysterious Voice, which offers him a Light of Blessing if he can bring the Crystal to the Shrine of Light. A beam of Light then appears connecting the Mysterious Crystal and the Shrine. After bringing the Crystal to the Shrine, the Mysterious Voice will acknowledge Link and honors its promise. The Mysterious Crystal will then grow in size, revealing itself to be the entrance to the Pupunke Shrine. Afterwards, "A Pretty Stone and Five Golden Apples" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在击败大德鲁树中的幻影加农后，Damia可以在位于科洛克森林东入口附近的神秘水晶旁找到。与他交谈时，他会赞叹水晶的美丽。如果林克要求这块水晶，Damia最初会拒绝，但他表示如果林克为他做一些事情，他就会将其交给林克。如果林克同意帮助，Damia声称只要他能带给他五个金苹果，他就会将水晶交给林克。

为了帮忙，Damia引导林克前往米多沼泽，那里有金苹果生长。他警告林克关于怪物和沼泽底部，但他不在乎金苹果是否来自米多沼泽。对话结束后，“美丽的石头和五颗黄金苹果”开始。

一旦林克拥有至少五个金苹果，他就可以返回并将其交给Damia。收到金苹果后，Damia允许林克拿走神秘水晶。

“美丽的石头和五颗黄金苹果”的下一阶段由与神秘的水晶或激活普普恩克神殿的旅行点来触发。这会导致他听到一个神秘的声音，声称如果他能将水晶带到光明神殿，就会赠予他祝福的光芒。然后出现一道连接水晶和光明神殿的光束。将水晶带到光明神殿后，神秘的声音会认可林克，并兑现承诺。神秘的水晶会变大，露出了通往普普恩克神殿的入口。之后，“美丽的石头和五颗黄金苹果”就完成了。

name_zh: 死亡破火山口的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
There are two methods to start "The Death Caldera Crystal". The first is by activating the Travel Point in front of the Momosik Shrine. The second is by interacting with the Shrine of Light's respective Mysterious Crystal. In either scenario, Link will hear a Mysterious Voice, telling him to bring the Crystal to the Momosik Shrine in exchange for a Light of Blessing. Upon hearing the voice, a beam connecting the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine will appear, and the Shrine Quest will begin.
The Mysterious Crystal corresponding to the Momosik Shrine can be found in the Death Mountain East Tunnel, which is initially blocked by blue Hard Sediment. The Crystal is also a part of the Ore Deposit of an Igneo Talus, which Link must defeat before being able to bring it to the Shrine. At the Shrine, the Mysterious Voice will speak again, honoring its promise to give him a Light of Blessing. The Crystal will then expand in size, revealing itself to be the Shrine's entrance. Afterwards, "The Death Caldera Crystal" will be completed.
overview_zh:
启动“死亡熔岩之晶”有两方法。第一种是激活在모모식神前的位置的传送点。第二种是与光明神祠对应的神秘水晶互动。无论哪种方式，林克都会听到神秘的声音，要求他将水晶带到모모식神，以换取祝福的光。听到的声音后，一个连接神秘水晶和神祠的光束会显示出来，神祠任务开始。
对应于모모식神的神奇水晶可以在死亡山东隧道中找到，该隧道最初被蓝色硬质沉积物阻挡。水晶也位于Igneo Talus的矿石堆中，林克需要先击败它才能将其带到神祠。在神祠，神秘的声音会再次响起，履行了之前承诺提供祝福的光。水晶会变大，显示出是神祠入口。之后，“死亡熔岩之晶”任务完成。

name_zh: 沉睡于幽芬湖的洞窟中的水晶
overview_zh: 目标：

overview_en:
At some point, a resident of Tarrey Town named Hagie chanced upon a Mysterious Crystal in the nearby Hudson Construction Site. Thinking it valuable, he took it with him intending to sell it to someone for a boon. However in spending more time with the Crystal, he grew disturbed by it and is now eager to sell it quickly.
The Shrine Quest begins after Link expresses curiosity about the Crystal. Hagie explains how he found it and offers to sell it to Link for 100 Rupees. Link can agree to the price or haggle for something lower, to which Haggie offers to sell for 80 Rupees instead. Regardless of Link's answer, the Shrine Quest begins as Hagie's wife, Ruli, interrupts and scolds him for trying to sell junk to people. She dismisses the Crystal as a large piece of Flint and estimates it as no more than 50 Rupees in value. Though Hagie tries to reason with her that Link may have been willing to settle for a higher price, he falters at his wife's expression and caves.
If Link denies the offer, Ruli continues to scold Hagie for damaging the spirit of Tarrey Town. However, if Link agrees to buy it, Hagie moves the Crystal behind his station and informs Link that he will accept no refunds on the deal. With a successful purchase, the Shrine Quest will be complete.
overview_zh:
在塔雷镇，一位名叫哈吉的居民偶然在附近的休斯顿建设工地发现了一块神秘的宝石。他认为这块宝石很有价值，于是打算将其出售给他人换取报酬。然而，当哈吉与这块宝石相处的时间越长，他就越感到不安，现在急于尽快将其卖掉。

当链接对这块宝石表现出兴趣时，“神殿任务”开始。哈吉向链接解释了他如何找到这块宝石，并以100卢比的价格出售给链接。链接可以选择接受这个价格或进行讨价还价，哈吉则提供以80卢比的价格出售。无论链接的答案如何，神殿任务就会开始，因为哈吉的妻子鲁利会打断他，并斥责他试图将垃圾卖给别人。她认为这块宝石只是一块普通的燧石，价值不超过50卢比。虽然哈吉尝试说服她，认为链接可能愿意支付更高的价格，但最终还是被妻子的表情所影响，妥协了。

如果链接拒绝购买，鲁利会继续斥责哈吉，指责他破坏了塔雷镇的传统。但是，如果链接同意购买，哈吉会将宝石放在他的工作台后面，并告知链接，此次交易不接受退货。完成这次购买后，“神殿任务”就完成了。

overview_en:
On Quatta's Shelf, Link can find a Steward Construct that claims to have information among a group of Sky Island ruins. When spoken to, the Steward reveals that a Shrine of Light can be found in the area, and it is the Shrine's keeper. To find the Shrine, Link must follow a riddle, which states, "Dye the white pattern black when the sun awakens in the sky. Then will the sacred shrine appear." After speaking to the Steward Construct, "Dyeing to Find It" will begin.
Near the Steward Construct is a level, which will rotate a rock structure when pushed. At 6:00 AM, the structure's shadow will be cast onto a white pattern on the ruins below. By orienting the structure correctly and inserting Boards into its slots, Link can shape its shadow to match the white pattern. When the pattern is completely covered by the shadow, Zonai writing will appear on top of it, and Kurakat Shrine will take form. Once the Shrine of Light appears, "Dyeing to Find It" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在“夸塔的架子”上，林克可以找到一个称作“管家构造体”的存在，据称它掌握着关于天空岛废墟的信息。与管家交谈后，它透露神圣之殿位于该区域，并且由神殿守护者保管。为了找到神殿，林克必须遵循谜题：“当太阳升起时，将白色图案染成黑色。然后，神圣之殿将会显现。” 在与“管家构造体”交谈后，“染色的寻光”阶段开始。

在“管家构造体”附近有一个平台，可以推动一个岩石结构旋转。在早上6点，该结构的阴影会投射到下面的废墟上的白色图案上。通过正确地调整结构并将其板插入槽中，林克可以将其阴影与白色图案对齐。当整个图案被阴影覆盖时，会在上面出现Zonai的文字，并形成神圣之殿。一旦神圣之殿显现，“染色的寻光”阶段完成。

name_zh: 高天之泉与光环的传说
name_en: The High Spring and the Light Rings
overview_zh: 目标：

name_zh: 拉聂尔参道的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
There are two methods to start "The Lanayru Road Crystal". The first is by activating the Travel Point in front of the O-ogim Shrine. The second is by interacting with the Shrine of Light's respective Mysterious Crystal. In either scenario, Link will hear a Mysterious Voice, telling him to bring the Crystal to the O-ogim Shrine in exchange for a Light of Blessing. Upon hearing the voice, a beam connecting the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine will appear, and the Shrine Quest will begin.
The Mysterious Crystal corresponding to the O-ogim Shrine can be found behind a breakable rock wall in the Lanayru Road South Cave, which Link can pick up and bring to the Shrine. At the Shrine, the Mysterious Voice will speak again, honoring its promise to give him a Light of Blessing. The Crystal will then expand in size, revealing itself to be the Shrine's entrance. Afterwards, "The Lanayru Road Crystal" will be completed.
overview_zh:
启动“兰雅鲁路水晶”有两种方法。第一种是激活在奥-吉姆神殿前的旅行点。第二种是在与光之神殿对应的神秘水晶互动。无论哪种方式，林克都会听到神秘的声音，指示他将水晶带到奥-吉姆神殿以换取祝福之光。听到声音后，水晶和神殿之间的连接将形成，并开始神殿任务。
对应于奥-吉姆神殿的神秘水晶位于兰雅鲁路南洞中的一个可破坏的岩墙后面，林克可以拾取并带到神殿。在神殿中，神秘的声音会再次确认承诺，给予他祝福之光。水晶会扩大，显露出神殿入口。之后，“兰雅鲁路水晶”任务完成。

name_zh: 沉睡于拉尔斯水脉的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
There are two ways to activate "The Ralis Channel Crystal". The first is by examining the Mysterious Crystal found by the southern entrance to Ralis Channel. The second is by approaching Joniu Shrine at the end of Ralis Channel and activating its Travel Point. In either scenario, a Mysterious Voice will speak to Link, instructing him to bring the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine of Light in order to receive a Light of Blessing. A beam of light will then appear, connecting the Crystal and the Shrine.
To bring the Mysterious Crystal to Joniu Shrine, Link must use Ultrahand to construct a makeshift raft. He can propel it through Ralis Channel using either the Sail or the Fans found nearby. When Link successfully brings the Mysterious Crystal, the Mysterious Voice speaks again, honoring its promise to grant him a Light of Blessing. The Mysterious Crystal will then float above the Shrine of Light and grow in size, and when its green sheen disappears, it is revealed to be the Shrine's entrance. The Shrine Quest will then be completed, and Link will be able to enter Joniu Shrine.
overview_zh:
激活“拉利斯通道水晶”有两种方法。第一种方法是，通过检查位于拉利斯通道南入口处的神秘水晶。第二种方法是在拉利斯通道的末端找到乔尼乌神殿后，激活其传送点。无论哪种情况，神秘的声音都会与林克交流，指示他将神秘水晶带到光明神殿，以获得祝福之光。随后会出现一道光束，连接水晶和神殿。

为了将神秘水晶带到乔尼乌神殿，林克需要使用“超手”建造一个临时小船。他可以使用附近找到的帆或风扇在拉利斯通道中推进小船。当林克成功将神秘水晶带到时，神秘的声音再次出现，履行了它许下的承诺，给予林克祝福之光。神秘水晶会漂浮在光明神殿上方并逐渐变大，并且当绿色光泽消失后，它就成为了进入乔尼乌神殿的通道。 完成“乔尼乌神殿”任务，林克就可以进入乔尼乌神殿了。

overview_en:
West of the Dueling Peaks in West Necluda, Link can find a large Fallen Ruin on the southern bank of Squabble River. Inside, he can find a Steward Construct offering to serve as a guide. When spoken to, it explains that it was tasked with guiding visitors to a Shrine of Light before the Ruin fell to the Surface, and it is thankful that it can still do so. The Steward Construct gives Link a riddle to reveal the Shrine, which states "Give keys born of water to the three altars. The sacred shrine will appear." Following this interaction, "Keys Born of Water" will begin.
Within the Fallen Ruin, Link can find several Frost Emitters. By activating a Frost Emitter while it is facing the Water of Squabble River, he can then create square sheets of Ice. These sheets can be resized by leaving them out in the daylight or by exposing them to the nearby Campfire while it is lit. Once a sheet is appropriately sized, Link can then use Ultrahand to slot it into one of the three altars. When an altar has a sheet of Ice in its groove, it will sink into the ground. After all three altars have slotted sheets of Ice, the Jochisiu Shrine will appear on top of the Fallen Ruin, and "Keys Born of Water" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在西尼克鲁达的斗峰以西，林克可以在 Squabble River 的南岸找到一座大型的倒塌废墟。里面有一个 Servant Construct，可以提供指引。它解释说，在废墟被地表发现之前，它负责引导访客前往圣光神殿，而现在它仍然能够做到这一点。Servant Construct 向林克提出了一个谜题：“将由水创造的钥匙放入三个祭坛上。圣殿将会出现。” 互动后，“由水创造的钥匙”任务开始。

在倒塌的废墟中，林克可以找到多个 Frost Emitter。通过激活 Frost Emitter 并使其面向 Squabble River 的水，林克可以将冰制成方形。可以通过在阳光下或在附近营火旁的篝火处放置来调整这些冰块的大小。当冰块达到合适的尺寸后，林克的可以使用 Ultrahand 将它放入其中一个祭坛上。当祭坛上有冰块时，它就会沉入地面。当所有三个祭坛都放入了冰块后，Jochisiu 神殿会在倒塌的废墟上显现，并且“由水创造的钥匙”任务完成。

name_zh: 沉睡于拉纳湖的洞窟中的水晶
overview_en:
Inside Oakle's Navel Cave, Link will find a Mysterious Crystal propped up on a pedestal. When he attempts to pick it up, a Mysterious Voice will speak to him, offering a Light of Blessing if he can bring the Mysterious Crystal to the end of its beam. Following this, the wall behind the Mysterious Crystal will part, revealing a large cavern with Boulders rolling across it, and "The Oakle's Navel Cave Crystal" will begin.
After exiting the cavern, Link will be in a tight corridor, where a large Stone Ball rolls towards him. After avoiding the Ball, he will be able to arrive at the location of Tokiy Shrine. The Mysterious Voice honors its promise. The Mysterious Crystal will then float above the Shrine of Light's exterior, growing and revealing itself to be the Shrine's entrance. Once its green coating fades away, Link is able to enter Tokiy Shrine.
overview_zh:
在奥克尔的肚脐洞内，林克会发现一个神秘水晶，它被放置在一个平台上。当他试图拿起水晶时，一个神秘的声音向他说话，并承诺如果他能将神秘水晶带到光芒的尽头，便给予祝福。随后，放置着神秘水晶的墙壁将会打开，露出一个巨大的洞穴，洞穴内有巨石滚动，游戏开始。
离开洞穴后，林克会进入一条狭窄的通道，其中一个巨大的石球向他滚来。通过躲避石球，他即可到达托基神殿的位置。神秘的声音兑现了承诺。神秘水晶随后漂浮在托基神殿外部，逐渐显露出来，成为了神殿的入口。当绿色的外壳消失后，林克即可进入托基神殿。
