name_zh: 海利亚湖的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
"The Lake Hylia Crystal" can be started in two separate ways. The first is by activating En-oma Shrine's Travel Point in the Lake Hylia Whirlpool Cave. The second way is to examine the Mysterious Crystal on the Sky Island above the Whirlpool Cave in the Faron Sky Archipelago. In either scenario, Link will hear a Mysterious Voice tell him to bring the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine of Light in order to receive a Light of Blessing.
Dropping the Mysterious Crystal from the hole in the Sky Island will cause it to fall directly into the Lake Hylia Whirlpool Cave. From there, Link can bring it to the Shrine of Light. The Mysterious Voice states that it will now offer the Light of Blessing. The Mysterious Crystal then begins to float and grow, and after its green sheen disappears, it is revealed to be the entrance to En-oma Shrine. Following this, Link is able to enter the Shrine of Light.
overview_zh:
“湖之海水晶”可以通过两种方式获得。第一种是通过激活位于湖之海漩涡洞穴中的恩·奥玛神殿的传送点。第二种是检查位于漩涡洞穴上方的天空岛上的神秘水晶。无论哪种方式，链接都会听到一个神秘的声音，要求他将神秘水晶带到光明神殿，以获得祝福的光。
将神秘水晶从天空岛上的孔中掉落，会导致它直接掉入湖之海漩涡洞穴。然后，链接可以将其带到光明神殿。神秘声音表示，现在会提供祝福的光。神秘水晶开始漂浮和生长，当绿色光泽消失后，它被发现是恩·奥玛神殿的入口。随后，链接能够进入光明神殿。

overview_en:
In the Tobio's Hollow Cave, Link can find a Tattered Notebook at an abandoned campsite. It describes a legend surrounding a treasure that the Zonai hid in the Cave, which goes, "Throw the Zonai spear with a wing from the pedestal, through the ring. Should your aim be true and right, you'll be blessed with dispelling light." However, the writer was unable to throw a Zonaite Spear through the Glowing Ring, and so they left the Notebook behind in the hope that the person that finds it would have better luck. After reading this passage, "Legend of the Soaring Spear" will begin.
When Link stands on the pedestal inside the Tobio's Hollow Cave, a Glowing Ring will appear above the nearby spring. In order to throw a Zonaite Spear through the Ring from the pedestal, Link must Fuse a Monster Wing to its end. This will allow the Zonaite Spear to fly farther after being thrown. Once he has successfully thrown a Zonaite Spear through the Glowing Ring, the Utojis Shrine will appear inside the Cave. Following this, "Legend of the Soaring Spear" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在托比奥的空洞洞穴，林克可以找到一本破旧的笔记本，该笔记本记录了一个关于祖纳人隐藏在洞穴中的宝藏的神话：用祖纳人的长矛从祭坛上投掷，穿过环。如果你的射击精准到位，你将获得驱散黑暗的光芒。然而，作者无法通过发光的环投掷祖纳人的长矛，因此他们把笔记本留在洞穴中，希望找到它的人能有更好的运气。
当林克站在托比奥的空洞洞穴中的祭坛上时，一个发光的环会出现在附近的泉边。为了从祭坛上投掷祖纳人的长矛穿过环，林克需要将怪物翅膀连接到矛的末端。这将使投掷后的祖纳人长矛能够飞得更远。一旦林克成功地将祖纳人的长矛投掷穿过发光的环，在洞穴内会出现乌托吉的神殿。然后，“传说中的翱翔之矛”就此完成。

name_zh: 格鲁德峡谷的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
There are two methods to start "The Gerudo Canyon Crystal". The first is by activating the Travel Point in front of the Rakakudaj Shrine. The second is by interacting with the Shrine of Light's respective Mysterious Crystal. In either scenario, Link will hear a Mysterious Voice, telling him to bring the Crystal to the Rakakudaj Shrine in exchange for a Light of Blessing. Upon hearing the voice, a beam connecting the Mysterious Crystal to the Shrine will appear, and the Shrine Quest will begin.
The Mysterious Crystal corresponding to the Rakakudaj Shrine can be found in between a couple of large rocks further south, near where Giro sets up camp after getting lost. When Link brings it to the Shrine, the Mysterious Voice will speak again, honoring its promise to give him a Light of Blessing. The Crystal will then expand in size, revealing itself to be the Shrine's entrance. Afterwards, "The Gerudo Canyon Crystal" will be completed.
overview_zh:
启动“女武士峡谷水晶”有两种方法：

第一种，激活位于拉卡库达吉神殿前的旅行点。

第二种，与神殿的光之水晶互动。

无论哪种方式，林克都会听到神秘的声音，告知他将水晶带到拉卡库达吉神殿以换取祝福之光。听到声音后，连接神秘水晶和神殿的光束将会出现，并开始神殿任务。

位于拉卡库达吉神殿的神奇水晶可以在吉罗迷路后设置营地的附近，若干大岩石之间找到。当林克将它带到神殿时，神秘的声音会再次响起，履行承诺，给予他祝福之光。水晶会逐渐变大，最终显露为神殿入口。之后，“女武士峡谷水晶”任务完成。

overview_zh:

沿着光线前进，把水晶供奉到神庙。

name_zh: 西哈特尔天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
Link can start "The West Necluda Sky Crystal" in two ways. The first is by activating Ukoojisi Shrine's Travel Point, and the second is by examining the Mysterious Crystal on the northernmost Sky Island in the West Necluda Sky Archipelago. In either scenario, a Mysterious Voice will speak to Link, informing him that he can receive a Light of Blessing by bringing the Crystal to the Shrine of Light.
Inside the cave where the Crystal is located, Link can find a Wing, a Cart, a Steering Stick, Batteries, and several Fans. Using Ultrahand, he can connect these Zonai Devices to create a gliding vehicle, which he can use to bring the Crystal to the Sky Island to the south. From there, Link will be able to bring the Crystal to Ukoojisi Shrine, where the Mysterious Voice honors its promise to him. The Crystal will then float above the Shrine of Light and grow in size, and as its green sheen fades away, it is revealed to be the Shrine's entrance. At this point, Link can now enter the Shrine, and the Shrine Quest will be completed.
overview_zh:
链接可以通过两种方式开始“西 Necluda 天空水晶”：

第一种是激活 Ukoojisi 神灵，第二种是检查西 Necluda 天空群岛最北的 Sky Island 上神秘的水晶。无论哪种方案，神秘的声音都会向链接告知，他可以将水晶带到 Shrine of Light，从而获得“光之祝福”。

在水晶所在的洞穴内，链接可以找到一对翅膀、一辆手推车、一个方向舵、几个通风扇等物品。通过使用 Ultrahand，链接可以将这些 Zonai 设备连接起来，创建一个滑翔装置，然后将水晶运送到位于南部的 Sky Island。随后，链接可以将水晶带到 Ukoojisi 神灵，神灵完成了他许下的承诺。水晶会悬浮在 Shrine of Light 上，并逐渐变大，随着绿色的光泽消失，它就变成了神灵的入口。此时，链接可以进入神灵，从而完成任务。

name_zh: 哈特尔天空诸岛的神庙与水晶
overview_en:
Link can start "The Necluda Sky Crystal" in two ways. The first is by activating Kumamayn Shrine's Travel Point, and the second is by examining the Mysterious Crystal which is located on the shoulder of a nearby Flux Construct III. In either scenario, a Mysterious Voice will speak to Link, informing him that he can receive a Light of Blessing by bringing the Crystal to the Shrine of Light.
After dislodging the Mysterious Crystal from the Flux Construct's shoulder, Link will be able to bring the Crystal to Kumamayn Shrine, where the Mysterious Voice honors its promise to him. The Crystal will then float above the Shrine of Light and grow in size, and as its green sheen fades away, it is revealed to be the Shrine's entrance. At this point, Link can now enter the Shrine, and the Shrine Quest will be completed.
overview_zh:
林克可以通过以下两种方式开始“奈克鲁达天空水晶”：一是激活库玛迈因神殿的传送点，二是检查位于附近流体构造 III 肩膀上的神秘水晶。在任何一种情况下，一个神秘的声音会与林克对话，告知他可以将水晶带到光明神殿，从而获得祝福的光芒。
在从流体构造的肩膀上取下神秘水晶后，林克可以将其带到库玛迈因神殿，此时神秘的声音兑现了承诺。水晶会悬浮在光明神殿之上并逐渐变大，随着其绿色的光泽消失，它便成为了神殿入口。此时，林克可以进入神殿，完成任务。

overview_en:
To unlock the "Spotting Spot" Side Quest, Link must have completed at least two "Regional Phenomena" Main Quests and completed the previous Side Quest "The Incomplete Stable".
If Link speaks to Lester at Lookout Landing, Lester will be worried about his missing horse, Spot.
Spot can be found just southwest of Lookout Landing near Passeri Greenbelt with other Horses. Like any Horse, Link can mount and ride Spot back to Lookout Landing and speak with Lester again to complete the Side Quest. Lester will reward Link with 50 Rupees and a Swift Carrot as thanks. He will also offer to let Link keep Spot and register him as his own Horse.
overview_zh:
要完成“Spotting Spot”支线任务，林克必须已完成至少两个“区域现象”的主要任务以及之前的支线任务“不完整的马厩”。

如果林克与卢斯特在 Lookout Landing 交流，他会担心自己的马 Spot 不见了。
Spot 可以被找到位于 Lookout Landing 以西偏南 Passeri Greenbelt 的地方，与其他马一起。 类似于任何其他马一样，林克可以骑上 Spot 并带回 Lookout Landing 与卢斯特再次交谈来完成支线任务。 卢斯特会奖励林克 50 个鲁比和一个 Swift Carrot 作为感谢。 他还会提供让林克收养 Spot 并将其注册为自己的 马的交易。

overview_en:
After completing two of the "Regional Phenomena" Main Quests, Link can find Mubs and Garini talking to each other at the Armor Shop in Lookout Landing. Garini is worried about Lurelin Village and wonders if he should go back, but Mubs does not want something to happen to him as well. Link then updates them on the situation. They are both relieved to learn everyone is safe, and Mubs gives him a Mighty Salt-Grilled Crab as a sign of their gratitude.
Garini thinks he should probably go check on their shop, but he does not want to leave Mubs alone in Lookout Landing. She convinces him to go back home to help the others bring their village back on its feet.
Afterwards, Garini will be gone and "Village Attacked by Pirates" will be complete.
overview_zh:
在完成两个“区域现象”主任务后，林克可以在 Lookout Landing 的盔甲店找到姆布和加尔尼。加尔尼担心鲁雷琳村，想知道是否应该回去，但姆布也不希望发生任何意外。林克将情况告知他们。他们都松了一口气，得知所有人平安。姆布作为感谢，送给林克一只烤盐蟹。

加尔尼觉得他应该去检查他们的店铺，但他不想单独留下姆布。她说服他回家帮助其他人重建村庄。
之后，加尔尼离开，并完成“村庄被海盗袭击”任务。

overview_en:
As Link talks to Burmano in the Emergency Shelter for the first time, the latter immediately realizes the fresh face. He says he is also a newcomer and therefore in charge of Cooking. In order to Cook a fancy dish he needs an Apple but is out of them. If Link has one of them with him he asks for it, as he can detect it with his nose. If Link denies it, he agrees, but promises a Fruit and Mushroom Mix in exchange for an Apple.[citation needed]
When given an Apple he Cooks said dish and explains the Cooking. This completes the Cooking and Burmano distributes his meal amongst Link and the other people, who loved it.
Later Burmano is missing and Deon explains that he went to Hyrule Castle's Dining Hall in order to find a super-special Cooking.
overview_zh:
当链接第一次在紧急避难所与巴玛诺交谈时，后者立刻认出了他。他表示自己也是新来的，因此负责烹饪。为了制作一道精致的菜肴，他需要一个苹果，但没有。如果链接有，他会要求借用，因为可以通过嗅觉来确认。如果链接拒绝，他会同意，并承诺用水果和蘑菇混合代替一个苹果。[需要引用]
当获得一个苹果后，巴玛诺完成了这道菜并解释了烹饪方法。这标志着烹饪完成，巴玛诺将食物分给链接和其他人，他们都非常喜欢。

后来，巴玛诺失踪，德恩解释说他去海拉鲁城堡的餐厅寻找特别的食材。[需要引用]

name_zh: 装点平原外围的驿站的画作
overview_en:
When Link examines the Empty Frame at Outskirt Stable, Embry will notice. Embry explains that after the Stable owners decided to display Pictures to their patrons, the Stable Association provided them with Empty Frames. Since the Upheaval has caused people to become anxious, Embry wants to display a Picture of Mother Tree, the Cherry-Blossom Tree on Satori Mountain, to put them at ease. While Embry is too busy to venture to Satori Mountain and paint it himself, he believes he would be able to recreate a Picture of one. After their conversation, "A Picture for Outskirt Stable" will begin.
Using the Camera, Link can take a Picture of Mother Tree, which he can then show to Embry. Upon seeing the Picture, Embry claims that it is exactly what he needed, and he asks Link permission to paint a copy of it. Should Link agree, Embry will be grateful. He is shocked that something as lovely as Cherry-Blossom Tree's petals can exist in the world, and he feels warm being able to see it bloom. He assures Link that he is talented enough at painting to create a copy of his Picture. Once the Picture of a Cherry-Blossom Tree is completed, Embry declares that it is perfect for Outskirt Stable, claiming it is as heartwarming and he thought it would be.
If Link brings him another Picture featuring Mother Tree, Embry offers to paint a new version of it. To reward Link for his help, Embry gives him one Pony Point. He also gifts him a Egg Tart, which he claims is a specialty of Outskirt Stable. Embry thanks Link for his help, inviting him to visit the Stable whenever he needs to. At this point, "A Picture for Outskirt Stable" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克在Outskirt Stable检查Empty Frame时，Embry会注意到。Embry解释说，Stable的业主为了向顾客展示Pictures，获得了Stable Association提供的Empty Frames。由于Upheaval导致人们感到不安，Embry想要将Cherry-Blossom Tree（Satori Mountain上的樱花树）的Picture展示出来，以安抚他们。虽然Embry太忙了无法亲自前往Satori Mountain并进行绘画，但他认为自己可以重现这幅Pictures。在对话之后，“为Outskirt Stable的Pictures”开始。

林克可以使用相机拍摄Cherry-Blossom Tree的Picture，然后向Embry展示。看到Pictures后，Embry表示这是他需要的，并请林克允许他复制它。如果林克同意，Embry将感激不尽。他惊叹于樱花树的花瓣竟然如此美丽，并且感到温暖，因为他能亲眼目睹它的盛开。他还向林克保证自己绘画技艺足够好，可以绘制出这幅Pictures的副本。一旦Cherry-Blossom Tree的Pictures完成，Embry宣布它是为Outskirt Stable完美的选择，并表示它就像他所期望的那样充满温馨。

如果林克再给他带来一张Featuring Mother Tree的Pictures，Embry将主动进行绘制新的版本。为了奖励林克的帮助，Embry会给予他一个Pony Point，并赠送一个Egg Tart（他说这是Outskirt Stable的特色）。Embry感谢林克的协助，邀请他随时来Stable拜访。此时，“为Outskirt Stable的Pictures”将完成。

overview_en:
At Riverside Stable, Link can find Teli looking into the Cucco pen, panicking about how much trouble he is in. If Link asks what is wrong with him, Teli initially fears that he has been caught, but he tells Link off after realizing his mistake. He recognizes that Link was the one who saved him and his friends during the "Gourmets Gone Missing" Side Adventure, and as a result, he wonders if he is willing to help him again. Teli reveals that he wanted to eat the Bird Eggs laid by the Stable's six Cuccos, but he accidentally scared away five of them. Although they are still in the vicinity, they run away whenever Teli gets close to them. He claims that he needs to return them before a Stable Worker notices, at which point "Feathered Fugitives" will begin.
Riverside Stable's Cuccos can be found at the following locations:

The stage where the Stable Trotters perform.
On top of a large Tree south of the Stable.
On top of a piece of Ruins Rubble in the Hylia River.
Inside the Stable.
On top of the Stable's Horse head.
Once all of the Cuccos have been returned, Teli will be shocked to see them. He is relieved that Link managed to retrieve them all, though he is embarrassed to have been saved by him yet again. To ensure Link's silence on the matter, Teli gives him a Silver Rupee. Afterwards, "Feathered Fugitives" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在 Riverside Stable，Link 发现 Telli 在观察着鸡笼，惊慌失措。如果 Link 问他怎么了，Telli 最初担心自己被抓住，但意识到自己的错误后斥责 Link。 他认识到 Link 和他的朋友们在“美食遭人绑架”支线任务中获救，并因此想知道是否愿意再次帮助他。 Telli 透露他想吃 Riverside Stable 的六只 Cucco 产的鸟蛋，但他不小心吓跑了五只。 虽然它们仍然在附近，但每次 Telli 靠近时，它们就会逃走。 他声称需要在工作人员注意之前将它们送回，届时“飞羽逃亡”将开始。

Riverside Stable 的 Cucco 可以找到以下位置：
* 在 Stable Trotters 表演的舞台上。
* 在 Stable 南部的巨大树上。
* 在 Hylia 河中的废墟上。
* 稳定内部。
* 在稳定马头的顶端。

一旦所有 Cucco 都被送回，Telli 会震惊地发现它们。 他松了一口气，知道 Link 又把它们都找回来了，虽然他仍然觉得很尴尬，因为他又一次被 Link 救了。 为了确保 Link 不再谈论此事，Telli 给他一枚银币。 然后，“飞羽逃亡”任务将会完成。

overview_en:
When Link inspects the Empty Frame at Riverside Stable, Ember will notice him doing so. He explains that it was provided by the Stable Association so that he could display a Picture for visitors to enjoy. Ember has decided that he wants to hang a Picture of a Great Goddess Statue. While he does not know where many of them are, but he has heard that one is located in a nearby temple southwest of Hyrule Field. Since he has been unable to find it, he suspects it is somewhere that a Horse cannot easily reach. Ember claims that if he were able to see a depiction of a Great Goddess Statue, he would be able to copy it for his own Picture. Following their conversation, "A Picture for Riverside Stable" will begin.
To complete this Side Quest, Link will need to use his Camera to take a Picture of one of these Great Goddess Statues:

The Temple of Time Statue, located within the Temple of Time Ruins on the Great Plateau.
The Great Goddess Statue, located within the Temple of Time on the Great Sky Island.
The Spring of Courage Statue, located at the Spring of Courage in the Faron Grasslands.
The Spring of Power Statue, located at the Spring of Power in Deep Akkala.
The Spring of Wisdom Statue, located at the Spring of Wisdom on Mount Lanayru.
After taking a Picture, Link will be able to present it to Ember. Upon seeing the Picture, Ember claims it is exactly what he has been searched for, and he asks permission to paint a copy. If Link agrees, Ember will be shocked by the Great Goddess Statue's size, though he assures Link that he is talented enough to produce a copy. Once the Picture of a Great Goddess Statue is completed, Ember declares that it is perfect for Riverside Stable, and he feels blessed having it watching over them.
Should Link ever want to bring him a new Picture depicting a different angle or Great Goddess Statue, Ember offers to paint a new one. As a reward, he gives Link one Pony Point. He also gifts Link an Energizing Crab Stir-Fry, which he claims to be a specialty of Riverside Stable. Thanking Link once again, Ember invites him to visit the Stable whenever he needs. Afterwards, "A Picture for Riverside Stable" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克在Riverside Stable检查Empty Frame时，艾姆尔会注意到。他解释说，这是Stable Association提供的，以便展示给游客欣赏的照片。艾姆尔决定挂一尊Great Goddess Statue的照片，虽然他不清楚具体位置，但他听说有座位于Hyrule Field附近西南方向的寺庙里。由于他无法找到它，他怀疑这可能在一个马难以到达的地方。艾姆尔表示，如果能看到Great Goddess Statue的画像，他就能复制出来。

为了完成这个支线任务，林克需要使用相机拍摄其中一个Great Goddess Statue的照片：
*   Temple of Time Statue（位于Great Plateau上的Temple of Time遗迹）
*   Great Goddess Statue（位于Great Sky Island上的Temple of Time）
*   Spring of Courage Statue（位于Faron Grasslands的Spring of Courage）
*   Spring of Power Statue（位于Deep Akkala的Spring of Power）
*   Spring of Wisdom Statue（位于Mount Lanayru的Spring of Wisdom）

拍摄照片后，林克可以向艾姆尔展示。看到照片后，艾姆尔表示这正是他一直在寻找的东西，并要求获得绘制复制品的机会。如果林克同意，艾姆尔会震惊于Great Goddess Statue的大小，但他向林克保证他有能力制作一份复制品。在完成Great Goddess Statue的照片后，艾姆尔宣布这是Riverside Stable的完美装饰，他觉得在Stable上方拥有它的存在是一种神佑。

如果林克将来想再次给艾姆尔带来一张不同的角度或Great Goddess Statue的照片，艾姆尔会提供绘制新的服务。作为回报，他会给予林克一个Pony Point，并赠送一份Energizing Crab Stir-Fry，声称这是Riverside Stable的特色菜。再次感谢林克，艾姆尔邀请他随时光临Stable。

overview_en: When Link arrives in New Serenne Stable, Zumi stands in front of it and talks about her latest investment, a horse-drawn wagon. Unfortunately, she isn't able to use it, as two wheels and a carthorse are missing. If Link uses the Fuse-ability the attach one of the scattered wheels to the wagon, she realised he is helping, but points out, that two wheels are necessary. After attaching another wheel, the cart is able to roll and Zumi overjoyed. Now the only missing objective is a suitable carthorse. Zumi earlier told Link that there are lots of wild horses around, but in order to catch them, one has to sneak up on them and after catching one, it needs to be soothed. Link sets out to catch a wild horse. He is not able to give one of his own to her, since she won't react to them. After catching and soothing a wild Horse, he gifts it to her. She is thankful and explains that a harness is required for a horse to pull a wagon and uses one to attach the horse to the cart. To show her gratefulness she give Link 100 Rupees, names the wagon "Zunk" - a combination of hers and his name  - and shares her knowledge of horses with him on later visits.
overview_zh: 链接到达新瑟恩稳定后，珠米站在那里，谈论她的最新投资——一辆马车。不幸的是，她无法使用它，因为缺少两个轮子和一个马。如果链接使用“融合”能力将散落的轮子连接到马车上，珠米意识到他是在帮助，但指出还需要两个轮子。在附加第二个轮子后，马车可以滚动，珠米欣喜若狂。“现在唯一缺失的就是一匹合适的马”。珠米之前告诉链接，附近有很多野生马，但是要捕捉它们，必须偷偷靠近并抚摸它们。链接决定去捕捉一只野生马。他无法给珠米自己的马，因为她对自己的不感兴趣。在捕捉和抚摸了一只野生马后，他将其赠送给她。她表示感谢，解释说如果要让马拉车需要一个马具，并用马具将马连接到马车上。为了表达谢意，她给了链接100卢比，给马车起了“Zunk”的名字——由她的名字和他的名字组合而成，并在稍后的访问中与他分享关于马的知识。

overview_en: Genli has a passion for culinary research. She wants to make a fish pie to help everyone feel better from the inside out, but she can't get her hands on any staminoka bass.
overview_zh: 庚珂热衷于料理研究。她想做一份鱼肉派，让大家从身体内部恢复元气，可是怎么也弄不到精力鲈鱼。

name_zh: 沉睡于山中秘泉的秘宝
overview_en:
When Link returns to Rito Village after completing the Main Quest "Tulin of Rito Village", he can find Tulin inside of Teba's Home. If spoken to, he reveals that there is something he wishes to discuss with Link. While helping Harth sort ancient literature, Tulin found a passage that described guiding the Water of three secret Hot Springs to their central point, which will reveal a hidden treasure. Tulin is reminded of the Sturnida Secret Hot Spring situated northwest of the Village, and although he is unsure about the other two, he is tempted by the prospect of treasure. Following this conversation, "Treasure of the Secret Springs" will begin.
To find this treasure, Link must go to the North Biron Snowshelf Cave, which is located at the center off the Sturnida Secret Hot Spring, Goflam's Secret Hot Spring, and Sherfin's Secret Hot Spring in the Hebra Mountains. Inside, he will find a tall chamber, with several Cracked Walls located along its sides. There is also an Updraft emanating from a structure in the chamber's center, as well as an Owl Statue. Destroying three of the Cracked Walls will cause Hot Springs to flow into the chamber, raising the Water-level. Once all three are destroyed, the Owl Statue will move to the side, revealing a hidden chamber with a Stone Chest inside. Opening the Chest will grant Link the Vah Medoh Divine Helm and complete the Side Quest.
overview_zh:
当林克完成主线任务“莉托村的图林”后，他可以在特巴的家中找到图林。如果与他交谈，他会透露自己想和林克商量某事。在帮助哈思整理古籍时，图林发现了一段描述将三个秘密温泉的水引导到其中心点的文字，从而揭示隐藏的宝藏。图林被位于村子西北方向的斯顿迪娅秘密温泉所提醒，虽然他对另外两个温泉不太确定，但他还是对宝藏感到渴望。
在与图林交谈后，“秘密温泉之宝”任务开始。

要找到这个宝藏, 林克必须前往北比隆雪架洞穴，该洞穴位于斯顿迪娅秘密温泉、戈弗拉姆秘密温泉和蛇菲恩秘密温泉的中心（分别位于赫卜拉山）。在该洞穴内，他会发现一个高大的房间，房间四周有多个被破坏的墙壁。该房间中央还有一股上升气流，以及一只雕像。摧毁三个被破坏的墙壁会导致温泉进入该房间，从而升高水位。一旦所有三个都被破坏，雕像就会移动到一侧，露出一个内部有石箱的隐藏房间。打开石箱将授予林克“瓦德·梅多”神圣头盔，并完成支线任务。
目标：

overview_en:
When Link returns to Rito Village after completing the "Tulin of Rito Village" Main Quest, he will be able to find Teba in his Home. Since he gave his Great Eagle Bow to Tulin, Teba plans to craft a new one for himself. He offers to make an additional one for Link, but he needs a Swallow Bow, five bundles of Wood, and three Diamonds in order to do so. Following their conversation, "Legacy of the Rito" will begin.
Once Link has collected the necessary Materials, he can return to Teba to craft the Great Eagle Bow. Before he does so, he asks if Link is certain, since Diamonds can be difficult to acquire. When Link gives his permission, Teba will accept the Materials, promising to make a worthy Bow. He assures Link that Harth, the finest craftsman of the Rito, considers his work to be masterful.
Upon finishing the Great Eagle Bows, Teba will give one to Link. Teba then tells Link that if his Bow ever breaks, he can bring him the Materials again to have a new one made. Afterwards, "Legacy of the Rito" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克完成“鲁托村的遗产”主线任务后，他可以回到鲁托村并找到特巴。由于他将巨鹰弓给了图林，特巴计划为自己制作一个新的弓。他提出为林克制作一个额外的弓，但需要一只燕子弓、五个木头捆和三个钻石。
在与特巴的对话后，“鲁托遗产”任务开始。

一旦林克收集了所需的材料，他就可以返回给特巴，让他制作巨鹰弓。在此之前，他询问林克的确认，因为获取钻石可能很困难。当林克同意时，特巴会接受材料，并承诺制作一把出色的弓。他向林克保证，鲁托最好的工匠哈斯认为他的作品是精湛的。

完成巨鹰弓后，特巴会把其中一把交给林克。然后，特巴告诉林克，如果他的弓损坏了，他可以再次提供材料来制作新的弓。之后，“鲁托遗产”任务完成。

overview_en:
Following the end of the Blizzard in Rito Village, Link can find Bedoli watching over a shipment of supplies. She recognizes Link as the person who aided Tulin in stopping the Blizzard, and she explains that the Rito are working on replenishing their stockpiles. Bedoli's job is the manage the process of searching for supplies, while other adults focus on scavenging. She notes that Huck has yet to return from Snowfield Stable, and she hopes he is fine.
Bedoli apologizes, before asking Link if he has any Food he would be willing to trade with her. She offers him a bundle of 10 Arrows if he can bring her three Glowing Cave Fish. If Link does not have enough Fish, Bedoli tells him the offer will still stand if he returns. Following their conversation, "Fish for Fletching" will begin.
When Link speaks to Bedoli with at least three Glowing Cave Fish in his Inventory, she will ask if he is willing to trade with her. If Link agrees, Bedoli will give him the bundle of 10 Arrows. Bedoli then asks if Link has more food, revealing that the Rito children enjoy Chillfin Trouts and Brightcaps. She promises to give him more Arrows if he can bring them to her. Afterwards, "Fish for Fletching" will be completed.
overview_zh:
暴风雪结束后，林克发现贝多利在照顾一批物资。她认出林克是帮助图林阻止暴风雪的人，并解释说日鸟正在补充他们的储备。贝多利的职责是管理物资搜寻过程，而其他成年人则专注于搜刮。她注意到休克尚未从雪原驿返回，希望他一切安好。

贝多利先道歉，然后询问林克是否愿意将食物与她交换。如果林克能提供 10 个箭，贝多利会给予 3 条发光鱼作为回报。如果林克没有足够的鱼，贝多利表示只要他回来，交易仍然有效。随后，“鱼换箭”交易开始。
当林克在手中持有至少 3 条发光鱼时，与贝多利交谈后，她询问是否愿意进行交换。如果林克同意，贝多利会给予 10 个箭。然后，贝多利询问林克是否有更多食物，透露日鸟孩子们喜欢“Chillfin Trout”和“Brightcap”。她承诺如果他能给她带回来，会给予更多的箭。随后，“鱼换箭”交易完成。

overview_en:
After the Extreme Cold Snap in Rito Village has ended, Link can find Gesane and Juannelle at the broken bridge near the Lucky Clover Gazette discussing reconstruction efforts. Although the Rito do not have the supplies to rebuild, Gesane has heard that the Hylians are skilled in such matters, and he asks Juannelle if she knows any carpenters. Juannelle believes that the individual who built Lookout Landing could help, but she can only remember that his name ends in "son". Gesane is impressed by his reputation, but he is unable to leave Rito Village as a guard. He plans to dispatch an emissary in his place, though he is unsure if anyone is available to leave. Afterwards, "The Rito Rope Bridge" will begin.
At Lookout Landing, Link can find Karson, who claims he has nearly finished building in the area. Since he is soon to be out of work, he asks Link if he is aware of anyone who needs the assistance of a carpenter. Upon hearing about the Rito, Karson recalls hearing that their bridge fell apart during the Extreme Cold Snap, and he notes that it must have ended if they are trying to rebuild. Karson decides to offer his help, at which point he departs for Rito Village.
When Link meets with Karson at the bridge, he can be seen informing Gesane and Juannelle that it is in worse condition than he anticipated. Gesane apologizes for the Rito's lack of building supplies, but Karson insists it is his fault for not bringing enough. If Link asks what happened, Karson and Juannelle claim they are short 20 bundles of Wood. Karson believes that could get more by chopping down the Cedar Trees nearby, but he compares it to taking on another project.
Once Link returns with enough Wood, Karson is shocked and asks if he is certain he can have it. When Link affirms it is for him, Karson will thank him. Now that he has all of the necessary Materials, Karson invites Gesane to fix the bridge with him. While working on the bridge, Karson directs Gesane, which involves Gesane catching a plank that was falling into Lake Totori and accidentally sitting on a support beam. Karson himself puts the finishing touches on the bridge, which involves singing the Hudson Construction theme song.
After finishing the bridge, Gesane is impressed. Karson admits that he was concerned about the end result, but he is relieved that it turned out well. He is certain that the new bridge could be hit by 10 blizzards at once and still not fall. Gesane believes that Rito Village will start to feel normal again, and as a reward, he gives Link a Silver Rupee. Karson decides to return to Lookout Landing, though he tells Gesane that he will be there if he ever needs help again. Gesane is grateful, offering the same invitation to Karson in return. Juannelle notes that the bridge has connected the Hylians and the Rito both literally and metaphorically, which she thinks would be a good topic for an article. Once Karson leaves, "The Rito Rope Bridge" will be finished.
overview_zh:
在经历了里托村的极端寒流后，林克可以找到格萨奈和尤恩内尔在幸运四叶草报社附近被摧毁的桥梁上，讨论重建工作。尽管里特人没有足够的材料来重建，但格萨奈听说希利娅人在这种方面很熟练，并询问尤恩内尔是否有认识造价师的人。尤恩内尔认为建造 Lookout Landing 的那个人可能可以帮忙，但他只记得他的名字以“son”结尾。格萨奈对他的声誉印象深刻，但无法作为一名看守离开里特村。他计划派遣一名使者代替自己，但他不确定是否有其他人可以离开。之后，“里特绳索桥”将开始建造。

在 Lookout Landing，林克可以找到卡森，他表示已经快要完成建设。由于即将失业，他询问林克是否有人需要木工的帮助。在得知里特的桥梁被摧毁后，卡森回忆起他们在极端寒流中桥梁倒塌的事实，并认为如果他们想要重建，那意味着寒流已经过去。卡森决定提供帮助，然后前往里特村。

当林克与卡森在桥上会面时，他向格萨奈和尤恩内尔告知这处情况比预想的更糟糕。格萨奈为里特人的缺乏建筑材料道歉，但卡森坚持认为这是他的错。如果林克询问发生了什么事，卡森和尤恩内尔声称他们缺少 20 根木材。卡森认为可以通过砍伐附近的红杉树来获得更多，但他认为这会涉及到另一个项目。

当林克返回并提供足够的木材时，卡森感到震惊，并询问他是否确定可以拥有这些木材。当林克证实这是为自己准备的，卡森向他表示感谢。现在，有了所有必要的材料，卡森邀请格萨奈与他一起修复桥梁。在修理桥梁的过程中，卡森指导格萨奈，其中包括让格萨奈抓住一个掉入湖泊的木板，并意外地坐在支撑柱上。卡森亲自完成了桥的修补，这包括演唱 Hudson Construction 主题曲。

在完成桥梁后，格萨奈表示赞叹。卡森承认自己对结果有些担忧，但很高兴最终一切顺利。他认为新桥可以承受 10 次暴风雪的影响而不会倒塌。格萨奈相信里特村将恢复正常，作为回报，他给予林克一枚银币。卡森决定返回 Lookout Landing，尽管他还告诉格萨奈如果需要帮助，他会再次出现。格萨奈表示感谢，并向卡森提出同样的要求。尤恩内尔注意到这桥连接了希利娅人和里特人，从字面意义上和象征意义上都相连，而她认为这是一个很好的新闻报道主题。当卡森离开后，“里特绳索桥”将完成。

name_zh: 装点塔邦挞大桥驿站的画作
name_en: A Picture for Tabantha Bridge Stable
overview_zh: 目标：

overview_en: Mazli needs Link’s help breaking some Hard Sediment in order to get his food out of the Rospro Pass Cave.
overview_zh: 马兹需要链接的帮助，清除“硬沉积”，以便从罗斯普罗隧道入口处取出食物。

overview_en: At Selmie's Spot, Link can find Russ wondering where Selmie has gone. When Link approaches him, he initially thinks he is Selmie, who he states was a famous Shield Surfer in the past. He explains that he took her and his friend Fin on as students, but she left to make a new course after the Blizzard disappeared and never came back. Fin left Selmie's Spot to look for her at the Biron Snowshelf, while Russ is waiting at the cabin in case she returns. Since Fin has also failed to come back, Russ has been searching for his Smoke Signals to try and meet with him. After their conversation, "The Duchess Who Disappeared" will begin.
overview_zh: 在Selmie's Spot，Link发现Russ正在寻找Selmie。当Link接近他时，他一开始以为是Selmie，他声称她是过去的著名“盾牌冲浪者”。他解释说，他收Selmie和Fin作为学生，但她离开后为了开设新的课程而走了，且没有回来。与此同时，Fin离开了Selmie's Spot，去Biron Snowshelf寻找Selmie，而Russ则一直在小屋里等待她的返回。由于Fin也没有回来，Russ一直在寻找他的“烟雾信号”试图与他会面。在他们谈话之后，“失踪的杜chess”将开始。

name_zh: 利特族的新式飞行训练
overview_en:
Link can encounter Kaneli in the Flight Range hut, where he is searching for a volunteer. He explains that after he retired as chief of Rito Village, he decided to assist Rito warriors who are training at the Flight Range. While the Blizzard ended up damaging the training equipment, Kaneli decided to take it as an opportunity to create a new course. The new course focuses on agility by having participants pass through Floating Rings, which Kaneli hopes will result in the warriors becoming for confident in their flight. Since the course was just finished, however, no one has tried it yet, though Kaneli wishes someone will come soon. At this point, "Kaneli's Flight Training" will begin.
When Link speaks to Kaneli again, he will be honored that he is volunteering to attempt Flight Training. Kaneli explains that Link must pass through as many Floating Rings as he can before time runs out, and if he strays too far from the Flight Range, he will be disqualified. He challenges Link to try and pass through 15 Floating Rings for his first attempt, promising a reward if he can do so.
If Link agrees to start Flight Training, Kaneli will show him to his position. At the start of the Mini-Game, Kaneli will count Link down. The Floating Rings can be found situated around the Flight Range's central pillar. After 30 seconds have passed, Kaneli will call Link back to the hut. If Link passed through at least 16 Floating Rings, Kaneli declares not only has he passed, he set a bar for the Rito to aspire to. As a reward, he gives Link a Purple Rupee. Kaneli also offers the Flight Training advanced course to Link, believing he needs more of a challenge. He invites Link to come again, but if he does so, he will need to pay a fee. Afterwards, "Kaneli's Flight Training" will be completed.
overview_zh:
链接可以在飞行训练营的住所找到卡内利，他正在寻找志愿者。卡内利解释说，自从他退休后，他决定帮助在飞行训练营训练的里托战士。虽然暴风雪损坏了训练设备，但卡内利利用这个机会设计了一门新的课程。这门新课程侧重于敏捷性，通过让参与者穿过漂浮环来实现，卡内利希望能够增强里托战士的自信心。然而，由于这门课程刚完成，还没有人尝试过，尽管卡内利希望有人尽快来。此时，“卡内利的飞行训练”将开始。
当链接再次与卡内利交谈时，他会感到荣幸能参与到飞行训练中。卡内利解释说，链接需要在时间耗尽前尽可能多地穿过漂浮环，如果离飞行训练区域太远就会被取消资格。他挑战链接尝试第一次穿越15个漂浮环，并承诺给予奖励。
如果链接同意开始飞行训练，卡内利会带他到指定地点。迷你游戏的开始时，卡内利会数下时间。可以通过飞行训练区域中心的柱周围找到漂浮环。在30秒后，卡内利会叫回链接到住所。如果链接成功通过了至少16个漂浮环，卡内利宣布他不仅成功了，还为里托创造了一个目标。作为奖励，他给了链接一颗紫 rupee 。卡内利还向链接提供了更高级的飞行训练课程，认为他需要更大的挑战。他邀请链接再次参加，但如果他这样做，则需要支付费用。之后，“卡内利的飞行训练”将完成。

overview_en:
On the north end of Goron City, Link can find Dugby near the Mine Cart Tracks, where he is struggling to move a Mine Cart. He recalls hearing that he can use the Mine Cart to reach the end of the Tracks, but he has been unable to make it move. Dugby suspects that Gorondia is located on the other side of the Tracks.
If Link asks about Gorondia, Dugby will initially be shocked, but he explains that it is an ancient city where Gorons lived in the ancient past. Treasure, advanced technology, and strange vehicles can also supposedly be found there. He reveals that he wanted to ride in the Mine Cart to search for this treasure, but he has been unable to move it. Dugby warns Link not to share his secrets, after which "The Ancient City Gorondia!" will begin.
Using Ultrahand, Link can place the Mine Cart on top of the Mine Cart Tracks. In order to get the Mine Cart to move, however, he will need to attach a Fan to the back. Once the Mine Cart is on the Tracks, Link is able to direct Dugby to sit in it. After activating the Fan, Link must ride with Dugby to YunoboCo HQ at the end of the Tracks. Upon disembarking from the Mine Cart, Dugby declares that he is going to search for Gorondia. Noticing that Link is still there, Dugby realizes he must want a reward, and so he gives him a Zonai Charge. He predicts that the treasure he finds will make him rich, and when that happens, he promises to hire Link. Dugby then rolls off, and "The Ancient City Gorondia!" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在戈隆城的北部，林克可以找到杜比，他位于矿车轨道附近，正试图移动一辆矿车。他记得听说可以用矿车到达轨道尽头，但一直无法启动矿车。杜比怀疑戈隆城位于轨道另一侧。

如果林克询问关于戈隆城，杜比最初会感到惊讶，但他解释说那是一座古老的城市，是过去戈隆人居住的地方。据说那里还可能找到宝藏、先进技术和奇怪的车辆。他透露自己想乘坐矿车去寻找这些宝藏，但一直无法启动矿车。杜比警告林克不要泄露信息，然后“古老的戈隆城！”游戏开始。

使用Ultrahand，林克可以将矿车放置在矿车轨道上。为了让矿车移动，他需要将风扇连接到后部。一旦矿车停在轨道上，林克可以引导杜比进入其中。激活风扇后，林克必须和杜比一起乘坐矿车到达轨道尽头的YunoboCo总部。下车后，杜比宣布要去寻找戈隆城了。注意到林克还在那里，杜比意识到他想要报酬，于是给了他一个Zonai Charge。他预测找到的宝藏会让他富有，并且承诺等找到了宝藏后会雇佣林克。杜比滚落在地，游戏“古老的戈隆城！”完成。

name_zh: 发现古代都市鼓隆提亚！？
overview_en: After both "The Ancient City Gorondia!" Side Quest and the "Yunobo of Goron City" Main Quest have been completed, and at least 30 in-game hours have passed naturally, Link can encounter Dugby near the entrance to Goron City.
overview_zh: 在完成“古城戈隆迪亚！”支线任务和“戈隆城的尤诺博”主线任务，并且游戏自然时间达到30小时后，链接可以在戈隆城的入口处遇到杜比。

overview_en:
After completing "Yunobo of Goron City", Link can find Fugo arguing with Rohan. He asks Rohan to allow him another attempt at making the Boulder Breaker, but Rohan refuses after he abandoned his training to indulge in Marbled Rock Roast. Fugo begs for a chance to finish his Boulder Breaker, saying that Rohan can forsake him as a student if he fails. However, Fugo needs a Cobble Crusher, five pieces of Flint and three Diamonds to do so, and he spent all of his funds buying Marbled Rock Roasts. Once Link listens to their conversation, "Soul of the Gorons" will begin.
When Link has the necessary supplies, he can give them to Fugo, who will be grateful to him. Now that he is able to make a Boulder Breaker, Fugo asks Rohan to watch him do so. After he completes the Boulder Breaker, Rohan examines it and declares it is perfect. Fugo thanks Rohan for his praise, and now that Fugo has gotten his priorities straight, he decides to pass the forge on to him. Fugo is honored by this.
Turning to Link, Fugo thanks him for providing the supplies he needed. As a reward, he gifts Link the Boulder Breaker that he just made. If it ever breaks, Fugo offers to make a new one for Link if he brings the supplies again. Afterwards, "Soul of the Gorons" will be finished.
overview_zh:
完成“古隆城中的弗古”后，林克发现弗古和罗汉在争吵。他请求罗汉允许他再次制作“岩石破摧者”，但罗汉拒绝，因为他放弃了训练来享用“玛瑙烤肉”。弗古恳求罗汉给予他一次机会，说如果自己失败，罗汉可以把他当作学生处理。然而，弗古需要一个“碎石锤”、“五块燧石”和三个钻石，但他花光了他的钱购买了“玛瑙烤肉”。当林克听到他们的对话后，“古隆人的灵魂”将开始。
当林克获得所需的材料时，他可以把它们交给弗古，后者会感谢他。现在弗古能够制作“岩石破摧者”，他请罗汉观看。完成后，罗汉检查后说它完美无缺。弗古感谢罗汉的赞美，并决定将锻造权传给他。弗古对此感到荣幸。
转向林克时，弗古感谢他提供所需的材料。作为回报，他赠予林克刚刚制作的“岩石破摧者”。如果它损坏，他会再次提供材料给林克，然后重新制作。之后，“古隆人的灵魂”将完成。

name_en: The Hidden Treasure at Lizard Lakes
overview_en:
After completing the "Yunobo of Goron City" Main Quest, Yunobo and Bludo can be found speaking at the center of Goron City. Yunobo recalls that while he was wearing the Weird Mask, the other Zelda told him not to go near the Lizard Lakes. Hearing mention of the Lizard Lakes, Bludo remembers a nursery rhyme about them, which states, "One brother hunts what the other brother hides—two lizards fighting over what's inside."
In his youth, Bludo tried to find the Lizard Lakes hoping to find treasure, but the eruption of Death Mountain forced him to stop. Having been reminded of the Lakes, Bludo wants to continue his search. He believes the most likely place to find them would be halfway up the north side of Death Mountain. He wants to go immediately, but his back pain suddenly flares up before he can do so. After witnessing this conversation, "The Hidden Treasure at Lizard Lakes" will begin.
The Lizard Lakes are located on the northern side of Death Mountain. One is situated at the base of Lake Darman, while the other is at the base of Death Caldera. Between the two Lakes, Link can come upon the entrance to the Lizard's Burrow. A Stone Chest can be found at the end of the Cave that contains the Vah Rudania Divine Helm. Upon obtaining the Helm, "The Hidden Treasure at Lizard Lakes" will be completed.
overview_zh:
完成“高隆市伊努波”主线任务后，你可以找到伊努波和布鲁多在高隆市中心交谈。伊努波回忆起，他戴着奇怪面具时，其他角色曾警告他不要靠近蜥蜴湖。听到关于蜥蜴湖的提问，布鲁多想起一首儿歌：“一个兄弟追捕另一个兄弟藏的东西——两只蜥蜴争夺内部内容。”

在年轻时，布鲁多试图寻找蜥蜴湖，希望能找到宝藏，但死亡之山的爆发迫使他停止。被提醒了蜥蜴湖后，布鲁多想要继续寻找。他认为最有可能找到它们的地方是在死亡之山北侧的中途。他想立刻去，但就在这时，他的背痛突然加剧。在亲眼目睹这段对话后，“蜥蜴湖的隐藏宝藏”将开始。

蜥蜴湖位于死亡之山的北侧。一个位于达玛纳湖的底部，另一个位于死亡熔口的底部。这两个湖之间，链接可以找到蜥蜴洞穴入口。在洞穴的末端，可以找到一个石箱，里面放置着神圣头盔 Vah Rudania。获得头盔后，“蜥蜴湖的隐藏宝藏”将完成。

name_zh: 隐秘温泉 岩熔温泉
overview_en:
Kima has come to Goron City in search for a secret hot spring called Simmerstone Springs. He plans to start by seeking out hot-water connoisseurs at various hot-spring locatins in the hopes they'll have information for him.

He's set his sights on Goron Hot Springs in particular.
overview_zh:

他尤其关注鼓隆温泉。

overview_en:
When Link examines the Empty Frame at Woodland Stable, Kish will notice him doing so. He reveals that the Stable Association sent it to him after the Stable owners decided to display Pictures for their patrons. Kish wants to hang up a Picture depicting a Goron soaking in the Goron Hot Springs. While he does not have the time to make a trip to the Hot Springs, Kish claims he would be able to recreate a reference if provided with one. Following this, "A Picture for Woodland Stable" will begin.
At the Goron Hot Springs, Link can find Grapp relaxing and take a Picture of him. He can also take a Picture of Axyl, Bohrin, or Jengo in the Hot Spring in Goron City. He can then present the Picture to Kish. Seeing the Picture, Kish proclaims that it is exactly what he needs, and he asks permission to copy it. When Link agrees, Kish jokes that he should abandon the Stable so he can go visit the Hot Springs. He then promises that he is talented enough to copy the Picture. Upon finishing the Picture of a Goron Soaking in Hot Springs, Kish declares that is is perfect.
Kish offers to switch out the Picture if Link brings him a new one to copy. As a reward, he gives Link one Pony Point. He also gifts him Hasty Vegetable Curry, which he claims is a specialty of Woodland Stable. Once again, Kish thanks Link, inviting him to visit the Stable whenever he is in need. Afterwards, "A Picture for Woodland Stable" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克在伍德兰稳定检查“空框”时，基什会注意到。他透露，稳定协会为了让稳定主人展示照片，将此“空框”送给他。基什想挂上一幅描绘 Goron 在 Goron 热泉的照片。由于他没有时间去热泉，但如果提供参考图片，基什表示可以复制。随后，“伍德兰稳定的照片”开始进行。

在 Goron 热泉，林克可以找到格拉普并拍下他的照片。他还可以在 Goron 城的热泉中拍摄 Axyl、Bohrin 或 Jengo 的照片，然后将这些照片交给基什。看到照片后，基什表示这正是他需要的，并要求许可进行复制。当林克同意后，基什开玩笑说应该放弃稳定工作，去参观热泉。他还保证自己有能力复制该照片。完成“描绘 Goron 在热泉中的照片”后，基什宣布这是完美的。

如果林克能为他带来新的照片进行复制，基什将更换照片并给予他一个 Pony Point。他还赠送 Hasty Vegetable Curry（速食蔬菜咖喱），声称这是伍德兰稳定的特色菜。再次感谢林克，邀请他随时光临稳定。之后，“伍德兰稳定的照片”完成。

overview_en:
When Link examines the Empty Frame at Foothill Stable, the owner Ozunda will notice him. He reveals that it was given to him by the Stable Association so he can hang up a Picture for his patrons. Since the Stable is a common stopping point on the way to Goron City, Ozunda wants to display a Picture of the statue of Daruk that can be found there. Although he is unable to leave the Stable to go paint it, he claims he would be able to replicate a Picture of it. After this, "A Picture for Foothill Stable" will start.
Using his Camera, Link can take a Picture of the Goron Stone Memorial in Goron City, which contains the statue of Daruk. He can then take the Picture back to Foothill Stable to show Ozunda. Once he sees the Picture, Ozunda claims it is what he needed to see, and he asks for Link's permission to copy it. If Link agrees, Ozunda thanks him, claiming that the Picture captures Daruk's strength. He asks for a moment to create his own Picture, promising he has the talent to recreate it faithfully. After the Picture of the Daruk Sculpture is finished, Ozunda expresses his pride at how it turned out, and he is happy to have been able to paint again.
Due to how much he enjoyed painting the Picture of the Daruk Sculpture, Ozunda offers to paint any more Pictures of the Goron Stone Memorial that Link takes. He then proceeds to reward Link with one Pony Point. In addition to this, he gives Link a Fireproof Lizard, which he believes will help him during his travels. Once again, Ozunda thanks Link, inviting him to make use of the Stable whenever he wants. Following their conversation, "A Picture for Foothill Stable" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克检查在 Foothill 稳定牌的空架时，房主奥zun达会注意到他。 他透露，这幅画是稳定协会送给他的，让他可以为顾客挂上画作。 由于该稳定是个通往高隆城的常见途经点，奥zun达想要展示达鲁克雕像的画像，这座雕像位于那里。 虽然他无法离开稳定去绘制，但他声称能够复制它。 之后，“为 Foothill 稳定牌制作画像” 将开始。
林克可以使用他的相机拍摄 Goron City 中的高隆石纪念碑上的画像，该画像中包含达鲁克雕像。 然后他可以将画像带回 Foothill 稳定牌给奥zun达看。 一旦他看到画像后，奥zun达表示这就是他需要的，并要求林克的许可来复制它。 如果林克同意，奥zun达感谢他，他说这幅画像捕捉到了达鲁克的力量。 他请求稍后再创作自己的画像，并保证自己有能力忠实地再现。 完成达鲁克雕像的画像后，奥zun达表达了他的自豪感， 并很高兴能再次绘画。
由于他对绘制达鲁克雕像画像的喜爱，奥zun达提出了在林克拍摄任何高隆石纪念碑画像后为他绘制更多画像的要求。 然后他奖励了林克一个 Pony Point。 此外，他还送给林克一只防火蜥蜴，理由是这将在他的旅途中帮助他。 奥zun达再次感谢林克，邀请他随时利用稳定牌。 在对话结束后，“为 Foothill 稳定牌制作画像” 将完成。

overview_en:
"Fell into a Well!" is begun when Link speaks to a Hylian named Dillie inside the Rebonae Bridge Well. He explains that he had previously dropped something in the Well and used a Ladder to retrieve it, which broke when he tried to Climb back up. Additionally, he says that his friend, Jora, failed to realize that he was stuck, and that it would be possible to reattach the broken part of the Ladder if the upper half was not out of reach.
Link can reconnect the broken part of the ladder using Ultrahand, although Dillie will be unable Climb it if it is still too high off the ground. When the Ladder reaches low enough, Dillie and Link will leave the Well. Dillie will reward Link afterward with a Purple Rupee, and he warns Link not to fall into any Wells in the future. He will also tell Link of his plans to apply for the Zonai Survey Team with Jora. The Side Quest will then be completed.
overview_zh:
“坠入井中！”事件始于林克与希利亚人 Dill 在瑞波纳桥的井中对话。他解释说，此前他曾将东西掉入井中，并使用梯子取回，但梯子在攀爬时断裂。他还提到，他的朋友乔拉并没有意识到自己被困，如果上部仍然触手可及，就有可能重新连接梯子的残骸。

林克可以使用 Ultrahand 重新连接梯子的部分，但 Dill 如果梯子仍然太高，就无法攀爬。当梯子足够低时，林克和 Dill 将离开井。Dill 会奖励林克一枚紫色 Rupee，并警告他以后不要再掉入井中。他还告诉林克他和乔拉的计划是申请加入 Zonai 调查队。

overview_zh: 在死亡山西洞隧道内，林克可以找到莫塔，他正在询问为什么没有人来接他。

overview_en:
Brothers Domidak and Prissen read you one of Misko's old manuscripts. It said, "A forgotten pirate cavern lurks at the foot of Cape Cales, overlooking the Necluda Sea. The short, shrill song of wing through lips will open the way to my treasure."

Solve the riddle to find the treasure.
overview_zh:
多米达克和普利森兄弟为你读了一份米兹科的古代文献："在俯瞰内库达海的卡雷斯海角脚下，潜藏着一处被遗忘的海盗洞窟。唇间短促尖锐的风之歌将为我的财宝开路。"

解开谜语，找到财宝吧。

overview_zh: 目标：

name_zh: 拉姆达的财宝 织梦之勇者服1
overview_en: This Side Quest is started past a wall in Goronbi River Cave. In order to get there, Link must open a Treasure Chest at the end of the cave, which will make the wall open. After that, Link can read a Misko's Letter on a Stone Tablet that will start the Side Quest. He should now head to the Ancient Columns and step on the column with a pressure plate on it. This will open up a passage in the ground leading to the Ancient Columns Cave. Within the cave is a Chest containing Misko’s Treasure of Awakening I, the Tunic of Awakening. Once Link has opened this chest, the Side Quest is complete.
overview_zh: 这个支线任务从戈隆比河洞的墙后开始。为了进入，Link需要在洞穴的末端打开一个宝箱，这将使墙打开。随后，Link可以在一块石碑上找到Misko的信，这会启动支线任务。现在，他应该前往古柱并踩下带有压力板的柱子。这将打开一条通往古柱洞的通道。在洞穴内有一个宝箱，其中包含Misko的觉醒宝藏I和觉醒长袍。一旦Link打开这个箱子，支线任务就完成了。

overview_en:
At South Akkala Stable, Link can find Parcy repeatedly striking a Rare Ore Deposit in an attempt to break it. When he approaches her, she becomes defensive, claiming that she will be the one to take the Gems from inside. She asserts that the reason she has not broken it open yet is because her hands are sweaty, and her grip is therefore not as firm. Sensing that Link does not believe her, Parcy angrily challenges him to smash the Rare Ore Deposit in only one swing, promising him all of the Gems inside if he can do so. Due to her own strength with her sword, Parcy does not think Link is able to do so. Following their conversation, "One-Hit Wonder!" will begin.
Using a Hammer-type Weapon or a Bomb Flower, Link will be able to destroy the Rare Ore Deposit in a single strike. Parcy is annoyed, claiming that she was only joking when she told him to break it. She notes that while she was only using her arm muscles, Link used his "brain muscles" as well. Parcy congratulates Link, and she allows him to keep the Gems as she promised. Afterwards, "One-Hit Wonder!" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在南阿卡拉马厩，林克可以多次看到帕尔奇试图破坏稀有矿脉。当他靠近她时，她变得防御，声称自己会从里面拿走宝石。她解释说，她还没有成功是因为她的手很潮，握力不够。察觉到林克不相信她，帕尔奇怒斥他只用一次攻击就能打破宝石，如果能做到，她将把宝石的所有权交给林克。由于自己的剑术，帕尔奇认为林克不可能做到。在对话之后，会开始“一击制胜”。

使用锤子类型武器或炸弹花，林克可以只用一次攻击就摧毁稀有矿脉。帕尔奇对此感到恼火，声称她一开始只是开玩笑。她注意到，虽然她主要用手臂的力量，但林克也使用了他的“大脑力量”。帕尔奇祝贺林克，并如约让他拿走宝石。之后，“一击制胜”会完成。

name_zh: 装点南阿卡莱驿站的画作
name_en: A Picture for South Akkala Stable
overview_en:
When Link examines the Empty Frame at South Akkala Stable, Dmitri will notice. He explains that the Stables are hanging up Pictures for their patrons, and they are making use of Empty Frames provided by the Stable Association. After discussing it with his wife and daughters, Dmitri decides he wanted to display a Picture of the Unity Bell, which can be found in Tarrey Town. Though he is too busy to leave the Stable to paint it himself, Dmitri claims he would be able to copy a reference Picture. Afterwards, "A Picture for South Akkala Stable" will begin.
Using the Camera, Link can take a Picture of the Unity Bell, which he can then show to Dmitri. When he sees the Picture, he claims that it is exactly what he needed before asking permission to make his own copy. If Link agrees, Dmitri recalls that he and his wife once rang the Unity Bell together, and they are still happy together. He then proceeds to make his duplicate, assuring Link that he is talented enough to do so. Once the Picture of the Unity Bell is complete, Dmitri claims he can almost hear it ringing, revealing that many couples hold wedding ceremonies in front of the Bell.
Should Link ever capture a new Picture of the Unity Bell, Dmitri offers to make a new painting for him. As a reward, he gives Link one Pony Point. He also gives Link Prime Meat Stew, which he claims is a specialty of South Akkala Stable. Thanking Link for the Picture, Dmitri invites him to stay at the Stable whenever he needs. Following this conversation, "A Picture for South Akkala Stable" will be finished.
overview_zh:
当林克检查南阿卡拉马厩的空框时，德米特会注意到。他解释说，马厩正在为顾客挂上画作，并且利用马厩协会提供的空框。经过与妻子和女儿的商议后，德米特决定要展示《团结之钟》的画像，这幅画像位于塔雷镇。虽然他太忙无法自己画下来，但他声称可以复制参考图片。之后，“为南阿卡拉马厩创作一幅画”将开始。
林克可以使用相机拍摄《团结之钟》的照片，然后向德米特展示。看到照片后，他表示这是他所需要的，然后请求获得制作自己的副本的许可。如果林克同意，德米特回忆起他和妻子曾经一起敲响过《团结之钟》，并且仍然非常幸福。然后他开始制作复制品，并向林克保证自己有能力完成。当《团结之钟》的照片完成后，德米特表示他几乎能听到钟声，透露许多情侣会在钟前举行婚礼仪式。《团结之钟》的照片完成后，德米特再次邀请林克，并赠送给予1个pony point, 以及一碗 Prime Meat Stew。

overview_en:
When Link speaks to Kodah after completing "Sidon of the Zora", she informs him that she and Finley found an Ancient Manuscript while organizing the Seabed Inn's bookshelf. The Manuscript states, "Long, long ago, at Tarm Point, a blessed stone was hidden away within a sacred shrine. It was a magnificent shrine that was overflowing with blessings." Kodah then declares that the Manuscript must lead to a secret. If Link agrees, Kodah states she knew an adventurer like him would understand. If Link disagrees, Kodah continues to insist that she is right.
Kodah believes that the Ancient Manuscript was likely left behind by a distant ancestor of hers and that it may lead to treasure. Upon seeing it, Finley decided to try and find the treasure for herself, and she took Sasan with her. Although Kodah is certain that Finley will remain safe, she is worried about Sasan. After speaking to Kodah, "True Treasure" will begin.
Inside Tarm Point Cave, Link can find Sasan wondering what he should do. He is shocked to meat someone else in the Cave, asking if Link is also in search of the treasure mentioned in the Ancient Manuscript. If Link has not yet spoken to Kodah, then Sasan reasons he just so happened to find the Cave. If Link did speak to her, Sasan explains that the Manuscript was left by her ancestors.
After hearing about the Ancient Manuscript, Sasan and Finley decided to seek out the treasure together, though Sasan admits that he was uncertain. However, he believes that a Shrine of Light is the most likely place that a treasure would be hidden, and so he followed after Finley. When they arrived at Tarm Point Cave, though Finley swam ahead, and Sasan was unable to keep up with her. He also has not been able to use the nearby Raft due to the Cave's Water level fluctuating, and so he is unsure how to reach her.
With the nearby Korok Fronds, Link can use Fuse to create a Korok-Frond Guster. He can then place the Raft in the Water and instruct Sasan to board. Link can then use the Korok-Frond Guster to navigate the stream. At the end of the stream, he will find Finley standing in front of a Shrine of Light, calling out to them. Once they reach the end of Tarm Point Cave, Sasan will thank Link.
On the shore, Finley notices that Sasan appears to be pale and asks how he is. He insists that he is fine, apologizing for keeping her waiting. Finley looks up at the Yomizuk Shrine nearby, wondering if it is the one mentioned in the Ancient Manuscript. While Finley is disappointed that there is no treasure, Sasan claims that the memory of their journey is more meaningful. Finley agrees, stating that the memory they shared is the greatest treasure of all.
Sasan thanks Link for helping him reach the Shrine of Light. As a reward, he gives Link an Opal. He claims he picked it up while he and Finley were on their way to Tarm Point Cave, and he hopes it could be useful to Link. Finley gives Link another Opal, which she also found on their journey. Sasan suggests that they should return to Zora's Domain at tell Kodah about what they discovered, which Finley agrees to. She decides they should hold hands while Swimming back in order to avoid being separated, though this only concerns Sasan. The pair then leave, and "True Treasure" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克与科达对话后，她告知他自己和芬利在整理海滨旅馆的书架时，发现了古代手稿。手稿的内容是：“很久以前，在塔姆港，一块神圣的宝石被隐藏在一个神圣的神殿里。那是一个充满祝福的神殿。” 科达随后表示，这本手稿一定指向某个秘密。如果林克同意，科达说她知道像他这样的冒险家会明白。如果林克不同意，科达继续坚持自己是对的。

科达认为这本古代手稿很可能是由她的远房祖先留下的，并且可能会通向宝藏。芬利在看到手稿后，决定亲自寻找宝藏，并带上了萨桑。虽然科达确信芬利会安全无事，但她对萨桑感到担忧。在与科达对话后，“真正的宝藏”将开始。

林克可以在塔姆港洞穴中找到困惑的萨桑。他惊讶地发现自己不是一个人，询问林克是否也在寻找手稿中所提到的宝藏。如果林克尚未与科达对话，那么萨桑认为自己只是偶然发现了这间洞穴。如果在林克已经与她对话后，萨桑解释说，这份手稿是由她的祖先留下的。

在得知古代手稿的事情后，萨桑和芬利决定一起寻找宝藏，但萨桑也承认他感到有些不确定。但他认为，神殿的光是宝藏最可能隐藏的地方，所以他跟随芬利。当他们到达塔姆港洞穴时，芬利率先游向前方，而萨桑则无法跟上她。他还无法使用附近的竹筏，因为洞穴的水位在波动，因此他不确定如何才能与她联系。

通过附近的玉米叶，林克可以使用聚结法制造出一个玉米叶探测器。他可以将竹筏放在水中并指示萨桑登上。然后，林克可以使用玉米叶探测器来导航水流。在水流的尽头，他会发现芬利站在一座神殿的光前，向他们招手。当他们到达塔姆港洞穴的尽头时，萨桑将感谢林克。

在岸边，芬利注意到萨桑看起来脸色苍白，并询问他的情况。她坚持说自己没事，并为过意不去。芬利抬起视线看向附近的异味神殿，想知道它是否就是手稿中所提到的那座神殿。尽管芬利感到失望，因为没有找到宝藏，但萨桑表示，他们的旅程记忆更有意义。芬利同意，说他们共同的记忆才是最大的宝藏。

萨桑感谢林克帮助他到达神殿的光前。作为回报，他给了林克一颗宝石。他说他们在前往塔姆港洞穴的过程中捡到的，希望能对林克有所帮助。芬利也给林克一颗宝石，她说她在旅途中也找到了。萨桑建议他们回到索拉的领域告诉科达他们所发现的一切，而芬利同意这样做。她决定在游泳时互相牵手，以防止被分开，尽管这只有萨桑在意。然后两人离开了，"真正的宝藏"将完成。

name_zh: 沉睡于大鱼之下的秘宝
name_en: Secret Treasure under the Great Fish
overview_en:
When Link speaks to Sidon after completing the "Sidon of the Zora" Main Quest, he reveals that he can across a text about the Zora royal family that mentions a secret treasure. If Link expresses his interest, Sidon will recite the passage for him, which states "The great fish. The eternal guardian. A secret treasure awaits just beneath the stony form of its statue. Below the long bridge that reaches for the statue, leave your fears behind. Pass beneath two waterfalls to find your prize." Although Sidon is excited by the prospect, he warns Link that the treasure may already be gone. Despite this, he still encourages Link to search, since it may be useful to him. Following this conversation, "Secret Treasure under the Great Fish" will begin.
Behind the Waterfall below the Great Zora Bridge, Link can find the entrance to the Cave Under Zora's Domain. Passing under the Waterfall in this cave, Link will come upon a secret chamber with a stone Treasure Chest, in which is the Vah Ruta Divine Helm. After Link obtains the Helm, "Secret Treasure under the Great Fish" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在完成“瑟拉的助手”主线任务后，当林克与赛顿对话时，他会透露自己找到了一篇关于瑟拉王室的文本，其中提到一个秘密宝藏。“伟大的鱼。永恒的守护者。一个秘密宝藏就在它的石像下方等待着你。在通往石像的长桥下，抛弃你的恐惧吧。穿过两个瀑布即可找到你的财富。”虽然赛顿对此感到兴奋，但他警告林克，这个宝藏可能已经消失。尽管如此，他仍然鼓励林克去寻找，因为这或许对他有帮助。之后，任务“在伟大的鱼下的秘密宝藏”开始。
在位于瑟拉大桥下的瀑布 atrás, 玩家将找到进入“瑟拉之域的洞穴”入口。通过该洞穴处的瀑布，玩家会发现一个隐藏的石制密室，其中包含一个带有 Vah Ruta 神圣头盔 的石制宝箱。获得头盔后，“在伟大的鱼下的秘密宝藏”任务完成。

overview_en:
After completing "Sidon of the Zora", Link can find Khira scolding Chroma in the Throne Room of Zora's Domain. She condemns Chroma for acting without self-awareness, since everything they do reflects back on Yona. However, they are interrupted when Chroma notices Link nearby. Khira apologizes for failing to see him, though Chroma claims she was too absorbed in her lecture to do so. This enrages Khira, who reveals that the point of her lecture was because she failed to retrieve the Zora Helm they wanted to give Link, which they learned has been kept in a "sky fish".
Chroma claims that she searched the Zora River for a Fish that had eaten the Zora Helm, but she was unable to find it. Khira informs her that the "sky fish" is likely a metaphor, and she believes she would have understood her had she listened to her guidance. In fear, Chroma asks Link to help her. Afterwards, "The Never-Ending Lecture" will begin.
On Floating Scales Island, Link can come across an entryway on the northeastern side of its tail. At the end of this hallways is a Stone Chest, which holds the Zora Helm inside. Once he obtains the Zora Helm, "The Never-Ending Lecture" will be completed.
overview_zh:
完成《索伊德之怒》后，林克可以在索拉领域的王座室找到基喇正在斥责色玛。她指责色玛缺乏自我意识，因为他们的行为都会反过来影响尤娜。然而，他们被打断，因为色玛注意到了林克的出现。基喇为未能注意到他道歉，但色玛声称她当时正沉浸在自己的教导中无法注意到他。这让基喇非常生气，她透露，她进行这次教导是因为她未能从索拉公主那里拿回他们想要给林克的东西——“天空鱼”。

色玛声称她曾在索拉河寻找一个吞噬了索拉护臂的鱼，但最终没有找到。基喇告诉她，“天空鱼”很可能是一种比喻，她认为如果当时聆听她的建议，她也能理解。出于恐惧，色玛请求林克帮助她。之后，“永无止境的教导”将开始。

在漂浮岛上，林克可以在岛尾东北方的入口处找到一条通道。通道的尽头是一个石箱，里面放着索拉护臂。获得索瓦护臂后，“永无止境的教导”将会完成。

overview_en:
When Link speaks to Seggin after completing "Sidon of the Zora", he reflects on Sidon's recent coronation, stating that Mipha would have been overjoyed if she had seen it. He recalls witnessing Mipha holding her Lightscale Trident in the moonlight, claiming it was beautiful. He wishes to see it once more, at which point "The Moonlit Princess" will begin.
At Mipha Court on Ploymus Mountain, Link can use his Camera to take a Picture of Mipha's Statue during the night. Upon seeing the Picture, Seggin will be shocked by its accuracy. Happy to have seen Mipha in the moonlight once again, he gives Link a Zora Sword as a sign of his gratitude. If Link's Weapon Inventory is full, Seggin will ask him to make room. He then reveals that he used the Sword in the past, and he believes that it could still be useful to Link. Feeling relieved, Seggin declares his loyalty to Sidon and the Zora royalty. Afterwards, "The Moonlit Princess" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在完成《西顿的祝福》后，当林克与赛宾对谈时，他回忆起西顿的加冕，认为米普哈会为此感到高兴。他还记得在月光下看到米普哈拿着她的光鳞三叉戟，并称其美不胜收。他希望再次亲眼见到这把三叉戟，此时《月光公主》剧情将开始。

在普利姆山上的米普哈庭院，林克可以使用相机拍摄夜晚的米普哈雕像的照片。赛宾在看到这张照片后会感到震惊，因为照片非常准确。他很高兴再次见到米普哈，并赠予林克一把水之剑作为感谢。如果林克的武器栏已满，赛宾会要求他清理空间。然后他透露自己曾经使用过这把剑，并认为它仍然可以对林克有所帮助。赛宾感到欣慰，并表示效忠于西顿和泽拉后裔。之后，《月光公主》剧情将完成。
目标：

name_zh: 卓拉族的荣誉“光鳞之枪”
overview_en:
Once "Sidon of the Zora" has been completed, Link can speak to Dento at the Hammerhead workshop. To thank Link for saving Zora's Domain, he wants to craft him a Lightscale Trident, a Weapon passed down by the Zora. In order to do so, however, he needs a Zora Spear, three Diamonds, and five pieces of Flint. Following this conversation, "Glory of the Zora" will begin.
After gathering the necessary supplies, Link must bring them back to Dento, who then proceeds to craft the Lightscale Trident. Once it is completed, Dento gifts the Lightscale Trident to Link. Should Link ever lose or break it, Dento offers to make a new one for him. Afterwards, "Glory of the Zora" will be completed.
overview_zh:
完成“索多的赞欧”后，林克可以与锤头工坊的丹托对话。为了感谢林克拯救赞欧之域，他想为林克打造一把“光鳞三叉枪”，这是赞欧世代相传的武器。为此，他需要一把赞欧长矛、三个钻石和五个燧石。完成此后，“赞欧之荣耀”将会开始。

收集完所有材料后，林克必须将它们带回丹托，然后丹托会制造出“光鳞三叉枪”。完成后，丹托会将“光鳞三叉枪”赠予林克。如果林克丢失或损坏它，丹托将为他制作新的。之后，“赞欧之荣耀”将会完成。
目标：
目标：

overview_en:
Following the completion of "Sidon of the Zora", Link can find Yona overlooking the Zora's Domain Square. When spoken to, she once again thanks him for saving Zora's Domain. She reveals that she wanted to give him the Zora Greaves as a reward, which was inspired by Jiahto finding an ancient text describing them. Since they grant their wearer an easier time Swimming, Yona thinks that they could be useful for finding Zelda. Although Yona has been unable to find the Zora Greaves, the texts suggest that they were offered at the Ancient Zora Waterworks as a symbol of friendship between the Zora and the Hylians. After their conversation, "A Token of Friendship" will begin.
When Link returns to the Ancient Zora Waterworks, he will find that the Water has been drained from its central chamber. On the north side of the Waterworks is a hole, which he can jump down to discover another chamber. Behind a Waterfall at the back of this chamber is a stone Treasure Chest, from which Link can obtain the Zora Greaves. Afterwards, "A Token of Friendship" will be completed.
overview_zh:
完成《索拉之子》后，林克可以在索拉领域广场上找到伊娜。与她交谈时，她再次感谢他拯救了索拉领域。她透露，她想奖励他“索拉护腿”，这源自贾托找到一本古老的文本。由于这件装备能让佩戴者更容易游泳，伊娜认为它们可能对寻找塞尔达有帮助。尽管伊娜无法找到“索拉护腿”，但文本表明，它们曾被作为索拉人和海利亚人的友好象征，在古代索拉水厂提供给他们。与伊娜的对话后，“友谊之礼”将开始。
当林克返回古代索拉水厂时，他会发现水已经从中心房间中排空。在水厂的北部有一个洞，他可以跳下去进入另一个房间。在这个房间的背后，瀑布之后，有一个石质的宝箱，从中林克可以获得“索拉护腿”。之后，“友谊之礼”将完成。

overview_en:
When Link examines the Empty Frame at Wetland Stable, Lawdon will notice his interest. He explains that it was provided to him by the Stable Association so that he can hang up a Picture for his guests. Lawdon wants to display a painting of the Ring Ruins, since they are popular among the patrons of his Stable. Although he can see the Ruins from the Stable, he is not close enough to paint them. Following their conversation, "A Picture for Wetland Stable" will begin.
At Kakariko Village, Link is able to take a Picture of the Large Ring Ruin using the Camera, which he can then show to Lawdon. When he sees the Picture, Lawdon asserts that it is just what he needed, and he asks for Link's permission to make his own copy. If Link agrees, Lawdon expresses his shock at how large the Ring Ruins are. He then proceeds to make his painting, assuring Link that he is talented enough to do so. Once the Picture of the Ring Ruins is complete, Lawdon states that he is proud of it.
Lawdon offers to replace the Picture of the Ring Ruins if Link brings him a new reference. As a reward, Lawdon gives Link one Pony Point. He also gifts Link an Electro Elixir, which he believes will be helpful for his journey. Thanking Link, Lawdon invites him to visit Wetland Stable whenever he wants to. Afterwards, "A Picture for Wetland Stable" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当链接在湿地稳定检查空erçe时，劳顿会注意到他的兴趣。他解释说这erçe是由稳定协会提供的，让他可以悬挂一幅画供客人欣赏。劳顿想要展示《环形遗迹》的绘画，因为这是稳定协会顾客们最喜欢的。虽然他可以看到环形遗迹，但他离得太远无法直接描绘。在与劳顿交谈后，“为湿地稳定提供一幅画”事件开始。

在卡卡里科村，链接可以使用相机拍摄《大环形遗迹》的图片，然后向劳顿展示。当劳顿看到这张照片时，他表示这就是他所需要的，并要求链接允许他制作自己的复制品。如果链接同意，劳顿对环形遗迹的大小感到震惊。然后他开始创作画作，并向链接保证他有能力做到这一点。完成后，“环形遗迹”的绘画完成。

劳顿提出更换《环形遗迹》的画作，以换取新的参考资料。作为奖励，他给了链接一个“马匹点”，还赠送了一个能量药剂，认为这对他旅程会有帮助。劳顿感谢链接，并邀请他随时光临湿地稳定。之后，“为湿地稳定提供一幅画”事件完成。

overview_en:
At Wetland Stable, Link can encounter Ami staring into the nearby woods. He warns Link not to enter the forest during the night, since a Blue Moblin and several Lizalfos have set up a Monster Outpost inside. He complains that he is now unable to use the Wetland Stable South Well that he built due to its proximity to the Outpost. However, he did make the new Wetland Stable Well to replace it. 
Ami is so scared of the Monsters that he is having trouble sleeping and talking straight. He claims that he tried to sneak up on them from behind, but he failed. If the Blue Moblin was gone, Ami thinks he would feel much safer, and he reiterates his warning to stay away from the forest. Following their conversation, "An Uninvited Guest" will begin.
From the bottom of the Wetland Stable Well, Link is able to exit from the Wetland Stable South Well right next to the Monster Outpost. After defeating the Blue Moblin, Link must return to Wetland Stable to inform Ami. He asks Link if he was the one who defeated the Blue Moblin, expressing his amazement and gratitude. Since he does not have any Rupees for a reward, Ami gifts Link two Pony Points. Ami thanks Link once again, stating he will be able to greet customers now. He then runs away, and "An Uninvited Guest" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在湿地稳定处，链接可以遇到阿米盯着附近的森林。他警告链接不要在晚上进入森林，因为蓝恶魔和几个蜥蜴人已经在此建立了怪物据点。他抱怨无法使用自己建造的湿地稳定南井由于靠近据点了。但他确实建造了一个新的湿地稳定井来代替它。
由于对怪物极度恐惧，阿米难以入睡和正常交流。他说他曾尝试从背后偷袭他们，但失败了。如果蓝恶魔不在场，阿米认为自己会感到更加安全，并再次警告不要靠近森林。在他们的对话之后，“不速之客”剧情将开始。

从湿地稳定南井的底部，链接可以穿过湿地稳定，到达位于怪物据点旁边的湿地稳定南井。击败蓝恶魔后，链接必须返回湿地稳定并告知阿米。他询问链接是否是自己击败了蓝恶魔，表达了他的惊讶和感激。由于他不拥有任何 rupee 作为奖励，阿米赠送给链接两个 pony points。阿米再次感谢链接，表示他现在可以接待顾客。然后他跑开了，“不速之客”剧情完成。

overview_en:
Following the completion of "Sidon of the Zora," Ledo can be found at the East Reservoir Lake, looking at the Reservoir Lakefront Cavern. Upon speaking to him, he tells Link about how he found a Cave containing some Blue Stones, points out its location, and he expresses their high quality. However, the Blue Stones are too heavy for him to Swim with, preventing him from working on repairs to Mipha Court. He then states even one Stone would suffice. Afterwards, "The Blue Stone" will begin.
Using the nearby Boards, Fans, and Steering Stick, Link is able to use Ultrahand to build a boat. Link can then use the boat to bring a Blue Stone from the Reservoir Lakefront Cavern back to Ledo, who will express surprise at seeing the stone before regaining his composure, and he also asks Link if he carried the Stone to him. Link then nods, and Ledo thanks him with complete awe. Ledo then rewards Link with the Zora Fabric, which he hopes Link likes. Following this, he sets off to begin his repairs to Mipha Court. He thanks Link again and leaves. Following their conversation, "The Blue Stone" will be completed.
overview_zh:
完成《索德的赞》后，玩家可以在东水库湖畔，眺望水库湖岸洞穴处找到雷多。与他交谈后，他告诉林克自己发现一个含有蓝色石头的洞穴，并指出了它的位置，同时称这些石头质量很高。然而，这些石头对他来说太重了，无法游泳去取，因此他无法进行米帕宫的修复工作。随后，他表示只需要一块石头即可。之后，“蓝色石头”事件将开始。

使用附近的板子、风扇和舵柄，林克可以使用Ultrahand建造一条船。然后，林克可以用这艘船从水库湖岸洞穴处取回一块“蓝色石头”，并将其带给雷多。雷多惊讶地看到这块石头，随后恢复了镇定，并询问林克是否将这个石头带给了他。林克点了点头，而雷多对林克表示崇高的感谢。然后，雷多向林克赠送“索拉织物”。之后，他开始修复米帕宫。他再次感谢林克，然后离开。在与林克的对话后，“蓝色石头”事件将完成。

overview_en:
Inside Zelda's Secret Well in Hateno Village, Link can find Zelda's Diary on her desk. Within her Diary, Zelda reveals that she has commissioned a new Champion's Tunic for Link, since she has noticed his old one has become worn. In order to keep him from discovering it during their expedition Beneath Hyrule Castle, Zelda hid the new Champion's Tunic in the Throne Room of Hyrule Castle. She also wrote that the Throne Room's Torches are the key to revealing its hiding place. After reading Zelda's Diary, the "A New Champion's Tunic" Side Quest will begin.
The remaining throne in Hyrule Castle's Throne Room is flanked on either side by a pair of stationary Torches. Striking the Torches with Flint, Fire Fruit, or Red Chuchu Jelly will ignite them. Once both Torches have been lit, the statue behind the throne will move to the side, revealing an Iron Treasure Chest in the base of its pedestal. Using Ultrahand, Link can pull out the Chest and open it, receiving the Champion's Leathers from inside. Immediately afterwards, "A New Champion's Tunic" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在海特诺村的泽尔秘密井中，林克可以找到泽尔的书桌上的《泽尔日记》。书中，泽尔透露她已经为林克订购了一件新的冠军战袍，因为她注意到他原来的战袍已经破旧。为了防止他在与城堡下方的探险期间发现它，泽尔将新的冠军战袍藏在了海伦堡的王座室中。她还写道，王座室中的火炬是揭示其藏身之处的关键。阅读完《泽尔日记》后，“全新冠军战袍”支线任务将会开始。

海伦堡王座室剩下的王座两侧分别有两根静止的火炬。用燧石、火果或红虫子果点燃这些火炬。一旦两根火炬都点燃，位于王座后面的雕像会移动到一侧，露出它底部的铁箱。林克可以使用 Ultrahand 将箱子拉出来并打开，从而获得里面的冠军皮甲。随后，“全新冠军战袍”任务将会完成。

overview_en:
If Link visits the Hateno School during the day, he will find Symin preparing to teach his students a lesson about the Great Calamity. At the start of the lesson, he explains that several Great Calamities have occurred throughout the history of Hyrule, and 10,000 years ago, it was sealed away by a princess and the Ancient Hero. Aster interjects, claiming that this story is a fairy tale. Azu agrees, staring that legend is often blurred with history over time. Karin also wonders what the significance of events 10,000 years in the past could be. Lastly, Sefaro asks for proof of a Great Calamity from 10,000 years ago.
Symin attempts to convince the students that a Great Calamity happened 10,000 years ago, but he realizes that he will need to find proof in order to do so. He claims that he should have had the foresight to borrow the Screen of the Ancient Hero from Impa's House, but it is too far for him to ask for it now. He believes that by seeing the Screen, his students would be able to conceptualize the Great Calamity. Following their conversation, "Teach Me a Lesson I" will begin.
The Screen of the Ancient Hero can be found in Paya's Room on the second floor of Impa's House. Using the Purah Pad's Camera, Link can take a Picture of the Screen. Upon showing the Picture to Symin, he tells his class to look at it for themselves. Aster is impressed by how real it looks, while Azu is shocked that the legend was true. Seeing the Screen makes Karin feel as though it happened yesterday. Sefaro considers the Screen to be enough proof that the Great Calamity actually happened, and he urges Symin to tell them more.
Before moving on with the lesson, Symin thanks Link and asks if he is willing to sit in on his lecture. If Link agrees to listen, Symin explains that Calamity Ganon was sealed away due to the efforts of the Divine Beasts and the ancient princess, the Ancient Hero was capable of defeating the Calamity and bringing peace to Hyrule.
When Symin implies that Calamity Ganon yet again returned, Karin demands to know more. Symin reveals that 100 years ago, a Fortune Teller predicted that Calamity Ganon would return, and when the Divine Beasts were excavated, four Champions were selected as their pilots. Despite having both Princess Zelda and the hero Link, Hyrule was still threatened by Calamity Ganon, Sefaro asks if something happened. Symin reveals that Zelda was unable to awaken her sealing powers until after the Divine Beasts were overtaken and Link was injured, at which point she sacrificed herself to seal Calamity Ganon away for 100 years.
Checking that his students are following along, Symin reveals that Link awoke from his Slumber of Restoration after 100 years, and from there, he reclaimed the Divine Beasts and helped Zelda seal Calamity Ganon. After finishing his story, Symin apologizes for becoming emotional, though he asserts that it truly happened. Standing from her chair, Aster realizes that they owe their lives to those who have fought against Calamity Ganon. Azu proclaims that he wants to be like the Ancient Hero.
With his lesson completed, Symin is relieved to have successfully taught his students. He once again thanks Link for bringing him the Picture, giving him 10 stalks of Hylian Rice as a reward. Symin claims that the development of new vegetables in Hateno Village have lead to Hylian Rice being farmed less, which he is disappointed by. He quietly adds that his next lesson is on home economics and involves Hylian Rice dishes. Afterwards, "Teach Me a Lesson I" will be completed.
overview_zh:
如果在白天，林克前往哈特诺学校，他会发现西米姆正在为学生们讲述关于大灾难的故事。课程开始时，他解释说，在英灵的历史中，已经发生过多次大灾难，10,000年前，公主和英灵封印了它。阿斯特插话，称这只是一个童话故事。阿祖同意，表示传说与历史经常随时间混淆。卡林也想知道10,000年前的事件可能具有何种意义。最后，赛法要求提供10,000年前的大灾难证据。

西米姆试图说服学生们相信10,000年前发生了大灾难，但他意识到他需要找到证据来证明这一点。他声称自己应该早该借用英灵的屏幕（来自伊帕的住所），但现在已经太晚了。他认为通过观看屏幕后，他的学生们就能理解大灾难。在与他们的讨论之后，“Teach Me a Lesson I”将开始。

英灵的屏幕位于伊帕的住所第二层，页亚房间。林克可以使用普拉帕드의相机拍照。向西米姆展示照片后，他让学生自己来观察。阿斯特对它的逼真程度感到赞叹，而阿祖则震惊于这传说是真实的。看到屏幕后，卡琳感觉就像事情发生在昨天。赛法认为这张照片已经足够证明大灾难确实发生过，并要求西米姆再讲述更多。

在继续上课之前，西米姆感谢林克，询问他是否愿意参与他的讲座。如果林克同意听讲，西米姆解释说，盖侬被封印是因为神兽和古代公主的努力。英灵有能力击败灾难，为英灵带来和平。

当西米姆暗示盖侬又返回时，卡林要求更多信息。西米姆透露，100年前，一位算命的人预言盖侬将再次回到，并且在挖掘神兽之后，被选出了四位驾驶员。尽管有公主塞尔达和英灵林克，但英灵仍然受到盖侬的威胁，赛法问道：“发生了什么？”西米姆透露，塞尔达直到神兽被占领，并且林克受伤后才能够唤醒封印力量，此时她牺牲自己将盖侬封印100年。

为了确认学生是否跟随他的讲座，西米姆向林克展示他所知道的情况，并询问林克是否了解了塞尔达和英灵在100年前的经过。
通过这次课程，西米姆成功地向学生们传授知识，再次感谢林克的礼物——10根海莲米，并说这是为了促进哈特诺村新蔬菜的生长而做的。

overview_en:
Following Symin's lecture on the Great Calamity, he decides to teach his students about Hylian Rice dishes. He invites Link to listen in on the lesson if he is interested.
Symin starts his lecture by introducing home economics, claiming that Food is essential for survival. He then asks what will happen if Goron Spice, Hylian Rice, and Raw Meat are Cooked together. Azu clarifies that Goron Spice is the hot seasoning sold in Goron City. Karin correctly identifies that the result would be a type of curry, and Aster and Sefaro deduce it must be Meat Curry.
Since his students were able to correctly guess the answer, Symin instead asks what can be made by Cooking Goron Spice, Hylian Rice, and Monster Extract together. Azu is confused by Monster Extract, and Karin and Aster recall that unless used for medicine, Cooking with Monster Parts is not possible. Sefaro believes that Symin is trying to give them a trick question.
Symin tells the class to calm down, though he acknowledges that his lesson might be too advanced. He informs the students that the result of this Recipe would be Monster Curry, but he realizes that they will not believe him unless they see it. Unfortunately, he does not have any Monster Extract to make Monster Curry, especially since it can only be found in Tarrey Town to the north. After this, "Teach Me a Lesson II" will begin.
Using a Cooking Pot, Link can Cook a serving of Monster Curry. When Link sits in on the next lesson, Symin is able to smell it from his Inventory. If Link agrees to share his Monster Curry, Symin invites the class to come sample it. Despite their concerns, the students find that Monster Curry is actually delicious. Symin assures his class that while Monster Parts can usually only be used when making medicine, Monster Extract can be used to make meals.
Symin is relieved that his students finally understand what he was trying to teach them. He thanks Link for his assistance, claiming that this lesson has lead the children to mature. Aster tells Link that he made their history lesson fun, and Azu claims that his Monster Curry tasted great. Karin declares that she already thinks of Link as her teacher. Lastly, Sefaro states that he cannot wait for their next lesson.
Due to Link's popularity with the students, Symin allows him to use the School's Field. Although space is limited, he gives Link permission to plant whatever he would like, and he directs him to speak with Uma to set it up. He quietly informs Link that he is planning a test for his students, and he hopes that he will join their classes again. Afterwards, "Teach Me a Lesson II" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在西米因讲解“大灾难”之后，他决定向学生们介绍赫伊利亚米饭菜。 他邀请林克旁听。

西米因的讲座从介绍家庭生活开始，强调食物对生存的重要性。 然后他问如果将高鲁辛调味料、赫伊利亚米和生肉一起烹饪会怎样。 阿兹解释说，高鲁辛调味料是高鲁辛城出售的一种辣味料。 凯琳正确地推断结果是一种咖喱，艾斯特和塞法罗则得出答案是肉咖喱。

由于学生们能够正确猜出答案，西米因转向问如果将高鲁辛调味料、赫伊利亚米和怪物提取物一起烹饪会怎样。 阿兹对怪物提取物的来源感到困惑，凯琳和艾斯特回忆起，除非用于药品，否则无法使用怪物部分。 塞法罗认为西米因在给他们出示一个陷阱问题。

西米因让大家冷静下来，尽管他承认他的课程可能过于深入。 他告诉学生们，这种食谱的结果是怪物咖喱，但他意识到只有通过实际操作才能让他们相信。 不幸的是，他没有怪物提取物，特别是因为这种提取物只能在北方的塔雷镇找到。 之后，“第二课”将开始。

通过烹饪锅，林克可以制作约一份怪物咖喱。 当林克旁听下一次课程时，西米因可以通过他的背包闻到它的味道。 如果林克同意分享他的怪物咖喱，西米因邀请学生们品尝。 尽管他们有顾虑，但学生们发现怪物咖喱实际上很好吃。 西米因向他的学生保证，虽然怪物部分通常只能用于制作药品，但可以使用怪物提取物来制作食物。

西米因很高兴学生们终于理解了他想传授的知识。 他感谢林克协助，说这堂课让孩子们成熟。 艾斯特告诉林克他让他们的历史课程变得有趣，而阿兹则说他的怪物咖喱味道很好。 凯琳已经把林克当成她的老师。 最后，塞法罗表示他期待着下一次课程。

由于林克的受欢迎程度，西米因允许他使用学校的田地。 虽然空间有限，但他允许林克种植自己想要的东西，并让他与乌玛联系以安排这一切。 他悄悄告诉林克，他正在为学生们安排测试，并且希望他再次加入他们的课堂。 之后，“第二课”将完成。

overview_en:
At the end of the "Teach Me a Lesson II" Side Quest, Symin gives Link permission to cultivate crops in the School's Field. At the Field, Link will find Uma tending to it. When Link approaches her, she reveals that Symin has already spoken to her about planting whatever Link wants and she has already finished preparing the Field. Uma claims she is capable of a variety of Fruits and Vegetables by extracting seeds from them. However, she is inexperienced in raising Endura Carrots and Hearty Radishes, and such harvests may have a lower yield than other crops. At this point, the "Uma's Garden" Side Quest will begin.
Uma then asks Link which crop he would like to grow. So long as Link has their grown counterparts, Link can ask Uma to plant Hylian Tomatoes, Wildberries, Hydromelons, Big Hearty Radishes, Hearty Radishes, Endura Carrots, Fortified Pumpkins, Sun Pumpkins, Swift Carrots, Hylian Rice, and Tabantha Wheat. Once Link makes his choice, Uma will take one of the crops from his Inventory. She explains that she will be unable to return it to him, but she can change out what she is growing if he wants something else instead. She also asks Link allow her to witness his first harvest. Lastly, Uma informs Link that it will take some time before his crops are ready, and sleeping in a Bed or waiting by a Campfire will not make them grow faster.
After two in-game days, the crops at the School's Field will be ready to harvest. When Link returns to the Field, Uma will greet him. She thanks him for being patient, pointing out how delicious the newly grown crops look. Uma encourages Link to do whatever he wants with his produce, and she tells him to inform her when he wants to grow something new. Following their conversation, "Uma's Garden" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在《教我一课 II》支线任务结束时，西敏允许林克在学校的田地里种植作物。 林克在田地中会找到宇玛，此时宇玛告诉林克，西敏已经和她商议过要种植什么，并且已经为这块土地做好了准备。 宇玛声称自己可以通过提取种子来种植各种水果和蔬菜。 然而，她对培育“安朵拉胡萝卜”和“强壮萝卜”的经验有限，因此这些作物的产量可能低于其他作物。 此后，“宇玛的花园”支线任务将开始。

宇玛询问林克想要种植什么作物。 只要林克有对应的种子，他就可以让宇玛种植“希莲番茄”、“野莓”、“水蜜桃”、“强壮萝卜”、“安朵拉胡萝卜”、“坚固南瓜”、“太阳南瓜”、“闪电萝卜”、“希莲米”和“塔班达小麦”。 一旦林克做出选择，宇玛会从他的物品栏中拿走相应的作物。 她解释说无法将作物还给他，但他可以更换种植内容。 此外，她也请林克允许她见证他的首次收成。 最后，宇玛告知林克，这些作物需要一段时间才能成熟，睡觉或在篝火旁等待并不能加速它们的生长。

经过两天的游戏时间，学校的田地中的作物已经可以收获了。 当林克返回田地时，宇玛会迎接他。 她感谢他的耐心，并指出新种植的作物的味道很好。 宇玛鼓励林克随意使用这些作物，并要求他告诉她何时想要种植其他东西。 在他们的对话之后，“宇玛的花园”支线任务将被完成。
