name_en: A Way to Trade, Washed Away
overview_en:
After completing the "Village Attacked by Pirates" and "Lurelin Village Restoration Project" Side Adventures, Link can find Garini at the dock in Lurelin Village. He seems defeated, and he tells Link that with his Boat gone, he cannot open the Lurelin Village Store. Unfortunately, he cannot borrow one, because all the Boats in the village got washed out when the Monsters attacked.
Usually, things that float out from their Village tend to wash up on Tenoko Island,. But he cannot get there himself, so his store will have to stay closed.
Link then has to bring a Boat back from Tenoko Island. When he is close enough, Garini will call to him and Link will be transported to the dock.
He thanks Link for his help and takes a moment to put the Lurelin Village Store back together, before offering Link a Star Fragment. Then, "A Way to Trade, Washed Away" will be completed.
overview_zh:
完成“海盗袭击村庄”和“洛瑞琳村复兴计划”支线任务后，林可以找到加尔尼在洛瑞琳村的码头。他看起来很沮丧，并告诉林，由于他的船被毁，无法打开洛瑞琳村商店。不幸的是，他也借不到别人的船，因为怪物袭击时，村里的所有船都沉没了。

通常情况下，漂浮离开村庄的东西会冲上天诺岛。但加尔尼自己无法去那里，所以商店就无法开业。
林需要从天诺岛带回一艘船。当他足够接近时，加尔尼就会呼叫，并将被转移到码头。

加尔尼感谢林给予的帮助，然后在重新整理洛瑞琳村商店之前，向林提供一颗星碎片。然后，“交易的方式被冲刷”，任务完成。
目标：

name_en: A Picture for Dueling Peaks Stable
overview_en:
When Link inspects the Empty Frame at Dueling Peaks Stable, its owner Tasseren will take note of him. He explains that it was given to him by the Stable Association so that he can display a Picture for his patrons. Tasseren wants to decorate it with a scene depicting the sunrise, as seen from the summit of Tuft Mountain. While he is unable to see the view for himself, Tasseren claims he would be able to paint it if he saw it. Afterwards, "A Picture for Dueling Peaks Stable" will begin.
From Tuft Mountain, Link will be able to use his Camera to take a Picture of the sunrise, which he can then show to Tasseren. Upon seeing the Picture, Tasseren is amazed and asks for permission to copy it. If Link agrees, Tasseren thanks him for bringing the Picture. He then proceeds to recreate the Picture for himself, promising he is talented enough to do so. Once the Picture of Hyrule's Finest Sunrise is complete, Tasseren declares that it is perfect.
Tasseren informs Link that he is willing to replace it with another Picture of Hyrule's Finest Sunrise if he is provided with another reference. He then rewards Link will one Pony Point. In addition to this, he gives Link a Hasty Apple Pie, which is a specialty of Dueling Peaks Stable. Tasseren once again thanks Link for the Picture, inviting him to visit the Stable whenever he wants to. Following their conversation, "A Picture for Dueling Peaks Stable" will be finished.
overview_zh:
当林克检查位于双峰赛马场的“空架”时，其主人塔塞伦会注意到他。他解释说，这架木架是由赛马协会赠送的，以便他向顾客展示一幅画。塔塞伦希望用描绘日出景象（从图夫山顶看到的景象）来装饰它。虽然他无法亲眼看到这个景象，但他声称如果能看到的话，就能画出来。随后，“为双峰赛马场制作画”开始。

在图夫山上，林克可以使用他的相机拍摄日出的照片，然后向塔塞伦展示。当塔塞伦看到这张照片时，他惊讶不已并要求获得复制的许可。如果林克同意，塔塞伦感谢他带来这幅画。然后他开始为自己制作这张画，并保证他有能力做到。一旦“图尔王城的最佳日出”画作完成，塔塞伦宣布它完美无缺。

塔塞伦告知林克，如果能提供另一幅图尔王城最佳日出的参考画，他愿意用另一幅代替。然后他奖励了林克一个“速食苹果派”，这是双峰赛马场的特产。塔塞伦再次感谢林克带来这幅画，并邀请他随时来参观赛马场。在与林克的对话之后，“为双峰赛马场制作画”就完成了。
目标：

overview_en:
You met Sesami of the monster-control crew on Eventide Island in Hyrule's southeastern sea.

He was sent to scout out a pirate hideout, but the three monster strongholds on the island are hindering his progress.
overview_zh:
你在海拉鲁东南海域的丧命岛遇到了讨伐队的塞萨米。

他奉命侦察海盗基地，但岛上三处怪物据点挡住了他的去路。
目标：

overview_en:
When Link inspects the Empty Frame at Lakeside Stable, the owner of the Stable, Anly, will notice him doing so. He explains that it was sent to him by the Stable Association so he could display a Picture for guests. After much thought, Anly has decided he would like to hang up a painting of the Floria Falls during clear Weather. However, Anly is unable to leave the Stable for long periods of time, and it is rare for the Weather in the area to remain clear. Anly claims that if someone brought him a Picture of this setting, then he would be able to recreate it for the Frame. Following this conversation, "A Picture for Lakeside Stable" will begin.
Using the Camera, Link is able to capture an image of Floria Falls when the Weather is clear, which he can then show to Anly. When he sees the Picture, Anly claims it is exactly what he needed, and he asks for Link's permission to make a copy. Should Link agree, Anly states that he is moved by the Picture, and he believes it will make travelers happy they came to visit. He then proceeds to make his own copy, which he assures Link he is capable of doing. Once the Picture of Floria Falls on a Clear Day is completed, Anly declares that it is perfect.
If Link ever wants to replace the Picture of Floria Falls on a Clear Day with a new version, Anly offers to repaint it so long as he is provided with a new reference. As a reward, he gives Link one Pony Point. He also gifts him a Tough Tomato Seafood Soup, which is a specialty of Lakeside Stable. Once again, Anly thanks Link for the Picture, and he invites him to visit the Stable whenever he needs. Afterwards, "A Picture for Lakeside Stable" will be finished.
overview_zh:
当林克检查湖边马厩的空框时，马厩的主人安莉会注意到。他解释说，这是马联寄给他的，以便他向客人展示一幅画。经过深思熟虑，安理决定把他现在想挂在马厩里的，是在晴朗天气时拍摄的弗洛里亚瀑的照片。但是，由于安理无法长时间离开马厩，而且该地区的天气通常并不晴朗，安理认为如果有人给他带来这幅照片，他就能为空框制作一幅类似的画。
之后，林克用相机在天气晴朗时拍摄了弗洛里亚瀑的照片，然后向安理展示。当安理看到这张照片后，他说这是他所需要的，并要求林克的许可来复制它。如果林克同意，安理表示被这幅照片感动，他相信这能让旅行者感到开心。他随后自己复制了一幅画，并向林克保证自己有能力做到。完成“晴朗天气下的弗洛里亚瀑”后，安理宣布这张画是完美的。
如果林克将来想用新的版本替换“晴朗天气下的弗洛里亚瀑”，安理会提供重新绘制服务的，前提是他能够获得新的参考照片。作为奖励，他会给林克一个 Pony Point 以及一份 特色菜 Tough Tomato Seafood Soup ，这正是湖边马厩的特色。 再次感谢林克送来的画作，并邀请他随时来参观马厩。 “为湖边马厩制作画”最终完成。

overview_en:
When Link examines the Empty Frame at Highland Stable, Padok will notice his interest. He reveals that the Stable Association has given it to the Stable in order to display a Picture. Having heard a rumor about the Giant White Stallion, Padok wants to display a Picture of it. Although he has heard it can be found near the Lake of the Horse God to the southeast, Padok is hesitant to leave the Stable based on only a rumor. However, he claims he would be able to create a painting from a Picture of the Giant White Stallion. If Link has already registered the Giant White Stallion, Padok will recall that they are looking after such a Horse for him. Afterwards, "A Picture for Highland Stable" will start.
After taking a Picture of the Giant White Stallion with the Camera, Link will be able to show it to Padok. Once he sees the Picture, Padok claims it is what he needed to see, and he asks for Link's permission to copy it. If Link agrees, Padok will imagine riding the Giant White Stallion across the plains. He then proceeds to paint the Picture, assuring Link that he is talented enough to replicate it. Upon completing the Picture of the Giant White Stallion, he will declare that it is perfect, and he looks forward to displaying it proudly.
Should Link want to replace the Picture of the Giant White Stallion, Padok offers to do so, as long as a new reference Picture is provided. To reward Link for his assistance, Padok gives him one Pony Point. He also gives Link an Energizing Honey Crepe, which is a specialty of Highland Stable. Padok thanks Link for the Picture, inviting him to use the Stable's facilities whenever he needs. Following this, "A Picture for Highland Stable" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克在海伦德稳定检查空erçe时，帕多会注意到他的兴趣。他透露，稳定协会将这个 çerçe赠给稳定，以便展示一幅画。帕多听说过关于巨型白色马驹的传闻，想要展示这幅画。虽然他听说可以在东南方向的神兽湖附近找到它，但帕多因为只靠传闻而犹豫不决。但他声称自己可以根据马驹的照片进行绘画。如果林克已经注册了巨型白色马驹，帕多会想起他们正在为他照看这样一匹马。之后，“为海伦德稳定准备画作”将开始。

在用相机拍摄巨型白色马驹的照片后，林克可以将它展示给帕多。当他看到照片时，帕多表示这就是他需要的，并要求林克的许可来复制它。如果林克同意，帕多会想象自己骑着巨型白色马驹穿过平原。然后他开始绘画，向林克保证自己有能力复制它。完成巨型白色马驹的画作后，他宣布这是完美的，并期待着骄傲地展示它。

如果林克想要更换巨型白色马驹的照片，帕多表示可以，只要提供新的参考照片即可。作为奖励，帕多给林克一个pony点，他还给林克一份能量蜜饼，这是海伦德稳定的特色食物。帕多感谢林克的帮忙，邀请他随时使用稳定设施。之后，“为海伦德稳定准备画作”将被完成。
目标：

name_zh: 沉睡于格鲁德沙漠的秘宝
overview_en: When Link returns to Gerudo Town after completing "Riju of Gerudo Town", he can speak to Riju, who asks if her Sage Avatar has been helpful.
overview_zh: 当林克完成《瑞朱》（Riju of Gerudo Town）任务后返回格鲁多镇，他可以与瑞朱对话，询问她的圣灵形态是否有所帮助。

name_zh: 格鲁德族的骄傲“七宝武具”
overview_en:
After both "Riju of Gerudo Town" and "The Missing Owner" have been completed, Link can speak to Isha in front of Starlight Memories, who thanks him for saving Gerudo Town. To repay him for his assistance, she offers to craft the Arms of the Seven for him, which consist of the Scimitar of the Seven and the Daybreaker. Since she is the only one who knows how to craft them, she has chosen Link to wield them, and she asks if he wants them.
If Link agrees to take on the Arms of the Seven, Isha reveals that their wielder must gather the supplies needed to craft them. In total, she needs four Diamonds, 10 pieces of Flint, a Gerudo Scimitar, and a Gerudo Shield, at which point she will be able to make them for him. After this conversation, "Pride of the Gerudo" will begin.
When Link returns to Isha with all of the supplies, she will proceed to craft the Arms of the Seven for him. Afterwards, she will present him with the Scimitar of the Seven and Daybreaker, claiming to have poured her heart into making them. She also wishes Link luck on his journey.
Isha reveals that she has only ever made the Arms of the Seven for one other person, that being Riju. She also claims that an ancestor of hers made them for Urbosa, the Champion of the Gerudo. Although Isha wants them to be taken care of well, she offers to make new ones of Link breaks or loses them. Lastly, she invites Link to visit her whenever he wants. Following this conversation, "Pride of the Gerudo" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在完成《格鲁多镇的莉朱》和《失踪的主人》后，林克可以在“星光记忆”前与伊莎交谈，她感谢他拯救了格鲁多镇。为了报答他的帮助，她同意为他制作“七武士之剑”和“日破”，因为只有她知道如何制作它们。因此，她选择了林克来使用它们，并询问他是否要接受。

如果林克同意使用“七武士之剑”，伊莎会透露这需要收集制作所需的材料：总共需要4颗钻石、10块燧石、一把格鲁多剑和一把格鲁多盾牌。完成这些后，她就能为他制作。之后，剧情将进入《格鲁多的骄傲》。
当林克带着所有材料回到伊莎时，她会继续为他制作“七武士之剑”。之后，她会把“七武士之剑”和“日破”赠予林克，并表示倾注了全部心血。同时，她也祝愿林克旅途顺利。
伊莎透露她只为一个人制作过“七武士之剑”，那就是莉朱。她还声称她的祖先曾为乌波萨（格鲁多的冠军）制作过“七武士之剑”。虽然伊莎希望林克好好使用它们，但如果损坏或丢失，她会免费为他制作新的。最后，她邀请林克随时来拜访。完成这些对话后，《格鲁多的骄傲》剧情将结束。
目标：
目标：

overview_en:
In either the Gerudo Shelter or Starlight Memories, Link can find Cara wondering where Isha has gone. When Link approaches her, she becomes distracted trying to determine his measurements. She explains that she makes Accessories, and it is important for them to fit perfectly on their wearers. Despite offering to make Accessories for Link, she reveals that the Jewelry Shop's owner, Isha, could make more for him. However, she has yet to return from searching for adornments in the Toruma Dunes, which is the home of a Molduga. At this point in the conversation, "The Missing Owner" will begin.
In the Toruma Dunes, Link can find Isha cowering on a rock pillar as a Molduga circles her. She laments not paying attention to her surroundings, and while she is safe on the pillar, she is unable to leave without alerting it to her location. She quietly pleads for the Molduga to go away.
Once the Molduga has been defeated, Isha will be shocked. She then asks Link if he was the one who killed it. After he confirms this, she is surprised to have met such a strong man, claiming that is must be fate. She introduces herself, inviting him to come to Starlight Memories and receive a reward from her. Though she is concerned he will not be able to enter Gerudo Town, Isha is certain that they will meet again. Now that it is safe to do so, she leaves for Gerudo Town.
When Link returns to Gerudo Town, he will find Cara speaking with Isha. Upon noticing Link, Cara reveals that Isha told her that he saved her. She thanks him and gives him a Diamond as a reward. She is impressed that he was able to defeat a Molduga. Isha thanks Link for helping her return to Gerudo Town, and she expresses her shock that he is Riju's honored guest. For her own reward, she tells Link to talk to her when he has time, since it is more involved. Afterwards, "The Missing Owner" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在格鲁多的庇护所或星光回忆中，林克可以找到卡拉询问伊莎去了哪里。当林克接近她时，她开始尝试测量他的尺寸。她解释说，她制作饰品，这些饰品必须完美地适合佩戴者。尽管她提议为林克制作饰品，但她透露，珠宝店的老板伊莎可以为他制作更多。然而，她仍在在托鲁玛沙丘寻找装饰品，那里有一只墨都加。此时对话将开始“失踪的房主”。

在托鲁玛沙丘中，林克可以找到伊莎躲在一个岩石柱上，而一只墨都加在她周围徘徊。她后悔没有注意自己的周围环境，虽然她身处岩石柱上，但无法离开而不引起墨都加的注意。她低声恳求墨都加离开。

当墨都加被击败后，伊莎会感到震惊。然后她问林克是否是杀死它的那个人。确认后，她惊讶于遇到这样一个强大的男人，并认为这是命运的安排。她自我介绍，邀请他前往星光回忆领取奖励。虽然她担心他无法进入格鲁多镇，但伊莎确信他们还会再次相遇。现在安全了，于是她前往格鲁多镇。

当林克返回格鲁多镇时，他会看到卡拉与伊莎交谈。注意到林克后，卡拉透露伊莎告诉她林克救了她。她感谢他并给予他一颗钻石作为奖励。她对林克能够击败墨都加感到惊讶。伊莎感谢林克帮助她返回格鲁多镇，并表示震惊于林克是瑞居的尊贵的客人。为报答，她建议林克如果有空就来找她，因为这会比较复杂。之后，“失踪的房主”将会完成。

overview_en:
After the "Riju of Gerudo Town" Main Quest is completed, Pokki can be found at the Sand-Seal Rental Shop East Gate Booth talking with Frelly. Link can eavesdrop to hear Pokki ask Frelly if any of her customers have seen ruins with large statues facing each other. Frelly comments on how there are a number of ruins throughout Gerudo Desert and asks if Pokki has a map or any other information to clarify which ruins she is talking about. Pokki complains that she used to have a map, but it was carried off by the wind and lost, and now the only thing she remembers is that the ruins are somewhere in the eastern desert. Frelly tries to think longer, but notices Link standing nearby and apologizes to Pokki stating that she needs to get back to work. This starts the Side Quest, "To the Ruins!"
Pokki can then be found pacing nearby, pondering what she can do to get to the ruins. If Link speaks with her, she will ask him if he has ever seen the ruins she was talking to Frelly about. She asks if Link could take her to the ruins on a Sleigh Seal for a reward. If Link declines, she says it is not a big deal since most Gerudo do not even know about the ruins. If Link agrees to take her, she will wait by the East Gate to the town. Link can rent a Sleigh Seal from either the Sand-Seal Rental Shop East Gate Booth or the Sand-Seal Rental Shop West Gate Booth on the other of Gerudo Town.
overview_zh:
在完成主线任务“古罗多镇的里朱”后，玩家可以在沙丘租车店东门售点与弗雷莉交谈时找到波基。莱恩可以偷听波基向弗雷莉询问是否有顾客见过有大型雕像互相面对的遗迹。弗雷莉评论说，在古罗多沙漠中有许多遗迹，并询问波基是否有名地图或其他信息来明确她所指的遗迹。波基抱怨说她曾有一张地图，但被风吹走了，现在只记得这些遗迹在东部沙漠某个地方。弗雷莉试图思考，但注意到莱恩在附近，向波基道歉，表示她需要回到工作岗位。这触发了支线任务“前往遗迹！”
之后，玩家可以在附近的区域找到正在思索如何到达遗迹的波基。如果莱恩与她交谈，她会询问他是否见过她说过的那些遗迹。她要求莱恩乘坐雪橇狗带她去这些遗迹，并提供报酬。如果莱恩拒绝，她说这无关紧要，因为大多数古罗多人甚至不知道这些遗迹。如果莱恩同意带她，她就在东门等待。玩家可以在沙丘租车店的东门售点或西门售点（位于古罗多的另一侧）租用雪橇狗。
目标：
目标：

name_en: A Picture for the Closed Stable I
overview_en:
At the end of the "Piaffe, Packed Away" Side Quest, Piaffe claims it would be nice to decorate the Empty Frames at Gerudo Canyon Stable before it closes for good. When Link examines one of the Frames, Piaffe asks if he is interested. He explains that he forgot about them due to how busy he was cleaning out the Stable. Feeling indebted to the role Gerudo Canyon Stable played in his life, he wants to decorate them before he leaves.
Piaffe recalls a Rito traveler once told him that when they looked down at Spectacle Rock while flying overhead, it appears to be smiling. Piaffe believes that a smile would be the best way to say goodbye to the Stable, and so he wants to frame a Picture of this sight. Although he is unable to take a Picture of this for himself, he believes that he would be able to copy one that someone else took.
overview_zh:
在“Piaffe, Packed Away”支线任务的结尾，Piaffe 建议在盖鲁多峡谷马厩关闭前，先装饰一下空置的画框。当林克检查其中一个画框时，Piaffe 询问他是否感兴趣。他解释说，由于他一直在清理马厩，已经忘记了这些小细节。 他因为盖鲁多峡谷马厩在他的人生中扮演的重要角色而感到不忘，所以想在离开之前装饰它们。
Piaffe 还记得一些鸟人曾告诉他，从Spectacle Rock上俯瞰时，它似乎在微笑。Piaffe 认为，将这个景象作为画框是送别马厩的最佳方式，因此他想将这幅画框装裱起来。虽然他无法自己拍摄这张照片，但他相信能够找到别人的照片来复制。

name_en: A Picture for the Closed Stable II
overview_en:
At the end of the "Piaffe, Packed Away" Side Quest, Piaffe claims it would be nice to decorate the Empty Frames at Gerudo Canyon Stable before it closes for good. The second time Link examines one of the Empty Frames, Piaffe will notice his interest. He reveals that the Stable Association accidentally sent him two Frames, but he has decided to use both to say goodbye to the Stable.
For the second Empty Frame, Piaffe wants to display a Picture of the Forgotten Sword near Gerudo Summit. However, Piaffe is unable to visit it himself since he needs to clean, and he dislikes the Freezing Climate of the Gerudo Highlands. Piaffe is willing to copy a Picture of the Forgotten Sword so he can display it in the Stable. Afterwards, "A Picture for the Closed Stable II" will begin.
overview_zh:
在“Piaffe, Packed Away”支线任务结束时，Piaffe称赞Link可以在Gerudo Canyon Stable关闭前，装饰一下空置的画框。当Link第二次查看一个空置的画框时，Piaffe会注意到。他透露，Stable Association无意中将两个画框寄给了他，但他决定把这两个画框都用来告别Stable。
为了第二个空置的画框，Piaffe想在Gerudo Summit附近展示一把“Forgotten Sword”的图片。然而，Piaffe无法亲自前往，因为他需要清洁，并且不喜欢Gerudo Highlands的寒冷气候。Piaffe愿意复制一把“Forgotten Sword”的图片，以便在Stable中展示。之后，“A Picture for the Closed Stable II”将开始。

overview_en:
At the Gerudo Canyon Stable, Link will find Piaffe surrounded by Wooden Box, wondering if he is ever going to be able to clean them all up. When Link approaches Piaffe, he reveals that the Stable has been closed due to a lack of visitors and Zelda's order to stay away from the Gerudo Canyon Well. Although she promised to return to fix the Well's problem, she has yet to do so. If "The Blocked Well" Side Adventure is not yet completed, Piaffe apologizes for letting his sadness get to him, and he recommends going to Kara Kara Bazaar if Link needs a place to rest.
If Link has already completed "The Blocked Well", he can inform Piaffe that Zelda was trying to prevent Monsters from attacking Gerudo Canyon Stable, Piaffe will be shocked. He recalls that Monster sightings in the area increased after the Gerudo Canyon Well was built, only ceasing after it was sealed, but he was too busy cleaning out the Stable to notice. He thanks Link for looking into it, resolving to thank Zelda the next time he sees her. At the end of either scenario, Piaffe decides to return to cleaning out the Stable, even though he is unsure how to deal with the scale of his mess. Afterwards, "Piaffe, Packed Away" will begin.
When Link breaks all of the Wooden Boxes in Gerudo Canyon Stable, Piaffe will be shocked that they are all gone. Thanking Link, he admits that he was responsible for letting the Box pile up until the entrance was blocked. While he is eager to leave, Piaffe asks Link if he wants to be the Stable's final customer. He welcomes Link to the Stable, giving him a single Pony Point to commemorate being the last customer. Having completed his time as a Stable owner, Piaffe wishes Link will on his travels. He then decides to finish cleaning out Gerudo Canyon Stable, once again thanking Link for his assistance.
Noticing the Empty Frames, Piaffe reveals that they were sent by the Stable Association. He removes their wrapping, claiming that they appear to be nicer than he predicted. He remarks that having art on the Stable's walls may make its final days seem less lonely. Afterwards, "Piaffe, Packed Away" will be completed.
overview_zh:
在格鲁多峡谷马厩，林克会发现皮亚菲被木箱包围，他想知道是否能清理完它们。当林克接近皮亚菲时，他透露马厩因游客稀少和塞尔达的命令而关闭，不能靠近格鲁多峡谷井。虽然她答应回来解决井的问题，但尚未执行。如果“堵塞的井”支线任务尚未完成，皮亚菲会为自己的悲伤感到抱歉，并建议林克前往卡拉卡巴扎尔休息。
如果林克已经完成了“堵塞的井”，他可以告诉皮亚菲塞尔达是为了阻止怪物袭击格鲁多峡谷马厩，这让皮亚菲感到震惊。他回忆起在格鲁多峡谷井建成后，该地区怪物的出现频率增加了，但在密封井之后才停止，但他太忙于清理马厩而没有注意到。他感谢林克进行了调查，并决定下次见到塞尔达时向她表达谢意。无论哪个场景结束，皮亚菲都决定重新开始清理马厩，尽管他不知道如何处理如此巨大的 mess。随后，“皮亚菲，终于整理完毕”将开始。
当林克在格鲁多峡谷马厩打破所有木箱时，皮亚菲震惊地发现它们都不见了。感谢林克，他承认自己让这些木箱堆积到阻碍入口。尽管他急于离开，但皮亚菲问林克是否愿意成为马厩的最后一个顾客。他欢迎林克来到马厩，并赠送一个独一无二的小洋蹄作为纪念品。完成任期后，皮亚菲祝愿林克旅途顺利。然后，他又决定重新清理格鲁多峡谷马厩，再次感谢林克的帮助。
注意到空空的画框，皮亚菲透露这是来自马厩协会的礼物。他打开了包装，称这些画看起来比他预想的好多了。他评论说，在马厩墙上挂艺术品可能会让它的最后几天感觉不那么孤单。随后，“皮亚菲，终于整理完毕”将完成。

overview_en:
Malena's husband became sick during their wedding adventure. She's upset that she pushed him past his limits, but it seems that Gleeok guts will cure him.

Unfortunately, they come from a three-headed monster flying over Gerudo Canyon.
overview_zh:
梅尔埃娜的丈夫在婚礼冒险途中病倒了。她懊悔让丈夫勉强过头，不过古栗欧克的肝脏似乎能治好他。

遗憾的是，那东西只能从飞在格鲁德峡谷上空的三头怪物身上取得。

overview_en:
When Link prays to the Spring of Wisdom Statue at the Spring of Wisdom, she expresses her concern that she can no longer sense the presence of the Mother Goddess Statue, who is situated within a "vast canyon". As a result of this, she asks Link to find the Mother Goddess Statue and report her condition. Following this request, "Goddess Statue of Wisdom" will begin.
At the back of the Forgotten Temple, Link discovers that the Mother Goddess Statue has fallen over. When he returns to the Spring of Wisdom Statue and informs her, she is saddened and asks for his help to restore the Mother Goddess Statue. In order to do so, she needs Link to find Naydra and offer one of her Claws to the Spring of Wisdom.
When Link drops Naydra's Claw into the Spring of Wisdom, the surrounding Water will begin to glow. The offering gives the Spring of Wisdom Statue the strength to send some of her power to the Mother Goddess Statue. As a reward for his help, she gives Link a Sapphire. If "Goddess Statue of Courage" and "Goddess Statue of Power" have already been finished, she suggests that he visit the Mother Goddess Statue, which starts "The Mother Goddess Statue" Side Quest. If not, she tells him to aid the other Goddess Statues that guard springs. Afterwards, "Goddess Statue of Wisdom" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克在智之泉的女神雕像面前祈祷时，她表达了对无法感知位于“广阔峡谷”中的母亲女神雕像的担忧。因此，她要求林克去寻找并汇报母亲女神雕像的情况。随后，“智之女神”将开始。

在遗忘神殿后方，林克发现母亲女神雕像倒塌了。当他回到智之泉的女神面前并告知她时，女神悲伤地请求他的帮助来恢复母亲女神雕像。为此，她需要林克去寻找纳德拉，并将其中一只爪子献给智之泉。

当林克将纳德拉的爪子放入智之泉后，周围的水开始发光。这让智之泉的女神获得了力量，可以将一部分力量传递给母亲女神雕像。作为回报，她给予了林克一颗蓝宝石。如果“勇气女神”和“力量女神”已经完成，她建议他去见母亲女神雕像，从而启动“母亲女神雕像”支线任务。否则，她让他帮助其他守护泉的女神。之后，“智之女神”将被完成。

overview_en:
When Link prays to the Spring of Power Statue at the Spring of Power, she claims that she can no longer sense the presence of a Goddess Statue known as the Mother Goddess Statue, which supposedly located within a "vast canyon". As a result, she asks Link to check on the Mother Goddess Statue and return with news of her condition. Following this request, "Goddess Statue of Power" will begin.
Inside the Forgotten Temple, Link finds that the Mother Goddess Statue has been knocked over. Upon returning to the Spring of Power Statue, she is shocked to hear this, and she asks Link to help her restore the Mother Goddess Statue. She needs Link to find the Dragon Dinraal and offer one of her Claws to the Spring of Power.
After obtaining Dinraal's Claw, Link can drop it into the Spring of Power, which causes the Water surrounding it to glow. The offering allows the Spring of Power Statue to send some of her strength to the Mother Goddess Statue. As a reward, she gives Link a Ruby. If "Goddess Statue of Courage" and "Goddess Statue of Wisdom" have already been completed, the Spring of Power Statue suggests that he visit the Mother Goddess Statue, which starts "The Mother Goddess Statue". If not, she asks him to help the other Goddess Statues that guard springs. Afterwards, "Goddess Statue of Power will be completed.
overview_zh:
林克在力量泉的女神雕像前祈祷，她声称已经无法感知到“母神雕像”的存在，据说是位于“广阔峡谷”中的。因此，她要求林克去检查“母神雕像”，并带回消息。随后，“力量女神雕像”将开始运作。
在遗忘之 temple中，林克发现“母神雕像”已被推倒。回到力量泉的女神雕像前，她被这个消息震惊了，并要求林克帮助她恢复“母神雕像”。她说需要林克找到龙——“Dinraal”，并将其中一把爪子献给力量泉。
获得Dinraal的爪子后，林克可以将它放入力量泉中，从而使周围的水呈现出光芒。这种献祭允许力量泉的女神将一部分力量传递给“母神雕像”。作为回报，她给予了林克一个红宝石。如果已经完成了“力量女神雕像”和“智慧女神雕像”，那么力量泉的女神建议他去拜访“母神雕像”，这会启动“母神雕像”。如果没有，她则要求他帮助其他守护泉的女神雕像。之后，“力量女神雕像”将完成。

overview_en:
When Link prays to the Spring of Courage Statue at the Spring of Courage, she reveals that she can no longer sense the presence of the Mother Goddess Statue, which can be found at the bottom of a "vast canyon". She asks Link to investigate the Mother Goddess Statue's status. Afterwards, "Goddess Statue of Courage" will begin.
At the Forgotten Temple, Link can find the Mother Goddess Statue has fallen over. When Link informs the Spring of Courage Statue, she becomes concerned, and she asks him to help her restore the Mother Goddess Statue. To do this, she asks him to find the Dragon Farosh and offer one of her Claws to the Spring of Courage.
When Link drops Farosh's Claw into the Spring of Courage, the Water surrounding it will begin to glow. The Spring of Courage Statue states that his offering gave her enough power to send her strength to the Mother Goddess Statue. As a reward, she gives Link a Topaz. If Link has already completed "Goddess Statue of Power" and "Goddess Statue of Wisdom", the Spring of Courage Statue asks him to make a pilgrimage to the Mother Goddess Statue, which starts "The Mother Goddess Statue". If not, she then requests that Link help the other two Goddess Statues who guard springs. Following this, "Goddess Statue of Courage" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克在勇气泉前祈祷时，她透露自己无法感知到位于“广阔峡谷”之下的母亲女神雕像的存在。她请求林克调查该雕像的状态。之后，“勇气女神雕像”将开始。

在遗忘神殿中，林克发现母亲女神雕像已经倒塌。当林克告知勇气泉，她感到担忧，并要求他帮助恢复母亲女神雕像。为此，她让他找到龙型怪物法罗斯，并将其中一只爪子献给勇气泉。
当林克将法罗斯的爪子放入勇气泉，泉水周围开始发光。勇气泉告诉他，他的贡品给予了她足够的能量来传达力量到母亲女神雕像上。作为回报，她给予林克一颗方晶。如果林克已经完成了“力量女神雕像”和“智慧女神雕像”，勇气泉则要求他前往母亲女神雕像，这将启动“母亲女神雕像”。否则，她会请求林克帮助其他两个守护泉的女神雕像。之后，“勇气女神雕像”将完成。

overview_en:
When Link initially visits the Mother Goddess Statue, he will discover that it has been knocked to the ground. After completing "Goddess Statue of Courage", "Goddess Statue of Power", and "Goddess Statue of Wisdom", Link will be directed to meet with the Mother Goddess Statue. Upon hearing this request, "The Mother Goddess Statue" Side Quest will begin.
At the back of the Forgotten Temple, Link can find that the Mother Goddess Statue has been able to set herself upright. When he prays to her, she expresses her gratitude for helping the Spring of Courage Statue, the Spring of Power Statue, and the Spring of Wisdom Statue. As a reward, she gives Link the White Sword of the Sky. She then tells him to bring peace to the world. Afterwards, "The Mother Goddess Statue" will be completed.
overview_zh:
当林克最初拜访“母神像”时，他会发现它被打翻在地。完成“勇气女神像”、“力量女神像”和“智慧女神像”，林克将被引导去与“母神像”见面。听到这个请求后，“母神像”支线任务开始。

在遗忘之寺的后方，林克可以发现“母神像”已经能够站起来。他向她祈祷时，她表示感谢帮助了“勇气泉”、“力量泉”和“智慧泉”。作为奖励，她赠予林克“天空之剑”（白色剑）。随后，她要求林克将世界带回和平。“母神像”任务完成。

overview_en:
The Side Quest begins when Link receives the final Light of Blessing from any of the 152 Shrines of Light. Rauru will call to Link and instruct him to visit the Temple of Time atop the Great Sky Island in order to receive a reward for his achievement.
A Stone Chest will appear behind the Goddess Statue in the Temple of Time after this. This Treasure Chest contains the Ancient Hero's Aspect, which houses the Spirit of the Ancient Hero who battled Calamity Ganon over 10,000 years prior. The Side Quest is completed upon opening the Treasure Chest.
overview_zh:
支线任务开始于林克在152个光之神殿中获得最终的光之祝福。拉鲁会呼唤林克，并指示他前往大天空岛上的时间之神殿，以获得奖励。
在时间之神殿的神后，会出现一个石质箱子。这个箱子内包含古代英雄的遗物，里面封存着与1万年前对抗灾厄加农的古老英雄的灵魂。完成支线任务就是在打开这个箱子的那一刻。
